Experience with machining stainless steel and aluminum. 8\. Oversee New Product Introduction (NPI) first article lots. 9\. Assist with shop scheduling process. 10\. Trouble shoot manufacturing processes on the floor as necessary. 11\. Working knowledge of CAD/CAM and DNC systems. 12\. Assist in generating estimates for new business. 13\. Basic knowledge of Lean Manufacturing. 14\. An associate or bachelor’s degree is desirable, or equivalent experience will be considered. 15\. This is a full\-time, 1st shift position and pays an extremely competitive salary. Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical benefits, company matching 401k, paidvacation, paid holidays, paid sick days. Summary: As a Manufacturing/Programming Engineer, you will be responsible for defining the process needed toproduce precision components. Reporting to the shop President, your role is essential in ensuring themanufacturing method meets all product specifications and quality standards. You will utilize your coreskills in blueprint reading, machining knowledge, and use of programming to achieve quality parts ontime to the customer. Your expertise will contribute to supporting efficient production workflows anduphold the organization’s commitment to excellence in manufacturing. Come and join our team to helpmake a significant impact on a dynamic manufacturing environment. You should be proficient in: * CNC Programming * CAD/CAM Software * Coating processes * Heat treatment * Machining

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: This role will be part of Bally Media, a Bally's Interactive company, that operates the Bally Sports Live and Stadium sports streaming services. Bally Sports Live reimagines how fans experience live sports through free streaming apps built around real\-time interactive communities, free\-to\-play games, and rewards. Stadium is a free ad\-supported streaming (FAST) sports network distributed through partners including Samsung TV Plus, Amazon Fire TV, Prime Video, LG Channels, Vizio WatchFree\+, Tubi, YouTube TV, DirecTV, and Fubo. Together, the two platforms bring fans live events and re\-airs from Minor League Baseball, the Savannah Bananas, Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship, Bare Knuckle Boxing, Pro Fighters League, AVP Pro Beach Volleyball, and more. We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to drive the modernization, scalability, and reliability of our infrastructure across AWS and on\-prem environments. Reporting to the Director, Platform Engineering, you'll work closely with software engineers, broadcast engineers, and product managers to evolve our cloud\-first, AI\-enabled DevOps practice. You'll contribute to critical projects improving CI/CD across our backend, web, mobile, and CTV apps, strengthening observability and incident response, and aligning processes across teams and platforms. This is a hands\-on role for someone who owns problems end to end, collaborates openly, brings a calm, reliability\-first mindset to incidents, and is always looking to automate toil and improve how we build and operate. You'll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping architecture, and building robust, maintainable systems at scale. Responsibilties: * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design and implement robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure in AWS * Develop and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform and Ansible * Contribute to improvements in system architecture, focusing on reliability, observability, and cost\-efficiency * Modernize our CI/CD practices, including the adoption of AI\-assisted tooling, to enable safe, rapid delivery of services across environments * Improve operational visibility through monitoring, logging, and tracing, applying AIOps approaches to anomaly detection and incident response. * Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and design reviews * Align DevOps tooling and processes across teams, promoting platform consistency and best practices * On\-call rotation and coverage during live events, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed to support broadcast reliability and incident response. Salary: $100,000\-$145,000 USD \#LI\-OP1 #### **Experience** Preferred* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 2–5 years of hands\-on DevOps or platform engineering experience, with a focus on cloud infrastructure * Experience with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, VPC, IAM, RDS, ALB, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, CloudWatch) * Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible), including reusable modules and remote state management * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines * Experience with observability and incident\-response tooling (Datadog, PagerDuty, or similar) * Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and distributed architectures * Experience operating systems at scale across multiple environments and AWS accounts * Experience with containerized workloads (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, ArgoCD, or similar) * Scripting or programming proficiency (Bash, Python, Go) * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation, including evenings, weekends, and holidays during live events Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: SR&ED Technical Specialist
jobs.description: **WHAT WE DO** We are a consulting firm, working in the areas of science, technology, and finance. Our knowledge extends across a diverse range of fields, including, but not limited to software engineering, manufacturing, agriculture, and other life sciences. We work with many different types of companies, ranging from start\-ups to multinational corporations. We work to support companies that are developing or using innovative technology to improve their business, through SR\&ED process improvements and strategic resource planning. **THE OPPORTUNITY** As an SR\&ED Technical Analyst, you will be working with industry leaders in technology and finance from all over Canada. You will be responsible for identifying eligible SR\&ED projects and expenses and preparing clear, well\-structured technical reports, giving innovators the opportunity to access government funding under applicable guidelines. For this role, we are especially seeking someone with the ability to write strong technical narratives in the life science and agriculture sector. You will need to quickly understand how new technologies and processes are being developed in life science and agriculture, and translate that information into accurate, compliant documentation that supports funding claims. Applicants should be comfortable engaging with technical experts across a variety of disciplines, asking the right questions to uncover key details, and distilling complex technical content into concise, compliant reports. This is an ideal role for someone with a background in life science, chemistry, biology, or a related technical field, strong technical writing skills, and a desire to work with innovative companies across Canada. Candidates with previous SR\&ED experience—whether in writing reports, reviewing technical eligibility, or working with SR\&ED consultants—are strongly encouraged to apply. Job benefits include corporate medical/dental plan. This is a full\-time permanent employment opportunity. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Lead technical interviews with developers, scientists, founders, and other subject\-matter experts to investigate SR\&ED projects. * Ask targeted follow\-up questions to uncover project objectives, technological challenges, attempted solutions, experimentation, failures, iterations, and technical advancements. * Quickly develop an understanding of unfamiliar technologies, systems, and technical domains. * Analyze project activities and technical documentation to identify potential SR\&ED\-eligible work. * Distinguish routine engineering, development, and implementation activities from eligible experimental development based on SR\&ED guidelines. * Identify gaps in technical information and conduct follow\-up discussions with clients to obtain the details required for claim preparation. * Organize information gathered through interviews and technical analysis into clear, concise technical reports that adhere to established SR\&ED claim conventions. * Collaborate with internal teams to connect technical project activities with eligible SR\&ED expenses. * Assist clients in preparing for and responding to CRA technical reviews, including helping technical personnel clearly explain the work performed. * Develop strong working relationships with client technical teams and become a trusted point of contact for understanding their ongoing SR\&ED activities. * Manage interviews, follow\-ups, and deliverables across multiple client projects and deadlines. **SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS** Ideally candidates will meet all job requirements listed below: * Degree or diploma in Chemistry, Biology, Life Sciences, or related technical field. * 1–2 years of experience in the above disciplines * Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to lead detailed technical conversations. * Excellent investigative skills, including the ability to ask effective follow\-up questions and identify missing or incomplete technical information. * Ability to understand unfamiliar technologies and technical concepts quickly. * Strong analytical skills and an ability to distinguish technical challenges from routine development problems. * Natural curiosity about how technologies, systems, and processes work. * Comfortable speaking with technical professionals ranging from individual developers and engineers to founders and senior technical leaders. * Ability to synthesize complex technical discussions into clear and accurate documentation. * Previous SR\&ED, R\&D grant, or other funding application experience. Technical interviewing, eligibility assessment, claim and report preparation, or working with SR\&ED consultants, is highly preferred. * Clear and concise technical writing skills with a focus on accuracy and compliance. * Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.). * Ability to manage multiple projects, interviews, follow\-ups, and deadlines. * Language of work: English. WHAT WE OFFER * Work\-from\-home flexibility within a fully remote team. * Direct exposure to developers, engineers, scientists, entrepreneurs, and technology leaders working on innovative projects. * Exposure to a wide range of technologies and industries, providing an opportunity to continuously expand your technical knowledge. * Training in SR\&ED technical eligibility, interviewing, claim preparation, and submission best practices. * The opportunity to develop specialized skills in technical investigation, analysis, and SR\&ED. * A collaborative environment that supports learning and professional growth. * Competitive compensation and extended health and dental benefits. Banhall Consulting Ltd. No phone calls and/or agencies. Candidates must be authorized to work in Canada. Banhall Consulting Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer. Please submit your cover letter, resume, and salary expectations to us. We thank all candidates who apply, however, only those selected for a personal interview will be contacted. Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent Job Type: Full\-time Pay: From $50,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off Flexible Language Requirement: * French not required Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Quantitative Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Job Description:** This job is responsible for designing, developing, testing and implementing common, reusable, and scalable software components which are either domain independent (generic data quality tools over billions of rows of data) or domain specific (classification models for surveillance or testing framework for Global Markets processes). Key responsibilities include enabling Global Risk Management's data and analytical capabilities. Job expectations include working with modelers, risk managers, and technologists to understand the current state and design the future state of data and analytics. **Responsibilities:** * Applies quantitative methods to develop capabilities that meet line of business, risk management and regulatory requirements * Understands financial data: schemas, flow, size, data issues, data controls, etc. * Builds performant big data pipelines * Uses programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles to deliver high quality code for model and testing processes * Collaborates with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements * Thinks outside the box of current industry standards to develop innovative approaches * Maintains and continuously enhances capabilities over time to respond to the changing nature of portfolios, economic conditions and emerging risks Global Risk Analytics (GRA) is a sub\-line of business within Global Risk Management (GRM), responsible for developing a consistent and coherent set of models, analytical tools, and tests for effective risk and capital measurement, management and reporting across Bank of America. GRA partners with the Lines of Business and Enterprise functions to ensure the capabilities it builds address both internal and regulatory requirements, and are responsive to the changing nature of portfolios, economic conditions, and emerging risks. In executing its activities, GRA drives innovation, process improvement and automation. **Job Description:** Quantitative engineers in Global Risk are responsible for designing and implementing common, reusable, and scalable software components. These components enable GRM’s data and analytical capabilities. These components can be domain independent (e.g., generic data quality tools over trillions of rows of data) or domain specific (e.g., classification models for surveillance or testing framework for Global Markets processes). Quantitative engineers work with modelers, risk managers, and technologists to understand the current state and design the future state of data and analytics. Quantitative engineers have a combination of software engineering, big data, and modeling skills and the ability to work across the entire spectrum of a big data stack – from data to logic to model to UI to UX. **Job Responsiblities:** * Applying quantitative methods to develop capabilities that meet line of business, risk management and regulatory requirements * Understanding financial data: schemas, flow, size, data issues, data controls, etc. * Building performant big data pipelines * Use programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles to deliver high quality code for model and testing processes * Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements * Think outside the box of current industry standards to develop innovative approaches * Maintaining and continuously enhancing capabilities over time to respond to the changing nature of portfolios, economic conditions and emerging risks * Source and evaluate data required for modeling and testing * Design and develop and implement models and tests * Produce clear, concise and repeatable technical documentation models and tests for internal and regulatory purposes **Required Qualifications:** * Candidates should meet all or a subset of the following technical skills: * Software engineering: modular code, software We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Job Description:** This job is responsible for designing, developing, testing and implementing common, reusable, and scalable software components which are either domain independent (generic data quality tools over billions of rows of data) or domain specific (classification models for surveillance or testing framework for Global Markets processes). Key responsibilities include enabling Global Risk Management's data and analytical capabilities. Job expectations include working with modelers, risk managers, and technologists to understand the current state and design the future state of data and analytics. **Responsibilities:** * Applies quantitative methods to develop capabilities that meet line of business, risk management and regulatory requirements * Understands financial data: schemas, flow, size, data issues, data controls, etc. * Builds performant big data pipelines * Uses programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles to deliver high quality code for model and testing processes * Collaborates with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements * Thinks outside the box of current industry standards to develop innovative approaches * Maintains and continuously enhances capabilities over time to respond to the changing nature of portfolios, economic conditions and emerging risks Global Risk Analytics (GRA) is a sub\-line of business within Global Risk Management (GRM), responsible for developing a consistent and coherent set of models, analytical tools, and tests for effective risk and capital measurement, management and reporting across Bank of America. GRA partners with the Lines of Business and Enterprise functions to ensure the capabilities it builds address both internal and regulatory requirements, and are responsive to the changing nature of portfolios, economic conditions, and emerging risks. In executing its activities, GRA drives innovation, process improvement and automation. **Job Profile Summary:** This job is responsible for obtaining an understanding of bank processes \- including underlying data, flows, and controls – and designing and implementing technical solutions to enhance Global Risk Management’s (GRM) data, testing, and analytical capabilities. Key responsibilities include collaborating with process owners, risk managers, and technologists to assess current state processes, underlying data, process flows and risks. Job expectations include building domain\-specific expertise in bank processes and data, and applying a combination of software engineering, big data, data science and risk management skills to drive the technical solution implementation and automate processes. **Responsibilities:** * Analytical Thinking \& Risk Management: Apply critical thinking, sound judgment, risk management principles to understand business processes, controls, and risks to influence appropriate designs for technical solutions to business problems. * Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication: Partner with process owners, data owners, Front Line Units, Technology teams, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and build understanding of the firms processes and technology landscape. * Solution Development \& Engineering: Leverage programming expertise, software development lifecycle (SDLC) principles, and AI development patterns to build and document scalable analytical solutions that support business objectives, regulatory requirements, and operational efficiency. * Data Engineering \& Analytics: Source, validate, and analyze data while designing scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions across large and complex datasets. Apply quantitative and analytical techniques to identify trends, assess risk. * AI Governance \& Operational Excellence: Understand governance, security, observability, and auditability control requirements for AI\-enabled solutions including continuous monitoring of performance. Develop understanding on how to drive process optimization, and enhance solution effectiveness through testing, feedback loops, automation, and responsible AI adoption. **Minimum Education Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degrees or above in fields including but not limited to: Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Process and Mechanical Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science (or equivalent work experience) **Required Skills:** * Analytical Thinking \& Problem Solving: Applies structured thinking, quantitative analysis, and sound judgment to solve business, risk, data, and technology challenges. * Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicates complex technical concepts to different audiences and able to build strong partnerships across stakeholders. * Software Engineering \& AI Development: Demonstrated strong programming skills (e.g., Python), analytical and problem\-solving, digital fluency, and exposure to AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), agentic AI concepts, or AI\-assisted development tools through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience. * Data Engineering \& Analytics: Experience working with structured and unstructured data, SQL, APIs, and databases to source, analyze, and integrate data while solving analytical problems. **Skills:** * Analytical Thinking * Critical Thinking * Oral Communications * Prioritization * Written Communications * Attention to Detail * Change Management * Collaboration * Presentation Skills **Minimum Education Requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent work experience **Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America) **Hours Per Week:** 40

jobs.title: IT Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **MEDICAL INSURANCE 100% ON US!** Great careers start with great benefits! Join the Barrett Petfood family and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical (company paid), dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) with company match; life insurance; health savings account; paid time off; seven paid holidays; employee discounts; complimentary pet food; and fun, company\-sponsored events. **About Barrett** This position is based in Little Falls, Minnesota, and an on\-site presence is expected due to the role's close partnership with manufacturing and operational teams and the need to support business\-critical systems used within the facility. Barrett Petfood develops super premium pet food diets from emerging brands to market leaders in the industry. Our family\-owned, nimble execution and continuous innovation takes pet food manufacturing, packaging and distribution to differentiating levels. With a relationship focus and a family feel, we offer many career opportunities throughout our process. **Purpose:** The IT Business Systems Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and enhancing Barrett Petfood's core business and manufacturing systems, with a primary focus on ERP (Plex), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), system integrations, reporting, and related applications. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines application support, system administration, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, integration support, and continuous improvement. This role is not primarily focused on desktop support, hardware support, printers, or general help desk ticket resolution. The primary focus is business applications, ERP/MES support, integrations, reporting, documentation, and system improvement. The IT Business Systems Engineer will work closely with IT Leadership, the IT Business Systems Lead, IT Operations, business stakeholders, and external technology partners to support reliable system operation, reduce dependency on individual system knowledge, and help expand Barrett Petfood's internal technical capabilities over time. **Attributes:** * Strong technical aptitude with the ability to learn complex business systems and technologies. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to understand business processes and apply technology to solve operational problems. * Curiosity and willingness to develop deep knowledge of ERP, MES, integrations, and related manufacturing systems. * Strong communication and relationship\-building skills across technical and non\-technical teams. * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the IT Business Systems Lead and other internal resources. * Comfortable balancing day\-to\-day system support with technical enhancements and continuous improvement. * Strong documentation and knowledge\-sharing habits. **Responsibilities:** * Support the day\-to\-day performance, reliability, configuration, and administration of Barrett's ERP (Plex), MES, and related business systems. * Develop strong functional and technical knowledge of Barrett's core business systems and serve as an internal resource for system administration and support. * Troubleshoot application, configuration, integration, data, and user\-related issues and coordinate resolution with IT leadership, the IT Business Systems Lead, IT Operations, or external vendors as appropriate. * Support manufacturing, supply chain, finance, quality, and other business teams with system questions, issues, and process improvements. * Assist with system enhancements, upgrades, new modules, integrations, configuration changes, and process\-improvement initiatives. * Support system integrations, EDI processes, APIs, interfaces, and reliable data flow between business applications. * Assist with the development, modification, or support of smaller technical solutions, scripts, reports, interfaces, or application enhancements based on business needs and individual technical capabilities. * Test and validate system changes, vendor\-developed solutions, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades before deployment into production. * Help identify opportunities for automation, standardization, simplification, and improved user experience. * Support user administration, system configuration, access management, and other application administration activities. * Assist in developing and supporting knowledgeable business system power users across the organization. * Partner with IT Operations to help ensure the integrity, availability, security, backup, recovery, and continuity of business systems and data. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, system configurations, integration documentation, and knowledge\-sharing practices. * Build knowledge across multiple business and manufacturing systems to help reduce organizational dependency on individual system knowledge. * Take on increasing technical responsibility and system ownership as experience, capability, and business knowledge develop. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant education or experience will be considered. * Experience in software development, application support, systems administration, integrations, databases, APIs, scripting, or other technical disciplines preferred. * ERP, MES, manufacturing systems, or enterprise business systems experience preferred but not required. * Experience working with ERP systems in a manufacturing environment is a plus. * Plex ERP experience is a plus but not required. Candidates with strong technical aptitude and demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex systems will be considered. * Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) is a plus. * Experience with system integrations, APIs, databases, EDI, or related technologies is preferred. * Experience supporting or troubleshooting business\-critical applications is preferred. * Recent graduates with strong technical fundamentals, demonstrated problem\-solving ability, and an interest in business and manufacturing systems are encouraged to apply. **Requirements** * Ability to sit, stand and walk for extended periods throughout the manufacturing facility. * Ability to bend, reach, climb stairs, stoop, kneel, and perform other physical activities required in a manufacturing environment. * Work in varying environmental conditions, including areas that may be hot, cold, wet, humid, noisy, or subject to temperature fluctuations. **Compensation** The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$60,000\-$85,000 annually**, depending on experience, qualifications, technical expertise, and overall fit for the role.

jobs.description: **Req \#** 209826 **Location** Raleigh, North Carolina, United States **Job Category** Research and Development **Date posted** 09/22/2026 **Overview** ------------ This is where new knowledge is discovered. Baxter’s Research and Development teams work cross functionally to innovate, develop and introduce creative solutions for patients needs globally. From Scientists to Engineers, your work creates the products that save and sustain lives. * Support for Parents * Continuing Education/ Professional Development * Employee Health \& Well\-Being Benefits * Paid Time Off * 2 Days a Year to Volunteer **Success Profile** ------------------- What makes a successful Research and Development team member at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit. * Courage * Action Oriented * Collaborates * Cultivates Innovation * Manages Ambiguity * Drives Results **This is where** your work makes a difference. At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. **Your Role at Baxter** ----------------------- Provides enterprise\-level technical leadership for cloud shared services and related connected\-care ecosystems. Collaborates with engineering, product, and business leaders to shape long\-term architectural strategy, establish technical standards, and guide the evolution of secure, cloud\-native services that support multiple products, regions, and business domains. Serves as a senior technical leader for distributed systems, GraphQL and API architecture, multi\-region cloud strategy, service interoperability, scalability, security, resiliency, observability, SOC 2 readiness, and operational excellence. Partners closely with executive leadership, product management, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, operations, and engineering teams to align technology investments, architectural decisions, and platform capabilities with business objectives and sustained growth. **What You'll Do** * Define and drive the long\-term architecture vision, technical roadmap, governance standards, and cloud\-native platform strategy for CSA in partnership with engineering and business stakeholders. * Collaborate with architects, engineering leaders, and cross\-functional teams to guide enterprise\-wide architectural decisions across products, services, and engineering organizations. * Lead the design and governance of scalable service, API, and integration architectures across GraphQL, REST, event\-driven systems, and microservices, building alignment around architectural best practices. * Partner with engineering and operations teams to establish and evolve multi\-region cloud strategies that support high availability, resiliency, disaster recovery, scalability, data residency, and operational readiness. * Champion modernization initiatives across Kubernetes, platform engineering, Infrastructure as Code, automated delivery pipelines, event streaming, and cloud\-native technologies. * Collaborate with cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, and engineering teams to define and implement security and compliance architecture standards, including SOC 2 readiness, identity and access management, encryption, secure software supply chains, and healthcare data protection requirements. * Facilitate architecture governance through reviews, standards, reference patterns, technical decision frameworks, and proactive management of architectural risk and technical debt. * Influence executive stakeholders, mentor senior technical leaders, and partner across engineering, product, security, quality, regulatory, audit, and operations teams to advance organizational architecture maturity, innovation, and technical excellence. **What You'll Bring** * 18\+ years of progressive software engineering experience with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, technical leadership, cloud\-native platforms, distributed systems, microservices, and mission\-critical service architectures. * Proven experience designing and governing scalable API ecosystems, including GraphQL, REST, event\-driven architectures, schema management, federation/composition, authorization, observability, and production operations. * Strong expertise defining and implementing multi\-region cloud strategies, including resiliency, disaster recovery, failover, traffic routing, replication, data e in healthcare technology, medical devices, connected\-care platforms, or other highly regulated industries strongly preferred. *Baxter is committed to supporting the needs for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a required minimum number of days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in\-person in support of our Mission. The flexible workplace policy is subject to local laws and legal requirements. At its discretion, Baxter may decide to adjust, suspend, or discontinue as business needs change.* We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $152,000\-$209,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview. **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.** \#LI\-TV1 **US Benefits at Baxter (except for Puerto Rico)** This is where your well\-being matters. Our health and well\-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short\-term and long\-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time\-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. jobs.title: Senior Algorithm Engineer
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Senior Algorithm and Machine Learning engineer! As part of Beacon's analytics and machine learning domain, you'll work alongside fellow data scientists, neuroscientists, engineers, and clinicians to scope, build, deploy, and maintain the machine and deep learning models that analyze brain and biosignal data for advancing sleep, neurological, and psychiatric therapy development. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those who lead by example. As such, we're always seeking out new contributors whose work demonstrates innate curiosity, a bias toward simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and—most of all—a deep empathy toward colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact. Beacon's work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs in Boston, New York City and Paris. This is a fully remote role based anywhere in the U.S. What success looks like * Participate in and lead the entire biosignal\-based algorithm development lifecycle for medical devices including specifications and requirements gathering, data curation and labeling, development, failure\-analysis, production, maintenance, and documentation. * Select, implement, and develop the most appropriate method for each problem, knowing when to apply deep learning techniques and when other methods are more effective. * Enhance our internal deep learning and machine learning tools to boost team efficiency, introduce new model architectures and algorithmic techniques, and refine the codebase to encourage reusability where needed to enable rapid experimentation. * Spread and improve our best practices to ensure algorithm implementations are user\-friendly, well\-documented, and thoroughly tested, including unit tests, comprehensive documentation, CI, and non\-regression testing. * Present results to key stakeholders and assist them in utilizing algorithms for client engagement. * Support the client\-facing projects to understand and shape the impact Beacon algorithms have for our customers, both for existing deployed algorithms, and future algorithm development. jobs.title: Engineer II, Marketplace
jobs.description: As an **Engineer II** with our **Marketplace** team, you will help build and support web experiences for sellers and customers, enabling them to discover, research, and purchase products through Best Buy’s marketplace ecosystem and digital commerce channels. Our mission is to build and evolve modern, scalable frontend platforms that power seamless user experiences. As part of the Marketplace engineering team, you’ll develop and enhance web applications for product discovery, seller platform, shopping, and commerce integrations. You’ll build responsive, accessible, and high\-performance web applications using modern frontend technologies. Our technology stack includes React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, REST APIs, GraphQL, Storybook and modern UI component libraries. You’ll work closely with backend services and APIs to deliver seamless end\-to\-end customer experiences. We seek a passionate frontend engineer with expertise in user experience and building high\-quality web applications that delight users. You’ll primarily work virtually from home or another non\-Best Buy location, but must live within a drivable distance to our corporate campus in Richfield, Minnesota. Specific work arrangements vary by role and team. The recruiter or hiring manager will provide details during the hiring process. **What you’ll do*** Build responsive, accessible, and high\-performance web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences across desktop and mobile platforms. * Design, develop, and maintain reusable frontend applications and UI components using React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Storybook. * Integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL services to create seamless, data\-driven user experiences. * Deliver simple, scalable solutions that enable rapid iteration, experimentation, and continuous delivery of customer value. * Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers through pair programming, design sessions, code reviews, and shared application ownership. * Thrive in fast\-changing environments by adapting to evolving requirements, taking ownership from ideation through delivery, and driving successful outcomes. **Basic qualifications*** 2\+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent relevant professional experience * 2\+ years of relevant Enterprise Software Engineering experience at scale * 2\+ years of development experience with React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Redux, HTML, CSS, Storybook and related technologies while leveraging modern tools such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, Webpack/Vite, and CI/CD pipelines. * 1\+ years of experience with REST web services and/or similar technologies **Preferred qualifications*** 3\+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent relevant professional experience. * Experience building web UI using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React) or working on MCP\-style applications * 3\+ years of development experience with Java, Spring, REST web services and similar technologies * Knowledge of modern deployment practices, CI/CD, and GitHub Actions * Ability and aptitude to solve complex problems and make pragmatic tradeoffs in a fast\-moving, evolving environment * Familiarity with networking, security, and infrastructure concepts (e.g., load balancers, DNS, firewalls) **What’s in it for you** We’re committed to helping our people thrive at work and at home. Best Buy offers a range of benefits to support your overall well\-being and provide support as you need it, especially at key moments in your life. Our benefits include:* Competitive pay * Great employee discount * Financial savings and retirement resources * Support for your physical and mental well\-being Best Buy provides different types of leaves of absence (LOA) and potential pay sources to employees based on eligibility. The length of your LOA depends on your situation, where you live, your full\-time or part\-time employment status, and federal and state regulations. Intermittent or reduced\-schedule leave is also available for certain medical or family care leaves. Paid time off (vacation or PTO) is offered to full\-time and part\-time employees based on work location, employment status, salary or hourly status (exempt/non\-exempt), and years of continued or bridged service. Certain roles, where market norms demand it, are eligible for various forms of incentive pay to drive performance and offer recognition for achieving financial and strategic results. For more information about our incentive pay plans, including eligibility, please refer to our Incentive Programs Summary. For more information about benefits, LOA and paid time off, please refer to our Benefits Guide. **About us** As part of the Best Buy team, you’ll help us fulfill our purpose to enrich lives through technology. We bring that to life every day by humanizing and personalizing tech solutions for every stage of life — in our stores, online and in customers’ homes. Our culture is built on deeply supporting and valuing our amazing employees who make it all possible. We’re committed to being a great place to work, where you can unlock unique career possibilities. Above all, we aim to provide a place where you can bring your full, authentic self to work now and into the future. Tomorrow works here.™ Best Buy is an equal opportunity employer. **Application deadline:** Minimum of 5 days from the posting date. You can find that date above the job title at the top of the page. Position Type: Full time

We put them at the center of everything we do and empower them to grow, explore new possibilities and use their diverse talents and perspectives to solve humanity's biggest challenges in an ever\-evolving world. With flexible ways of working and meaningful development opportunities, you’ll build a career you can be proud to stand behind. **The Opportunity** ------------------- In this role as **Construction Stormwater \& Environmental Compliance Specialist**, you will have the opportunity to: * Work with a dynamic team within an established global infrastructure consulting and engineering company. * Support proposal, design, procurement, and construction teams in identifying, mitigating, and managing environmental compliance risks on complex infrastructure and industrial construction projects. * Help develop practical environmental plans, procedures, matrices, and training materials that enable project teams to execute work safely, efficiently, and in compliance with federal, state, local, and client\-specific requirements. * Join Black \& Veatch’s Environmental practice focused on environmental stewardship, regulatory compliance, and practical solutions for clients and their projects. *This position will be based out of our Overland Park, World Head Quarters office.* **The Team** ------------ Our Environmental team is a multidisciplinary team of ecologists, engineers, scientists, project managers, and attorneys working together to identify optimum environmental solutions for our clients. We have provided environmental consulting services in support of projects for over 40 years including a diverse and growing mix of infrastructure projects such as power generation (conventional and renewable) and transmission, oil and gas facilities and pipelines, water and wastewater treatment facilities, and food and beverage industries. As a full\-service environmental consulting practice, services include impact assessment and planning, regulatory compliance and permitting, wetland and floodplain analysis, waterbody and water quality assessment, air quality permitting and management, environmental remediation, site due diligence, environmental noise assessment, pollution prevention planning, and climate action solutions. Environmental \| Black \& Veatch **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Review RFPs, contract documents, permit conditions, design packages, and applicable environmental regulations to identify construction\-phase environmental requirements, risks, assumptions, and compliance obligations for proposals and project execution. * Participate in pre\-bid and pre\-construction site visits to identify potential environmental constraints, stormwater risks, access considerations, waste streams, dewatering needs, sensitive resources, and mitigation measures that should be reflected in bids, schedules, scopes, and execution plans. * Develop, review, update, and support implementation of SWPPPs, environmental operations plans, waste management plans, spill prevention and response procedures, environmental compliance matrices, environmental awareness training, and related construction compliance deliverables. * Conduct construction site visits and compliance audits to evaluate implementation of permit requirements, SWPPPs, BMPs, waste management practices, spill prevention controls, and other environmental commitments; document findings and help develop solutions and timely implementation to support the resolution of issues. * Advise project mana s and regulations. **Certifications** ------------------ * Relevant stormwater, erosion and sediment control, environmental compliance, health and safety, or construction\-related certifications are preferred and may vary by project location and regulatory jurisdiction. **Work Environment/Physical Demands** ------------------------------------- * Hybrid or flexible work options may be offered after the first 90 days of employment based upon manager discretion, job performance, and work assignments. * Ability to utilize audio/videoconferencing software tools for internal and external communication. * Sitting, standing, and computer usage for extended periods of time. * Domestic travel is required to support proposal activities, site visits, construction audits, training, and project execution. jobs.title: Principal Engineering Lead
jobs.description: **About Blueprint** Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. **Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.** **About the Role** ------------------ Blueprint is seeking a **Principal Engineering Lead** to establish and guide engineering operating standards across a complex federal healthcare delivery program. This person will be accountable for improving how teams build, release, operate, and support reliable services at scale. The **Principal Engineering Lead** will collaborate with engineering, product, security, platform, operations, and program leaders to create consistent practices across the delivery model. The role will connect engineering execution with continuous delivery, operational readiness, measurable reliability, and DevSecOps expectations. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define and lead engineering operations standards across teams and delivery workstreams. * Establish continuous integration, continuous delivery, and release governance practices that support secure and reliable delivery. * Develop and maintain a consistent framework for service\-level objectives and service\-level indicators. * Define operational readiness criteria for new services, releases, and significant production changes. * Advance DevSecOps practices by integrating security, quality, automation, and operational controls throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Set reliability expectations and guide teams in improving service performance, resilience, observability, and recoverability. * Coordinate engineering standards across application, platform, security, and operations teams. * Identify systemic delivery and reliability risks and lead cross\-team resolution efforts. * Use operational and delivery metrics to evaluate performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement. * Communicate engineering standards, decisions, risks, and progress to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Participate in proposal\-related oral presentation preparation and presentation activities as required for this key personnel role. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Demonstrated experience leading engineering operations, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or large\-scale software delivery. * Experience establishing engineering standards across multiple teams or workstreams. * Strong understanding of continuous integration, continuous delivery, release governance, and production operations. * Experience defining or managing service\-level objectives, service\-level indicators, operational readiness criteria, and reliability practices. * Experience integrating security and compliance expectations into engineering and delivery processes. * Ability to align engineering, product, security, platform, operations, and program stakeholders around shared standards and priorities. * Ability to communicate complex engineering concepts and operational risks clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Experience operating at a principal, enterprise, or program leadership level. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience supporting federal healthcare, public\-sector healthcare, or similarly regulated technology environments. * Experience leading DevSecOps or reliability improvements across a multi\-team delivery model. * Experience with observability, incident management, release automation, and production\-readiness reviews. * Experience using engineering and operational metrics to guide investment and continuous improvement. * Experience participating in client presentations, solution reviews, or proposal oral presentations. **Compensation** ---------------- At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. The anticipated compensation range is **$174,300 to $205,900 USD annually**, with a **midpoint of $190,100\.** Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate's qualifications. **Location and Work Arrangement** --------------------------------- This role is primarily remote, but candidates must reside in the Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Northern Virginia area. Occasional onsite attendance in Baltimore, Maryland, will be required for key kickoffs and other important program activities. **Benefits** Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include: * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * 401(k) retirement plan * Competitive paid time off * Parental leave * Professional growth and development opportunities Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. **Applicant Accommodations** If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

components, documentation, and standards, and measure impact through efficiency gains, adoption, and business outcomes. * Measure solution impact through efficiency gains, time savings, adoption, paid parental leave covering up to 20 weeks of leave for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks of leave for all other parents * Access to financial coaches and education sessions * Weekly catered jobs.title: Director of Project Management - Project Management
jobs.description: General Summary: The Director of Project Management (DoPM) provides executive leadership and oversight of Brazos County’s Project Management Office (PMO). The DoPM ensures total lifecycle management of all County capital projects and other critical non\-capital projects, from idea intake through project closeout and lessons learned. The DoPM directs the County’s project governance structure, enforces the accountability framework, and ensures that Commissioners Court, departments, and external partners clearly understand their roles. All project ideas — including those originating from Commissioners Court — are routed through the PMO for evaluation and prioritization against the County’s long\-term Master Plan. The PMO serves as the single point of accountability to Commissioners Court and the public, while departmental projects may be executed locally with the PMO providing governance, support, and reporting. Essential Duties: 1\. Strategic Project Oversight * Exercise full authority over all County capital projects and critical non\-capital projects, including intake, prioritization, planning, execution, and closeout. * Determine which projects require direct PMO management and which may be executed at the departmental level, while maintaining governance and reporting authority. * Ensure all project ideas are consistently evaluated through the PMO and aligned with County priorities and statutory requirements. * Maintain the integrity and quality of the County Master Plan, ensuring all projects and initiatives are evaluated, prioritized, and executed in alignment with its goals. The DoPM is responsible for keeping the Master Plan current, actionable, and relevant to the County’s growth and needs. 2\. Governance \& Accountability * Enforce the County’s RACI framework, ensuring the PMO holds Accountability across the entire project lifecycle. * Serve as the County’s single point of contact with planners, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and partner agencies. * Oversee procurement coordination with Purchasing while retaining project lifecycle accountability. * Determine, and recommend to Commissioner’s Court, appropriate project delivery methods and procurement strategies for all major projects, ensuring compliance with Texas law and alignment with County goals. * Establish and enforce County\-wide project management standards, policies, and deliverable methods, ensuring consistency in design submissions, schedules, closeout documentation, and reporting. * Review and approve all change orders, scope adjustments, and amendments prior to submission to Commissioners’ Court. * Maintain the County’s official project portfolio register, balancing priorities, sequencing, and resources across all projects. * Lead County\-wide continuous improvement and benchmarking of project management practices. * Integrate technology, data analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools into project planning, monitoring, and reporting to enhance accuracy, transparency, and efficiency. * Maintain and administer the County’s Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), ensuring they are used consistently across all projects and departments. * Direct and require County personnel from various departments to fulfill project responsibilities in accordance with PMO policies, procedures, and standards. While department heads retain operational control of their staff, the DoPM holds the authority to ensure all assigned personnel perform their project roles and deliverables as required. 3\. Project Lifecycle Management * Direct initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout processes under PMBOK\-aligned methodologies. * Oversee project documentation including business cases, requirements, schedules, cost control items, and quality assurance. * Lead lessons\-learned reviews and ensure knowledge is institutionalized for future projects. 4\. Meetings \& Reporting * Lead and chair bi\-weekly project meetings with all pertinent staff, holding departments accountable for assigned tasks. * Produce and distribute meeting minutes with action items and decisions to all stakeholders. * Conduct quarterly workshops with Commissioners Court to provide public updates on project progress, risks, and milestones. * Maintain full transparency by updating the County’s project website with schedules, reports, and project documents for Court, staff, and public access. 5\. Departmental \& Stakeholder Coordination * Collaborate with the County Judge, Commissioners Court, Budget Office, Auditor, Purchasing, Facilities Services, Road \& Bridge, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure roles remain aligned with accountability assignments. * Ensure Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) provide technical input while maintaining PMO leadership of the process. 6\. Leadership of PMO Staff * Lead, mentor, and evaluate PMO staff, including project managers, coordinators, and analysts. * Build capacity for the PMO to support both centrally managed and department\-level projects. Other Duties as assigned. Supervision Received: General instruction and periodic review from Commissioner’s Court. Given: Direct Supervision of Project Management staff. Education Required: BA or BS in Business Administration, Operations Management, Business Analysis, Computer Science, MIS or related field or any equivalent combination of education and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities. Preferred: MS in Business Administration, Operations Management, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, MIS, Business Analysis, or IT Project Management or related field. Experience Required: Two years of experience in Project Management, Systems Analysis, and Business Analysis Preferred: Five years of experience in Project Management, Systems Analysis, and Business Analysis Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required: Valid driver’s license Preferred: PMI Project Management Professional, IIBA Certified Business Analysis Professional Physical Demands Typical: Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities Typical: Must be able to apply project management, systems analysis, and business analysis methodologies independently to identify opportunities and risks, interpersonal skills, excellent verbal, written, and communication skills, organization, and Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project. Must have excellent interpersonal skills. Work Environment Typical: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate but may be noisy or distracting. The employee is required to perform multiple tasks simultaneously and to perform tedious and exacting work. The employee may be required to work closely with others as part of a team or perform required job functions remotely, to work under time pressures to meet deadlines, and to work in emergency situations. Brazos County is a county located in the U.S. state of Texas. The population as of the 2020 US Census was 233,849 . The county seat is Bryan. Along with Brazoria County, the county is named for the Brazos River, which forms its western border.

The ideal candidate is deeply technical, credible with executives and operators alike, and drawn to complex, cross\-functional problems. Reporting into the CFO/COO organization, you will define the operating model, hire and develop the team, set the standards to maintain consistent metrics across the company, and be a key partner to leadership in making faster, better\-informed decisions. Near\-term opportunities span power utilization, capacity and demand forecasting, schedule and cost forecasting, fleet reliability, and product experimentation. * **Own Certified Marts and Metric Definitions**: Own the business logic, certified data marts, metric dictionary, and business\-rule testing that keep metrics consistent across the company. Establish peer review as a standard practice so work is checked by qualified colleagues before it reaches business leaders. * **Own Executive and Cross\-Business Reporting**: Own certified reporting for the executive team, the board, and questions that span business units, with operational reporting in the business units built on the marts your team certifies. * **Drive High\-Stakes Decision Support**: Turn the company's most complex, cross\-functional questions into clear analysis and recommendations that leadership can act on. * **Build Toward Self\-Service**: Create the conditions for the business to answer routine questions without routing through an analyst, including the table and field descriptions our data MCP reasons over, on top of certified marts with properly defined metrics. * **Maintain Close Proximity to the Business**: Keep analysts embedded in their domains through staff meetings, planning cycles, and shared goals, and align central and business unit priorities so analysts always know what matters most. * **Partner with the Data Team**: Collaborate with the Data team on the data foundation, contributing the domain context and business definitions that   team’s models substantively. * **Data Science Depth**: Direct experience applying forecasting, experimental design, and statistical inference to business problems, including ownership of models in production. * **Modern Data Stack Experience**: Experience with a modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, or equivalents). * **Governance Judgment**: Experience defining and certifying metrics, testing business rules, resolving entities across systems, and holding the line on definitions when a stakeholder wants their own version of a number. * **Business and Financial Acumen**: Comfort with P\&L mechanics, unit economics, capital projects, and returns analysis. You can defend a number, explain a method to a non\-technical audience, and disagree with a stakeholder without damaging the relationship. * **Organizational Navigation**: Proven ability to operate in a dotted\-line structure with competing priorities, earn trust from leaders within the business units, and optimize for the whole company rather than any one team. * **Ownership**: Track record of being the go\-to person for "is this number right?"
