jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Software Engineering Manager, GTI Team Lead** **Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00** **Remote** Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world. Global Tax and Regulatory Intelligence (GTI) is the product that tracks tax and regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, models them as workflows, and tells our clients what is due, where, and when. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the GTI engineering team. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will run the team, own delivery, and stay close to the code. Your architecture calls and your code reviews carry real weight. You will report to the Head of AI and work alongside product, design, and tax content on everything GTI ships. **Some of the things you will be doing:** * **The team.** You will run one\-on\-ones, set growth plans, give direct feedback, handle performance, and hiring decisions. * **Delivery.** You will work with product to turn the roadmap into releases the team can land, and you will be accountable for the dates you agree upon. * **Technical direction.** You will make and document the architecture decisions across the frontend, the backend services, the database, and the Azure footprint. * **Code quality.** You will review pull requests, set the bar for testing, and contribute code on the novel problems we encounter daily. * **The release process.** GTI ships from a multi\-service repository with release tagging, release candidates, changelog gates, and merge\-back rules. You will own that process and keep it “boring” and stable. * **Production health.** You will own on\-call, alert routing, and the observability stack. You will be the person who asks why an incident happened and makes sure it never happens again. * **Hands\-on work.** You will definitely write code, enough of it to keep your judgment current, though it will not fill most of your week. **The Stack:** GTI has a small number of moving parts, and you should be comfortable in all of them. * **Frontend:** Next.js and TypeScript, with a shared React component library. * **Backend:** .NET and C\# services behind the product APIs. * **Data:** Microsoft SQL Server, including schema design, migrations, and query tuning. * **Hosting:** Azure Container Apps, with Key Vault, Container Registry, managed identities, and private endpoints around it. * **Delivery:** GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Bicep for infrastructure, and Linear for planning. * **Telemetry:** Application Insights for tracing and PostHog for product analytics. **What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?** **Required** * Experience building and shipping production software, including leading a team as a manager or a technical lead. * Hands\-on depth in C\# and .NET, including API design, async work, and testing. * Hands\-on depth in modern TypeScript and React, with Next.js experience preferred. * SQL Server skills: schema design, indexing, reading query plans, and running migrations against live data. * Production experience with containerized workloads on Azure. * A track record of shipping on a schedule in an Agile work environment. * Clear written communication. You can write a design document, an incident review, and a performance review, and all three land. **Nice to Have** * Infrastructure as code with Bicep, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions. * Experience with observability tooling such as Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, or PostHog. * Experience leading a team through an agent\-led development workflow with tools such as Claude Code. * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features into production. * Background in tax, accounting, law, or another rule\-governed domain. We can teach the domain, and it is a head start if you already have it. * Experience hiring and onboarding engineers. **What you get out of this:** * A funded product with real regulatory stakes. * A small team you can shape, with enough room to change how it works. * Direct access to the Head of AI and to the AI research feeding into GTI. * The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly, including model APIs and Azure capacity. * Competitive compensation and a flexible remote setup. Tax compliance is unforgiving. A wrong obligation date or a missed filing is a real problem for a real client, so the bar for correctness is high and the surface area keeps growing. We need someone who can hold that bar while still shipping on a schedule, and who can drive a team that holds it without being watched. If that sounds like the kind of team you want to run, apply! \#CSC \#CSCCareers \#CorporateTax \#LI\-HL1

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== CVS Health is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering to join the Enterprise Observability Platform organization and help advance the next generation of observability, infrastructure, and security data capabilities. The Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering will play a critical role in designing, building, and operating scalable data pipelines and data products that power enterprise observability, operational intelligence, and security analytics across the organization. The Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and optimizing Databricks\-based data engineering solutions that ingest, transform, govern, and deliver high\-volume telemetry, infrastructure, application, and security data. This role combines deep hands\-on technical execution with ownership of engineering excellence, operational reliability, performance optimization, and data platform best practices. Working closely with Observability Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, and Data Platform teams, the Senior Data Engineer, Observability Engineering will contribute to the evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by building resilient ingestion frameworks, establishing data quality standards, enhancing governance controls, and driving efficient, scalable data processing patterns. The ideal candidate is passionate about engineering high\-quality solutions, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement, influencing technical standards, and raising the overall quality, reliability, and maintainability of the platform and team. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** ============================ * Design, build, deploy, and support scalable Databricks\-based data pipelines and lakehouse solutions that ingest, transform, and curate observability, infrastructure, and security data from multiple enterprise sources. * Develop and optimize PySpark workloads, Structured Streaming jobs, and bronze/silver/gold data architectures while ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, data quality, and operational excellence. * Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Observability, and Platform Engineering teams to onboard new data sources, establish governance standards, improve metadata management, and deliver trusted enterprise data products. * Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews, CI/CD practices, monitoring strategies, and platform optimization efforts while proactively identifying and addressing technical debt, process gaps, and operational risks. * Support the ongoing evolution of the enterprise observability lakehouse by promoting best practices for Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data governance, security controls, access management, and cost\-efficient data platform operations. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** =========================== * 5\+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise data engineering solutions using Python, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and distributed data processing technologies. * 5\+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large\-scale data pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, and bronze/silver/gold lakehouse architectures across multiple data sources. * 4\+ years of experience working with Databricks in production environments, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, serverless SQL, performance optimization, and platform operations. * 3\+ years of experience developing high\-volume batch and streaming data solutions, implementing data quality controls, troubleshooting pipeline issues, and improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. * 2\+ years of experience collaborating with engineering teams, participating in code reviews, contributing to technical standards, applying cloud security and access management principles, and communicating technical solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Experience building Structured Streaming and near real\-time ingestion solutions within Databricks or similar cloud\-native data platforms. * Experience implementing Databricks governance capabilities, including Unity Catalog, storage credentials, external locations, catalog management, and access control frameworks. * Familiarity with OCSF or similar observability, cybersecurity, or security event normalization frameworks. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for data engineering solutions using Databricks Asset Bundles, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent automation frameworks. * Prior experience supporting observability, infrastructure, cybersecurity, logging, telemetry, or operational analytics platforms in large\-scale enterprise environments. **EDUCATION** ============= Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience (High School Diploma/GED plus 4 years of relevant experience). **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** ===================== Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health**.** This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric healthcare for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make healthcare more personal, convenient, and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active duty, veterans, reservists, National Guard members, and military spouses) to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $92,700\.00 \- $222,480\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/31/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. Key reasons to join Cyngn: **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** * Our Vehicles \& Hardware team develops the physical systems that power Cyngn’s autonomous products, with a strong focus on real\-world deployment, safety certification, and operational robustness. * Cyngn is seeking a **Senior Systems Engineer** to lead system definition and architecture for autonomous vehicle and robotics platforms. This role is a senior, hands\-on systems position responsible for converting high\-level product requirements (L0/L1 user stories and product intent) into detailed, testable engineering specifications, architectures, and verification plans using a structured V\-model systems engineering approach. * This is a generalist systems role spanning sensors, compute, power distribution, actuation, and safety\-critical behaviors. The ideal candidate has deep experience in industrial robotics or vehicle systems, understands safety certification expectations, and can bridge product intent with disciplined engineering execution. **What you'll do** * Translate L0/L1 product requirements and user stories into complete, unambiguous, and testable system and subsystem specifications (L2\+). * Define system architectures and interfaces for autonomous vehicle and robotics platforms, including: * + Sensors (perception and low\-level feedback) + Compute and embedded controllers + Power distribution and protection + Actuation and drive systems * Own requirements decomposition, allocation, and traceability across mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software domains. * Develop system\-level verification and validation plans, including test strategies, acceptance criteria, and pass/fail definitions aligned with the systems engineering V\-model. * Lead technical trade studies, risk assessments, and architectural decisions with a focus on safety, reliability, and manufacturability. * Act as the systems engineering point of contact for industrial safety certification, ensuring system requirements and test plans support compliance. * Collaborate with product management, safety engineering, hardware, firmware, software, and test teams to ensure aligned execution. * Drive cross\-functional design reviews, requirements reviews, and system readiness milestones. * Support integration, debugging, and validation of vehicle and robotic systems during development and deployment phases. **Safety \& Certification Responsibilities** * Incorporate industrial safety requirements into system architecture, requirements, and test planning. * Support compliance efforts related to ANSI B56 standards for industrial trucks and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). * Work closely with safety and compliance teams to define safety functions, fault responses, and operational limits. * Ensure system behaviors are well\-defined for normal operation, degraded modes, and fault conditions. * Contribute to safety\-related documentation, including requirements, test evidence, and certification support artifacts. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or related field. * 8\+ years of experience in systems engineering for complex electro\-mechanical systems (robotics, vehicles, industrial automation, autonomy). * Strong experience translating product\-level requirements into detailed engineering specifications and verification plans. * Solid understanding of industrial safety standards, particularly ANSI B56 and related AMR / industrial vehicle safety frameworks. * Hands\-on familiarity with low\-level sensors and feedback systems, including: * + Encoders (incremental, absolute) + Angle and position sensors + Temperature sensors + Current and voltage s liarity with system integration, bring\-up, and hardware validation testing. * Experience working in fast\-paced product development environments with cross\-functional teams. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance plans, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Sabbatical leave opportunity after 5 years with the company * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, discipline, and termination.* *If you require accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know and we will work with you to provide reasonable accommodation* ***A Note on Recruitment Scams*** *We've seen an increase in fraudulent job offers and phishing attempts impersonating real companies, including Cyngn.* *To protect yourself:* * *All official communication from Cyngn recruiters and hiring managers will come from an email address ending in* ***@cyngn.com****. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* **The pay range for this role is:** 170,000 \- 190,000 USD per year(HQ \- Terra Bella)

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Developer - Computing Services
jobs.description: **Senior UI/UX Developer** to lead the design and front\-end implementation of intuitive, accessible, and responsive web applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between user experience design and software engineering—transforming complex functional requirements into user\-centered interface designs while writing clean, modern front\-end code. You will serve as the champion for web accessibility (ADA/WCAG compliance), establish UI/UX best practices, and collaborate with cross\-functional development teams to deliver seamless digital experiences across the university. **Your core responsibilities will include:** * I/UX Design \& Architecture: Design intuitive user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity prototypes, and design systems for enterprise web applications. * **Front\-End Development** : Translate UI/UX designs into production\-ready, performant front\-end code using modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS, and relevant web frameworks. * **ADA \& Accessibility Compliance** : Lead accessibility audits, remediations, and testing to ensure all web applications comply with ADA standards and WCAG 2\.1 AA/AAA guidelines. * **Front\-End Testing \& QA** : Build and execute automated UI testing (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and integration tests to ensure cross\-browser compatibility and component reliability. * **Technical Estimation \& Scoping** : Evaluate UX/UI requirements, estimate implementation timelines, assess browser compatibility, and ensure interface designs integrate cleanly with backend services. * **Mentorship \& Design Standards** : Establish division\-wide UI/UX design patterns, mentor junior developers on accessibility and front\-end best practices, and maintain clear design documentation. * Other duties as assigned. Flexibility, excellence, and passion are vital qualities within Computing Services. Inclusion, collaboration, and cultural sensitivity are valued competencies at CMU. Therefore, we are in search of a team member who is able to effectively interact with a varied population of internal and external partners at a high level of integrity. We are looking for someone who shares our values and who will support the mission of the university through their work. **Qualifications:** * **Experience:** 5–7 years of professional experience in UI/UX design and modern front\-end web development. * **Front\-End Engineering** : Solid JavaScript expertise and experience navigating modern JavaScript build tools, package managers, and front\-end frameworks/ecosystems. * **ADA \& Accessibility (WCAG):** Demonstrated experience designing and coding for web accessibility, including ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, contrast compliance, and screen reader compatibility (e.g., NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver). * **Automated Web \& UI Testing** : Strong experience with automated web testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress) and unit/component testing frameworks. * **UI Security \& Standards:** Good understanding of web application security as it impacts the front\-end (e.g., preventing XSS, safe state management, and secure form handling). * **Collaborative Leadership:** Proven track record of guiding UI/UX initiatives, collaborating closely with backend engineers and project leads, and documenting design systems/components. *A combination of education and relevant experience from which comparable knowledge is demonstrated may be considered.* **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Experience:** * **Full\-Stack Context** : Broad familiarity with Java application stacks (Spring Framework, Tomcat) or RESTful API integrations to collaborate effectively with backend developers. * **Database \& Data Integration** : Basic to solid understanding of SQL/Oracle or data pipelines to better design data\-dense dashboards and admin interfaces. * **AI Tooling in UX/Dev:** Recent exposure to AI\-assisted tools for design, prototyping, or front\-end code generation/testing. * **Environment \& Tools:** Comfort working in Linux\-based developer environments, using Git version control, and deploying containerized applications. * **Domain Context** : Prior experience designing accessible digital services within a Higher Education or public\-sector context. **Key Soft Skills:** * **User Empathy \& Advocacy** : Passion for to developers, product managers, and non\-technical university stakeholders. * **Problem\-Solving \& Detail Orientation** : Sharp eye for visual consistency, user friction points, micro\-interactions, and edge\-case behaviors. * **Adaptability \& Learning** : Drive to keep pace with evolving accessibility standards, modern front\-end frameworks, and emerging design technologies. **Requirements:** * jobs.title: Autonomy Engineer
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Engineering**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. The Robotics Planning Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and validating planning software that enables autonomous machines to safely and efficiently navigate, perform work tasks, and execute complex operations in dynamic environments. This role develops planning algorithms, APIs, software frameworks, and reusable components that support navigation planning, motion planning, path planning, terrain planning, and autonomous work execution across a variety of machine platforms and applications. The engineer collaborates closely with autonomy, perception, controls, simulation, and software platform teams to define requirements, develop robust planning solutions, create test scenarios, and evaluate system performance. Responsibilities include implementing and optimizing planning algorithms, developing C\+\+ software libraries and interfaces, supporting simulation and validation activities, analyzing field and test data, and contributing to scalable planning architectures that can accommodate different machine types, operating environments, objectives, and constraints. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with expertise in robotics, motion planning, optimization, controls, or autonomous systems and demonstrates a passion for solving challenging real\-world robotics problems. **What You Will Do:** * Collaborate with autonomy, perception, controls, simulation, and software platform teams to define requirements, develop robust planning solutions, create test scenarios, and evaluate system performance. * Design, implement, and optimize motion planning algorithms that enable autonomous systems to operate safely and efficiently in complex real\-world environments. * Develop and maintain high\-quality C\+\+ software libraries, interfaces, and planning frameworks to support autonomous machine capabilities. * Support simulation, testing, and validation activities by analyzing field and test data to identify performance improvements and ensure system reliability. * Contribute to scalable planning architectures that can be adapted across different machine types, operating environments, objectives, and operational constraints. * Apply expertise in robotics, motion planning, optimization, controls, and autonomous systems to solve challenging engineering problems and advance autonomy technology. **What You Will Have:** * **Problem Solving:** Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. * **Software Development Life Cycle:** Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace. * **Programming:** Knowledge of relevant programming languages and tools; ability to test, write, design, debug, troubleshoot and maintain source codes and computer programs. **Considerations For Top Candidates:** * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Robotics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * 1\+ years of experience developing robotics or autonomous solutions with demonstrated technical expertise in complex software systems. * Strong C\+\+ development skills with proficiency in Python for algorithm development, testing, and automation. * Experience interpreting system architectures, application designs, and technical specifications to deliver robust software solutions. * Knowledge of robotics frameworks and middleware technologies, including Robot Operating System (ROS). * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex software and application issues through code analysis, debugging, profiling, log analysis, and root cause investigation. * Experience applying structured software engineering practices, documenting technical issues and resolutions, and contributing to maintainable, scalable software architectures. **Additional Information:** * This position requires the candidate to work full\-time at the Irving, TX office. * Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position. * Visa sponsorship is NOT available with this position. * This position will require up to 10% travel * \#LI **Summary Pay Range:** $97,530\.00 \- $158,480\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. **Benefits:** Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. Relocation is available for this position. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:** Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply. Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

may involve some nights \& weekends * Overtime should generally be expected * Applicant must be able to complete the entry\-level safety training and demonstrate safe practices within 90 days of starting * Candidates must be local to the **Fairfield Maine** area or have independent plans to relocate **Work Environment** * Repeated and frequent ability to lift, from floor to above head, 25 lbs continuously. * Ability to sit, stand, climb, kneel, bend, lift, crawl, squat, reach, and utilize both hands and feet in an aerial and underground capacity. * Environmental Conditions exposure is heat, cold, dust, wet, vibration, and very loud noise. * Requires the ability to sit for extended periods, stand, bend, walk, communicate via telephone, computer and/or face\-to\-face contact, vision to monitor, and use basic office equipment such as a personal computer, copier, and fax machines regularly during the course of work. * Work is performed in and out of an office environment. This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. **AAP/EEO Statement:** Centerline is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Who We Are** At Centerline, we design, build, and maintain industry\-leading critical infrastructure across North America. Our technicians, engineers, and professional staff bring unmatched expertise to each job, working as a team to deliver consistent, exceptional results. That’s why Fortune 500 clients choose Centerline again and again for a wide range of projects. With demand for connectivity at an all\-time high, Centerline’s opportunities for growth are limitless — and so are yours. We’re committed to fostering your professional advancement and supporting your career journey. We look for team members who demonstrate our core values: Safety, Teamwork, Accountability, and Reliability. Our values are key to our team’s success and driving everyone to reach their full potential. As a member of our winning team, you’ll receive comprehensive insurance benefits — medical, dental, and vision — plus a 401(k) plan, referral bonuses, and generous PTO. Join us today. Together, we’re building a better network. \#LI\-AM1 \#IND1 Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description: At Central, an internship is more than completing busy work. Interns contribute to technology products that support our customers and business while building the engineering skills, judgment, and confidence needed to begin their careers. You will learn through meaningful work, regular feedback, and support from experienced teammates. Central’s internship program is customized to each placement. Interns gain first\-hand experience solving defined business and customer problems as part of a product team. The program provides exposure across the organization, opportunities to learn from experienced teammates, and the context to understand how technology improves the way the business operates. Each internship will be different; however, at its core, the program consists of the following opportunities: * Immersive experiences in challenging and meaningful work with built\-in continuous learning opportunities * Direct impact on work that matters and opportunities to affect successful outcomes and drive corporate objectives * Build foundational software engineering skills, product knowledge, and professional judgment * Build a lasting professional network through events and activities Software Engineering Intern * Uses and learns applicable programming language(s) and writes code * Learn and use the team’s standard development, source control, testing, collaboration, and delivery tools * Implements functionality on top of existing patterns and approaches * Work as part of a software engineering product team, participate in pairing and code reviews, and apply coaching and feedback from experienced engineers * Build an understanding of the product, who uses it, the customer or business problem it solves, and the team’s role in Central’s value chain * Use AI\-assisted development tools under team guidance to explore code, tests, documentation, and design options; verify the output and never treat generated content as automatically correct * Learn how delivered software behaves after release and how reliability, security, accessibility, maintainability, and data protection influence engineering decisions * Completes a summer long project and presents to executive leaders **Ready to dive in? Ideal candidates for this program are:** * Motivated to accomplish big things while demonstrating the upmost level of integrity * Curious and willing to seek context, ask thoughtful questions, try new tools and approaches, and act on feedback * Interested in understanding problems, analyzing information, and offering ideas while remaining open to coaching * Engaged in open communication to share a vision and build meaningful relationships * Committed to learning the craft, producing careful work, and improving when challenges or mistakes occur Next Steps **Applications Accepted:** Through January 2027, or until all positions are filled **Interviews \& Offers:** Conducted and extended on a rolling basis **Internship Dates:** May \- August 2027, aligning with summer break Candidates are encouraged to apply early. The job posting will close once all internship positions have been filled. Work Authorization Central will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1(including those with OPT or CPT), H\-1, H\-2, L\-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. Equal Opportunity Employer It is the policy of Central that all recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, overtime, job classification and assignment, facilities, promotions, transfers, employee treatment and all other terms and conditions of employment shall be maintained in a manner which will not discriminate against any person because of race, color, age, sex, national origin, ancestry, religion, marital status, military status, or disability. The applicant should respond to questions on this application in a way that will not divulge such information.

jobs.title: Full Stack Application Support Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Position Summary** The IT Application Support Analyst is responsible for providing technical assistance, troubleshooting, and maintenance of enterprise applications used within the organization. This role ensures system stability, supports end\-users, and collaborates with IT teams to enhance application functionality. The ideal candidate will have experience in IT support, application troubleshooting, and a strong understanding of business processes. ### **Responsibilities** The below reflects the essential functions considered necessary for this role and shall not be construed as a detailed description of all work requirements inherent in the job or assigned by supervisory personnel. This job description is used as a guide only and not inclusive of all responsibilities and job duties. * Provide first and second\-level support for enterprise applications, diagnosing and resolving technical issues efficiently. * Monitor and maintain application performance, ensuring uptime and reliability. * Work closely with vendors, IT teams, and end\-users to troubleshoot software\-related issues. * Assist in software installations, upgrades, patches, and configurations. * Manage user accounts, permissions, and access within applications. * Develop and maintain documentation, including troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles. * Collaborate with business units to understand requirements and provide application solutions. * Support integrations between applications and ensure data integrity. * Identify recurring issues and recommend long\-term solutions or process improvements. * Conduct training sessions and create user guides to enhance application knowledge among team members. * Conduct quarterly user access attestations. * Coordinate with the development team and product team on bugs and other application issues. * Duties as assigned. * Compliance with Centria's Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, and Federal and State laws. * Responsibility to report violations of Company policies or the Code of Conduct. ### **Required Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience). * 2\+ years of experience in IT support, application support, or helpdesk roles. * Working knowledge of laptop/desktop PC * Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel) * Proficiency in G Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Google Meet) * Proficiency with enterprise applications such as EHR/EMR systems, Google Suite, Central Reach Institute, Salesforce, Kronos UKG, or other industry\-specific software. * Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to analyze complex technical issues. * Experience with ticketing systems and IT service management processes. * Familiarity with SQL databases, reporting tools, and scripting for automation is a plus. * Strong communication and customer service skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. * Knowledge of IT security best practices and compliance requirements. * Experience with Microsoft Intune, Azure AD, or cloud\-based application management preferred. * ITIL certification or understanding of IT service management frameworks preferred. * Experience in a healthcare, education, or nonprofit organization preferred. An initial assessment of competency will be completed during the interview period and evaluated on an ongoing basis. * Ability to follow written instructions * Ability to use computers and computer/software programs * Ability to communicate expressively and receptively ### **Working Conditions** * Centria's office hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM. Hybrid or onsite work with occasional after\-hours support as needed. * Fast\-paced environment requiring adaptability and problem\-solving skills. ### **Physical Requirements** While performing the duties of this job, physical requirements such as bending, reaching, and lifting of up to 50 pounds may be required. This role will require sitting a majority of the day as well as walking as standing when needed. This role will require close visual activity on multiple computer screens or monitors and the ability to analyze data and figures on a screen. *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, Veteran status, or disability status. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with the position. Centria reserves the right to amend this job description at any time, with or without written notice.*

Work is performed under the limited supervision of the Assistant Director of Permits \& Inspections. \*\*NOTE\*\* Must attach a Prequalification letter or standard certificates **Essential Functions** ----------------------- The following essential functions serve as a general guide for this position. Position functions are subject to change based on departmental needs and external factors including, but not limited to, regulatory requirements. * Performs field inspections and reinspections of residential and commercial facilities for compliance with building, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical codes and documents violations and reinspection requirements for code compliance; * Examines and reviews plans and specifications for construction, plumbing, heating and air conditioning systems, and insulation for compliance with codes and reviews revised plans to ensure that they have been brought in compliance with the codes; * Enters inspection findings into permitting software for deficiencies and status and shall issue a Certificate of Compliance and consults with appropriate parties to resolve code deficiencies; * Interprets various codes and provides technical code information to the public, departmental staff, outside architects, engineers, and contractors and conducts code research through documentation and discussions with other agencies and jurisdictions; * Issues warnings and takes appropriate action; * Issues stop work orders where construction is not being made in compliance with regulations as to methods and/or materials; * Testifies in court on code violation cases; * Investigates complaints received by the public or other county departments; * Operates and maintains a county vehicle; * Prepares technical reports and documentation and maintains records and files regarding inspections; * Attends various meetings and training sessions to stay abreast of professional developments; * Performs other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- High school diploma or GED with coursework in building construction trades or a related field and considerable experience in building and construction trades or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ------------------------------------ * Thorough knowledge of all types of building construction materials and methods, and of the stages of construction when possible violations and defects may be easily observed and corrected; * Thorough knowledge of state and local building ordinances and codes related to building construction; * Ability to detect poor workmanship, inferior materials, and hazards of fire and collapse; * Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, and blueprints accurately and to compare them with construction in process; * Ability to deal firmly and tactfully in enforcing ordinances and codes; * Ability to perform mathematical calculations; * Ability to operate a personal computer including some knowledge of applicable software packages; * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with county officials, department heads, peers, associates, and the general public. **Physical Requirements** This work requires the regular exertion of up to 10 pounds of force, frequent exertion of up to 25 pounds of force and occasional exertion of up to 50 pounds of force; work regularly requires speaking or hearing, frequently requires standing, walking, sitting, use of hands and fingers, handling or feeling, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching with hands and arms, and repetitive motions and occasionally requires climbing, balancing, smelling, pushing, pulling and lifting; work has standard vision requirements; work requires vocal communication to express or exchange ideas orally; work requires hearing to perceive information at normal spoken levels; work requires preparing and analyzing written or computer data, visually inspecting small defects and/or small parts, using measuring devices, assembly or fabrication of parts within arms length, operating motor vehicles or equipment, and observing general surroundings and activities; work frequently requires exposure to outdoor weather conditions and occasionally requires exposure to wet, humid conditions (non\-weather), working near moving mechanical parts, working in high, precarious places, exposure to fumes or airborne particles and exposure to the risk of electrical shock; work is generally in a loud noise location (e.g. grounds maintenance, heavy traffic). **Special Requirements** Must possess a valid North Carolina driver's license. We believe the built environment of the future will incorporate renewable power on every surface that can support it. That’s why we designed an easy\-to\-adopt platform that allows large\-scale customers to achieve the benefits from solar energy with no upfront investment. **Job Summary** --------------- We’re seeking a Project Manager to join our growing team. This person will be responsible for the full\-cycle of project implementation, from project startup, including obtaining permits and licenses and managing jobsite mobilization, to overseeing job close\-out documentation and procedures (closeout documents, final job report, and final accounting). You will supervise multiple projects simultaneously and will report to the PMO Director. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Develop project business plan * Work with field management to generate job specific safety plan for the project * Serve as the main point of contact for the Engineer and Architect * Work with Pre\-Construction and Field Supervision to identify and implement all contract deliverables, quality testing, and reporting requirements * Create staging, logistics, and phasing plan for project * Lead coordination of subcontractors * Set up bonding and/or Subguard, change order log, and cost tracking for the project * Set up project in Procore software * Facilitate subcontractor pre\-mobilization/startup meetings * Issue and administer subcontracts (payments, insurance, bond, safety, haz\-com, etc.) and purchase orders for multiple trades * Assist in development, planning, and updating of overall project schedule. Attend/direct regular job scheduling meetings * Lead responsibility for project quality control plan implementation and compliance * Conduct bi\-weekly safety surveys with project superintendent * material/equipment invoices according to project budget * Prepare payment requests and monitor collections * Meet with city and state agencies to review project and inspections * Attend OAC progress jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cinchapi:** Cinchapi is where business runs itself. Our operational AI platform powers Ambient Agents that own ongoing outcomes, guided by your high\-level goals and KPIs. Instead of directing AI task by task, you define what success looks like. Ambient Agents figure out how to achieve and sustain it by working continuously in the background to plan, act, orchestrate workflows, and adapt as conditions change. For enterprises and small businesses alike, Cinchapi turns fragmented data and AI into operations that run autonomously. We’re an Atlanta\-based, founder\-led company at an inflection point: the product is live, the AI market is exploding, and we’re ready to build a repeatable revenue engine. That’s where you come in. The role: We’re hiring a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer to help our first customers put Cinchapi to work in their businesses. You’ll work directly with the founder, engineering team, and go\-to\-market lead, taking customer deployments from the first technical conversation through production and ongoing improvement. The work starts with understanding how a business operates: what people are trying to accomplish, where work gets stuck, and which systems and data they depend on. From there, you’ll design and build a solution on the Cinchapi platform, connecting systems, developing agent capabilities, and making sure the deployment delivers the results we agreed on with the customer. Our initial focus is mid\-market companies, with select enterprise design partners where there’s a strong fit. You might work directly with an operations leader on one engagement and navigate an IT team’s security and integration requirements on another. You’ll need to be comfortable with both. This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a position where you write recommendations and hand implementation to someone else. You’ll write production code, troubleshoot real systems, and stay involved after launch. As our first FDE, you’ll also help us figure out how to make deployments more consistent and less dependent on custom work as we grow. What you'll do: Work with customers to understand their operations, identify a useful starting point, and agree on what success looks like. You’ll turn a broad business goal into a practical scope, with clear requirements and measurable outcomes. Build the integrations, data connections, agent capabilities, and interfaces needed to make a deployment work. You’ll use the Cinchapi platform wherever it fits and write the code needed to connect it to the customer’s environment. Configure Ambient Agents around the customer’s goals and KPIs, giving them the context, tools, permissions, and boundaries they need to operate effectively over time. Establish how we test and monitor each deployment. You’ll evaluate agent behavior, handle failure cases, and decide where human review or approval is needed, taking reliability, security, privacy, and operating costs into account. Take promising prototypes into production. That includes resolving integration issues, managing technical scope, documenting how the system works, and making sure someone can diagnose and recover from problems after launch. Partner with the go\-to\-market lead on technical discovery, demos, and pilot design. They’ll own the commercial process; you’ll help determine what we can deliver, what it will take, and how we’ll demonstrate its value. Help customer teams understand and use what you build. You’ll lead practical training, answer questions honestly, and make sure customers know how to oversee their agents and when to step in. Bring recurring needs and deployment lessons back to the engineering team. When an integration or capability would help multiple customers, you’ll help turn it into something reusable rather than rebuilding it for every engagement. Develop the implementation practices, documentation, and tools that future FDEs will use. As the team grows, you’ll help hire and mentor the people who join you. What success looks like: In your first 90 days, you’ll develop a working command of the platform and lead an initial customer deployment from discovery into production. You’ll establish success metrics and reliability checks, while documenting the gaps and lessons we should address before the next deployment. By six months, you’ll have evidence of customer value from live deployments and a clearer understanding of which use cases we can deliver reliably. Useful integrations and implementation patterns should be reusable, and customer feedback should be informing product improvements. By the end of the first year, we should have a repeatable approach to technical delivery, customers who can point to measurable improvements in their operations, and a foundation that allows additional FDEs to become productive without starting from scratch. We’ll judge the work by how well it serves customers over time, not just how quickly we can launch a pilot. Who you are: You have roughly five or more years of software engineering experience and have taken systems from an incomplete set of requirements into production. You’re a strong generalist who can work across backend services, APIs, and data, with enough frontend experience to build a usable interface when needed. We care more about what you’ve built and owned than how many years you’ve spent with a particular framework. We’re especially interested in how you work: You’ve built with LLMs or agentic systems beyond a basic demo. You can explain how you tested their behavior, what failed, and how you decided they were ready for real users. You’re comfortable working directly with customers. You ask good questions, listen to how people actually do their jobs, and can explain technical decisions to both an engineer and a business owner. You have a solid grasp of data modeling, querying, APIs, authentication, and integrations. You can debug a problem that spans several systems, including ones you didn’t build. You can take an ambiguous goal and propose a sensible path forward. You know when to reuse an existing capability, when custom code is justified, and when a request needs to be narrowed or reconsidered. You’re honest about what AI can and cannot do. You’re willing to explain a limitation, raise a concern, or recommend human oversight rather than make a promise the system can’t keep. You can manage competing priorities across customer engagements without losing track of commitments. You communicate risks early and stay accountable when something goes wrong. You’re based in Atlanta or willing to relocate, and you can travel up to 25% for customer work and events. Previous experience in forward deployed engineering, an early\-stage engineering team, or hands\-on technical consulting would be especially useful. So would experience navigating enterprise deployment requirements, teaching non\-technical teams, or turning customer\-specific work into a reusable product. Compensation and benefits: Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience. Equity: 0\.75%–1% in stock options, vesting over four years with a one\-year cliff. Benefits: Health reimbursement and flexible PTO. This is a full\-time engineering role with meaningful ownership in the company. As our founding FDE, you’ll help shape both how we deliver for customers and how the team grows. Why this role: You’ll get to build software and work directly with the people who depend on it. You’ll see where the product helps, where it falls short, and have a direct hand in improving it. Because you’re joining early, you’ll also shape how Cinchapi works with customers and how the forward deployed engineering team grows. If you like understanding a business problem, building the solution, and staying close enough to see whether it actually worked, this role gives you responsibility for all three. To Apply Please submit your application at https://cinchapi.com/careers/founding\-forward\-deployed\-engineer Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description: Cognizant is a large IT Consulting Firm that leverages modern technologies to transform a variety of business operations. We are seeking a data\-driven Business Analyst to design and optimize customer support, teleoperations, and remote assistance workflows for our autonomous taxi (robotaxi) fleet. In this role, you will act as the bridge between autonomous vehicle operations and rider support. While you will not be performing raw point\-cloud or sensor signal processing, you must bring a solid conceptual understanding of the autonomous stack—including ADAS, LiDAR, radar, and camera perception—to accurately translate vehicle events into real\-time agent workflows. You will pair this domain literacy with strong SQL, Python, and modern dashboarding skills, alongside hands\-on application of GenAI and GenBI, to automate customer interactions and drive fleet performance insights. Please note that this role is fully onsite in Plano, TX . Role Responsibilities **Autonomous Fleet \& Teleoperations Workflows:** Define functional requirements for contact center agents and remote\-guidance operators handling robotaxi edge cases (e.g., sensor\-degradation alerts, pick\-up/drop\-off deadlocks, unexpected stops). Translate vehicle health, perception status flags (LiDAR/radar/camera health indicators), and ADAS state transitions into clear operational triggers for the support team. **Define and track mission\-critical metrics:** Time\-to\-Intervene (TTI), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Rider Safety NPS. **Data Analytics, SQL \& Dashboard Engineering:** Write complex SQL queries across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to track intervention trends, fleet exceptions, and call center throughput. Use Python (Pandas, NumPy) for exploratory data analysis, pattern identification in incident data, and automated reporting scripts. Design, build, and maintain production\-grade operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight to deliver real\-time operational visibility to executive and operations teams. **GenAI \& GenBI Implementation:** Specify functional requirements for contact center GenAI tools: real\-time call summarization, automated agent response recommendations, and context\-aware action triggers. Support the rollout of GenBI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot, ThoughtSpot, Amazon Q) to enable operations stakeholders to query fleet and support data using natural language. Collaborate with AI engineers to design safety guardrails, prompt templates, and evaluation criteria for customer\-facing conversational agents inside the vehicle. **Agile Delivery \& Product Backlog:** Author detailed PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams (BPMN) in Jira and Confluence. Partner with Teleoperations Leads, Fleet Operations, Data Engineers, and CCaaS engineering teams to deliver iterative platform upgrades. Desired Skills \& Experience **Domain Knowledge :** We would prefer someone with 3\+ years in the Automotive, ADAS, Autonomous Mobility, Connected Vehicle, or Fleet Telematics domain. This is not a hard requirement. **Conceptual literacy of autonomous vehicle systems:** LiDAR, Radar, Cameras, Ultrasonic sensors, and ADAS , including how sensor state degradation (weather, occlusion, hardware fault) impacts fleet routing and safety escalations (no low\-level sensor signal processing required). **Familiarity with autonomous vehicle concepts:** ODD (Operational Design Domain), disengagements, remote assist vs. direct drive, and SAE autonomy levels (L3–L5\). **Analytics \& Technical Toolkit:** **SQL:** Advanced capabilities in joining multi\-table schemas, writing window functions, query optimization, and aggregations. **P ython:** Strong working knowledge for data extraction, manipulation (Pandas), and incident data parsing. **BI \& Data Visualization:** Demonstrated track record building high\-impact operational dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. **GenAI / GenBI:** Hands\-on exposure to implementing or evaluating LLM\-driven features (e.g., prompt workflows, conversational AI, natural language querying for BI). **Business Analysis \& Operations:** Proven experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, and root\-cause analysis. Exposure to modern Contact Center / CCaaS platforms (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys, Twilio Flex) is a distinct advantage. **Salary and Other Compensation:** The annual salary for this position is between $110,000 \- $140,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. **Benefits:** Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off 401(k) plan and contributions Long\-term/Short\-term Disability Paid Parental Leave Employee Stock Purchase Plan **Disclaimer:** The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law. Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend) - Payments
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. **About Collectors** ==================== Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items, and today we employ more than 3,000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our Product \& Engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. **About the Role** ================== We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for our Payments team — a critical engineering domain responsible for building, scaling, and evolving the payments infrastructure that powers every transaction across the Collectors ecosystem. This team owns the full lifecycle of payment capabilities: integrating with and abstracting across multiple payment gateway providers (including Stripe and PayPal), supporting payment methods spanning credit card, ACH, and digital wallets, and building both the APIs that downstream services depend on and the web application experiences that customers and internal tools rely on. As a Staff Software Engineer, your influence extends beyond your team to the technology organization. You have expertise in the entirety of the Payments portfolio — how our services interact and how money and data flow between them — and you are building the same understanding of adjacent systems across grading, marketplace, vault, and identity. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role. Payments is the financial backbone of our marketplace — touching grading order checkout, vault and consignment transactions, partner payouts, and customer wallet top\-ups. You will own architecture decisions, gateway strategy, and the quality bar for everything that ships. We believe there is significant value in onsite partnership and team collaboration, and candidates within 1\-hour commuting distance of the office may be expected to work onsite most of the time. Additional details will be discussed during the recruiting process. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Own the architecture of the Payments domain end to end:** Hold expertise across the entirety of the team's products and services — C\#/.NET payment services, the distributed event\-driven systems they run on in AWS and Kubernetes, their relational and NoSQL data stores, gateway integrations, and the frontends they serve — including how they interact, how data flows between them, and how they fail. Architect for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling through clean service boun I and service layers, data stores, and the infrastructure they run on — with the judgment to design and review at every layer, even where others do the bulk of the implementation. * **Deep payments or fintech expertise.** You have owned gateway integrations, idempotency, webhook reliability, tokenization, reconciliation, and PCI compliance in production, and can reason about failure modes where money is at stake. * **Deep database and data\-modeling expertise, both relational (e.g. PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g. DynamoDB).** Schema design, migrations, query performance, and the realities of shared\-database coupling between services. * **Strong distributed\-systems fundamentals.** Service boundaries, API and contract design, Kafka\-based event\-driven architectures, messaging, idempotency, and failure handling — designed and operated in production. * **Production AWS and Kubernetes depth,** with infrastructure\-as\-code fluency (CDK and/or Terraform). * **A track record of raising engineering standards** across testing strategy, observability, documentation, and incident response. * **Observability\-first mindset.** You instrument what you ship using Datadog or similar tools, build dashboards and alerting, and use distributed tracing to debug production issues. * **Security\-minded.** You treat payment security as a first\-class engineering concern, not an afterthought, and partner with Security and Compliance to maintain and advance our certifications. * **AI\-first engineer.** Daily fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar), experience integrating them into team workflows (CI, code review, documentation), and mature judgment about verification, security, and the limits of AI\-generated code. * **Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies.** You're comfortable working in iterative delivery cycles, participating in sprint planning, and adapting quickly to changing priorities. * **Influential communicator.** Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and business audiences alike, with sharp analytical and troubleshooting instincts — you align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders without direct authority, make crisp calls, and bring people with you. * **Bias for ownership.** You have an extreme ownership mindset and will wear any hat required to get the job done. You thrive in a fast\-moving, self\-directed environment — you set the bar, hold it, and take full accountability for outcomes. Passion for collecting is a plus. * Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.*
