jobs.title: Business Development Executive
jobs.description: CTMS is seeking an experienced **Business Development Executive (BDE)** with a strong background in **Managed Service Provider (MSP) sales, technical solution selling, and business\-to\-business technology sales**. This is not an entry\-level sales position. The ideal candidate understands how businesses purchase and consume technology services and can confidently communicate with business owners, executives, IT leaders, and technical teams about managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, networking, compliance, and technology strategy. The Business Development Executive will be responsible for developing new client relationships, identifying business and technology needs, building solution opportunities, and working with CTMS technical leadership to design and close managed service agreements and technology projects. This individual should be comfortable discussing technology at both the **business and technical level** and must be capable of managing opportunities from initial prospecting through contract execution. About CTMS CTMS is an established technology services company providing managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, automation, and technology consulting to businesses throughout Ohio and beyond. Our managed services organization supports thousands of devices across a diverse client base and provides businesses with comprehensive technology management, cybersecurity, infrastructure support, and strategic IT services. Our solutions include: * Managed IT Services * Managed Cybersecurity * Microsoft 365 and Cloud Services * Network Infrastructure and Architecture * Server and Virtualization Solutions * Endpoint Management * Backup and Disaster Recovery * Security Operations and Monitoring * Microsoft 365 Security * Multi\-Factor Authentication * Vulnerability Management * Security Awareness Training * IT Consulting and Technology Strategy * Business Process Automation and AI Solutions The Business Development Executive will have access to experienced technical resources who can assist with discovery, solution architecture, assessments, and complex technical presentations. Key ResponsibilitiesNew Business Development * Identify, develop, and close new Managed Services opportunities. * Build relationships with business owners, executives, CFOs, IT leaders, controllers, operations managers, and other decision\-makers. * Develop new opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, strategic partnerships, industry events, and outbound sales activities. * Maintain an active and qualified sales pipeline. * Conduct initial discovery meetings with prospective clients. * Identify operational, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology challenges within prospective organizations. * Develop opportunities for recurring Managed Services agreements as well as associated technology projects. * Manage opportunities throughout the complete sales lifecycle from initial contact through contract execution. Technical \& Solution Selling The successful candidate does not need to be an engineer but must have enough technical knowledge to comfortably discuss modern business technology environments. Candidates should be familiar with concepts including: * Managed Service Providers and recurring IT services * Microsoft 365 * Microsoft Azure and cloud services * Windows Server environments * Active Directory * Networking, switching, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure * Endpoint management * Cybersecurity * Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR) * Managed Detection and Response (MDR) * Security Operations Centers (SOC) * Multi\-Factor Authentication * Email security * Backup and disaster recovery * Vulnerability management * Security awareness training * Virtualization * VMware environments * Business continuity * Compliance and cybersecurity frameworks The BDE must be capable of recognizing when deeper technical expertise is required and bringing CTMS engineers, technical leadership, or management into the sales process. Consultative Selling * Conduct business and technology discovery with prospective customers. * Understand the customer's business before recommending technology. * Identify risk, operational inefficiencies, cybersecurity concerns, technology gaps, and business objectives. * Translate technical capabilities into business value. * Build solutions around business outcomes rather than simply selling products. * Present CTMS Managed Services offerings and technology solutions to executive and technical audiences. * Help prospects understand the financial and operational advantages of outsourcing or augmenting IT operations. Sales Process \& Pipeline Management * Maintain accurate CRM records for prospects, opportunities, activities, and sales forecasts. * Develop and maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified MSP opportunities. * Perform regular follow\-up with prospects and strategic partners. * Coordinate technical assessments and discovery activities. ifications * Previous experience working for a Managed Service Provider. * Existing business relationships within Northeast Ohio. * Experience selling cybersecurity solutions. * Experience selling Microsoft 365 or Microsoft cloud solutions. * Experience selling infrastructure or networking solutions. * Experience selling recurring Managed Services agreements. * Experience selling to organizations with approximately 25–500\+ employees. * Experience with CRM\-based sales management. * Familiarity with compliance\-driven industries. * Experience working with automotive dealerships, professional services organizations, manufacturing companies, financial organizations, or other multi\-location businesses is a plus. What Makes This Position Different CTMS is looking for a **technology business development professional**, not simply a high\-volume salesperson. Our sales approach is consultative. We want someone who can sit across the table from a business owner, CFO, CIO, or IT Director, understand how technology affects their organization, identify areas where CTMS can provide value, and develop a long\-term technology partnership. You will work directly with experienced CTMS technical and executive leadership during larger or more complex opportunities. The right candidate will have the opportunity to develop substantial recurring revenue relationships and play an important role in the continued expansion of CTMS's Managed Services organization. Key Performance Expectations Success in this position will be measured through factors including: * Qualified MSP opportunities generated * New Managed Services agreements signed * Monthly recurring revenue generated * Annual contract value generated * Sales pipeline growth * Proposal\-to\-close performance * Development of strategic referral relationships * Development of new enterprise and mid\-market client relationships Compensation CTMS offers a competitive compensation structure designed to reward both experience and performance. * **Base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, technical sales background, industry knowledge, and demonstrated track record of success.** * In addition to base compensation, the position includes a **commission plan tied to new business and revenue generation**. * Additional performance\-based incentive opportunities may be available based on individual and company results. * The compensation structure is designed to reward the development of profitable, long\-term client relationships and recurring Managed Services revenue. Who Should Apply You may be an excellent candidate if you currently sell Managed IT Services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, telecommunications, infrastructure, or other complex technology solutions and are looking for an opportunity where you can have a meaningful role in growing an established technology company. We are particularly interested in candidates who understand that successful technology sales requires **business knowledge, technical credibility, disciplined prospecting, and strong relationship development**. CTMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $71,200\.46 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Cell phone reimbursement * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * You inherit a territory with no active pipeline. How would you generate qualified first meetings during your first 30 days? * A prospect says, “Our current IT company is fine.” How would you respond and continue the conversation? * What discovery questions would you ask before recommending a managed IT or cybersecurity solution? * How would you explain EDR, MDR, MFA, backup, and business continuity to a nontechnical business owner? * If your annual quota is $750,000 and your average qualified win rate is 25%, how much qualified pipeline would you want, and how would you manage it? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Akron, OH 44307

jobs.title: Sr. Network Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Date posted:** August 6, 2026 **Work Type:** Contract 6 month opportunity with possibility for extension. **Job description:** **Position Summary** Concordant LLC is seeking a hands\-on Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to support a phased infrastructure modernization engagement for a multi\-site customer. This contractor will own the network\-focused workstream: validating the current environment, developing a practical future\-state design, evaluating and recommending replacement hardware, and leading the configuration, implementation, performance testing, and cutover of network infrastructure. The environment includes multiple business locations, SonicWall and Sophos firewalls and site\-to\-site connectivity, switching and wireless infrastructure, VMware ESXi networking, on\-premises Windows services, and Azure connectivity dependencies. The right candidate combines strong design judgment with disciplined implementation and troubleshooting skills. This is an execution\-oriented role; the engineer must be comfortable working independently while coordinating closely with Concordant's Azure/Windows engineer and project manager. **Key Responsibilities** * Validate discovery findings and document the current network topology, traffic flows, dependencies, constraints, risks, and performance bottlenecks across customer locations. * Develop a right\-sized target\-state network design covering VLANs, segmentation, IP addressing, routing, switching, firewall policy, wireless, site\-to\-site VPNs, remote access, and resiliency. * Review and improve SonicWall and Sophos firewall and VPN configurations, including rules, objects, NAT, routing, logging, and secure inter\-site connectivity. * Assess and configure switching and UniFi components, including VLAN assignments, trunks, uplinks, access ports, wireless network mappings, and management connectivity. * Assess existing network hardware, software, licensing, lifecycle status, capacity, supportability, and replacement needs; translate findings into clear technical and operational requirements. * Evaluate, size, and recommend firewalls, switches, wireless equipment, and related infrastructure from Sophos, SonicWall, Cisco, Fortinet, UniFi, or any other appropriate major vendor. Prepare bills of materials, licensing, support, and cost options; then lead ground\-up configuration, staging, installation, migration, testing, validation, and documentation. * Prepare implementation plans, configuration standards, rollback procedures, validation checklists, and concise as\-built documentation needed for safe execution and support. * Stage, implement, validate, and troubleshoot network changes across multiple sites while minimizing operational disruption. * Coordinate Azure network connectivity with Concordant's Azure/Windows engineer, including VPN, routing, DNS, network security, and hybrid connectivity dependencies. * Support iterative file\-services and storage performance testing; identify network\-related throughput, latency, packet\-loss, MTU, routing, or firewall constraints and tune where appropriate. * Support VMware networking dependencies, including physical uplinks, NIC teaming, vSwitches, port groups, VLAN presentation, and connectivity validation. * Provide focused cutover support, root\-cause troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and operational handoff to Concordant and the customer. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience, including responsibility for production design, implementation, and troubleshooting in small\-to\-midsize enterprise environments. * Demonstrated expertise with SonicWall and Sophos firewalls, site\-to\-site VPNs, firewall policy, NAT, routing, logging, and troubleshooting. * Demonstrated experience gathering requirements and independently selecting, sizing, designing, and deploying complete network environments across multiple major vendors, including building and configuring new infrastructure from the ground up. * Strong practical knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, subnetting, DHCP, DNS dependencies, static and dynamic routing, QoS, and network segmentation. * Experience with managed switching and wireless platforms; direct UniFi experience is strongly preferred. * Experience supporting VMware ESXi network connectivity, vSwitches, port groups, physical NICs, and VLAN integration. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, including virtual networks, subnets, network security groups, VPN gateways, route tables, and hybrid connectivity. * Proven ability to diagnose performance issues using packet captures, throughput and latency testing, firewall logs, interface statistics, and other network telemetry. * Ability to produce clear diagrams, configuration records, implementation plans, and concise technical documentation. * Strong customer\-facing communication, sound change\-control discipline, and availability for scheduled evening or weekend cutovers when required. **Preferred Qualifications** * Relevant certifications such as SonicWall SNSA/SNSP, Sophos Firewall certification, CCNA/CCNP, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or comparable experience. * Experience modernizing multi\-site environments with limited segmentation, aging network components, or performance\-sensitive hybrid workloads. * Experience working in professional services or managed services environments with time\-bounded project scopes and multiple technical stakeholders. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code or configuration automation is helpful but not required. **Engagement Expectations** This is a project\-based contract role expected to average 13 hours per week, with heavier periods of up to 30–40 hours during staging, site implementations, performance testing, and cutovers. The initial engagement is planned for approximately 280 hours, with a potential extension of up to 80 additional hours based on project needs and performance. Schedule and duration may shift as discovery findings, customer availability, and implementation sequencing are confirmed. The contractor should be available during normal Mountain Time business hours for collaboration and may need to support scheduled after\-hours changes. Travel to customer locations may be required for selected discovery, installation, or cutover activities; exact requirements will be coordinated in advance. **Role Boundaries and Collaboration** The contractor will lead the network workstream and collaborate with Concordant's Azure/Windows engineer and part\-time project manager. The role is not intended to own Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DFS/file\-server engineering, general Azure resource deployment, end\-user support, or project administration except where those areas directly depend on network design, configuration, testing, or troubleshooting. **Success in This Role** * Network risks and dependencies are identified early and communicated clearly. * Hardware and platform recommendations are well sized, vendor\-neutral, cost\-conscious, supportable, and aligned with the customer's pace and operational needs. * Changes are implemented safely with documented validation and rollback steps. * Connectivity and performance gates are resolved so downstream Azure and file\-services work can proceed. * Documentation is accurate and sufficient for handoff without creating unnecessary project overhead. **About Concordant LLC** Concordant LLC helps organizations plan, modernize, secure, and operate technology environments. Our teams value practical engineering, thoughtful communication, efficient execution, and supportable solutions. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Concordant LLC is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available during the hiring process. Pay: $45\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment? * What is your current physical mailing address? (SBA HUBZone check) * Do you have any relevant certifications for this role? * Would you be available for occasional travel to Wyoming for stakeholder meetings? Experience: * Network engineering: 7 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager
jobs.description: Core Facility Solutions is seeking an Construction Project Manager with an anticipated start date of approximately October 2026\. The primary focus of this position will be HVAC and building controls projects; however, responsibilities may also include roofing, paving, concrete, and other facility improvement projects. The Project Manager will take approved designs and project scopes and coordinate their successful implementation in the field. Responsibilities include subcontractor scheduling and coordination, customer communication, construction oversight, project documentation, schedule management, quality control, commissioning support, and project closeout. This position serves as an important link between the customer, project design team, subcontractors, suppliers, and other project stakeholders. The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, managing multiple projects, solving field issues, and maintaining strong relationships with customers and contractors. The preferred candidate will be located in central or western North Dakota and will work remotely from a home office. Frequent weekly travel to active project sites is required, including multiple overnight stays at or near customer facilities. **Primary Responsibilities** **Project Implementation** * Review approved project designs, drawings, specifications, estimates, and scopes of work. * Develop a clear understanding of project intent and customer expectations before construction begins. * Coordinate implementation of the approved design with subcontractors, suppliers, customers, and project stakeholders. * Ensure field work is completed in accordance with project drawings, specifications, approved proposals, and contract requirements. * Identify discrepancies, conflicts, unforeseen conditions, and potential scope changes. * Coordinate with designers, engineers, contractors, and ownership to resolve project issues. * Assist with constructability reviews and identify potential scheduling or installation concerns before they affect the project. **Subcontractor Coordination and Scheduling** * Develop and maintain subcontractor construction schedules. * Coordinate subcontractor mobilization and sequencing of work. * Communicate project requirements, milestones, deadlines, and customer expectations. * Coordinate multiple trades to reduce scheduling conflicts and project delays. * Monitor subcontractor progress against established schedules. * Conduct subcontractor coordination meetings as needed. * Follow up on outstanding work, materials, submittals, deficiencies, and project commitments. * Ensure subcontractors have the information necessary to complete their work. * Coordinate equipment and material deliveries with project schedules. * Resolve or assist in resolving conflicts between trades. **Customer Support and Communication** * Serve as a primary point of contact for customers during project implementation. * Maintain regular communication regarding project schedules, progress, disruptions, upcoming work, and outstanding decisions. * Respond to customer questions and concerns in a timely and professional manner. * Coordinate construction activities around building occupancy and customer operations. * Explain project activities and technical issues in clear, practical terms. * Communicate schedule changes, field conditions, and potential project impacts. * Assist with customer training and project turnover when applicable. * Develop and maintain strong working relationships with owners, facility personnel, contractors, and other stakeholders. * Approach project decisions with the customer's long\-term interests in mind. **HVAC and Building Controls Projects** * HVAC and controls projects may include coordination of: * Boilers and hydronic heating systems * Heat pumps * Air\-handling units * Rooftop units * Pumps and piping systems * Unit ventilators and terminal equipment * Ventilation systems * Variable\-frequency drives * HVAC controls * Building automation systems * Control valves and dampers * Sensors and actuators * Equipment integration * Electrical work associated with HVAC systems * Testing, adjusting, and balancing * Equipment startup * System commissioning The Project Manager is not necessarily expected to perform controls programming but should have sufficient knowledge of HVAC and building controls to coordinate contractors, understand intended system operation, recognize potential issues, and communicate effectively with controls technicians, engineers, and facility personnel. **Other Facility Improvement Projects** * The Project Manager may also oversee projects involving**:** * Roofing replacement and repair * Asphalt paving and parking lot improvements * Concrete sidewalks, curbs, slabs, and equipment pads * Exterior and site improvements * Building envelope improvements * Deferred maintenance projects * Energy\-efficiency improvements * Other capital improvement projects as assigned **Project Administrat ations** * Residence in central or western North Dakota. * Commercial HVAC project experience. * Building automation or HVAC controls experience. * General construction project\-management experience. * Experience managing roofing, paving, concrete, or facility\-improvement projects. * Experience working in K\-12 schools, municipal facilities, tribal facilities, churches, commercial buildings, or other occupied facilities. * Experience reviewing subcontractor bids and proposals. * Experience with construction estimating and project cost tracking. * Familiarity with building commissioning and project closeout procedures. * Experience with energy\-efficiency or deferred\-maintenance projects. * Associate's or bachelor's degree in construction management, HVAC technology, engineering technology, or a related field is beneficial but not required when equivalent experience is demonstrated. **Key Skills and Characteristics** The successful candidate should demonstrate: * Strong customer\-service orientation * Project ownership and accountability * Strong scheduling and coordination skills * Practical construction knowledge * Mechanical aptitude * Ability to read construction documents * Problem\-solving ability * Attention to detail * Budget awareness * Ability to manage subcontractors effectively * Ability to communicate with both technical and non\-technical personnel * Ability to prioritize multiple active projects * Professional judgment and decision\-making * Flexibility and willingness to help where needed * Ability to work independently with limited day\-to\-day supervision **Work Location, Travel, and Schedule** The preferred candidate will be based in central or western North Dakota and will work remotely from a home office. Frequent weekly travel to customer facilities and active project sites is required for project meetings, subcontractor coordination, inspections, equipment startup, commissioning, punch\-list work, and closeout. Multiple overnight stays may be required based on project location and schedule. Core Facility Solutions will: * Reimburse approved business travel expenses. * Reimburse mileage for approved use of a personal vehicle for company business. * Provide a phone allowance. * Provide a home internet allowance. * This position may require extended workdays and occasional weekend hours based on project schedules, equipment startup requirements, customer needs, or construction activities. **Physical and Environmental Requirements** Project work may require exposure to active construction environments and varying field conditions. * The employee may be required to: * Work outdoors in varying weather conditions. * Climb ladders and access rooftops. * Enter mechanical rooms and confined or tight spaces. * Walk active construction sites and uneven surfaces. * Access equipment areas that may be hot, cold, dusty, noisy, or otherwise typical of construction and mechanical environments. * Stand, walk, bend, climb, and move throughout project sites for extended periods. * Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position. **Position Objective** The objective of this position is to turn approved project designs into completed projects by coordinating subcontractors, schedules, customers, materials, documentation, and field activities. The Project Manager is responsible for keeping projects moving forward, identifying and resolving issues, maintaining clear communication with customers, and ensuring the completed work meets the intended project requirements. Above all, the Project Manager is expected to support Core Facility Solutions' commitment to practical solutions that serve the customer's long\-term interests. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Cell phone reimbursement * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Opportunities for advancement * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bismarck, ND 58502

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer – AI/Machine Learning
jobs.description: We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to help shape and drive AI/ML enablement and readiness across the organization. This role requires strong data engineering fundamentals: you will start hands\-on, contributing directly to our data platform and pipelines, while progressively taking on a leading role in defining how the organization builds, deploys, and governs AI/ML capabilities. Reporting directly to the VP, Head of Data, you will work autonomously to identify gaps, propose solutions, and bring innovative thinking to how our data and AI/ML ecosystem should evolve. You will partner closely with Data Governance, Data Engineering, and Product stakeholders to define our AI/ML frameworks and MLOps strategy, and to ensure the organization is well\-positioned to adopt AI/ML responsibly and at scale. **Key** **Accountabilities/Deliverables:** * Design, build, and optimize data pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and platform components that support analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases. * Take direct, autonomous ownership of complex engineering initiatives, from technical design through implementation and rollout, with minimal need for oversight. * Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability issues across the existing data platform. * Bring innovative, well\-reasoned solutions to data engineering problems, proactively identifying gaps and proposing improvements rather than waiting for direction. * Write clean, well\-tested, well\-documented code and infrastructure\-as\-code, maintaining strong engineering hygiene across your work. * Help define the organization's AI/ML frameworks, evaluating and recommending tools, platforms, and standards for building and deploying AI/ML solutions. * Build working prototypes that provide immediate value to the engineering teams * Shape and help implement our MLOps strategy, including approaches to model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management * Partner in deep, ongoing collaboration with Data Governance to ensure AI/ML frameworks and practices align with data governance, security, and compliance standards. * Design and advocate for data infrastructure patterns that support AI/ML use cases at scale (e.g., feature stores, curated/governed datasets, streaming access for training and inference). * Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and business stakeholders to assess AI/ML readiness gaps and build a roadmap to close them. * Act as a subject\-matter expert and thought partner to the VP, Head of Data on emerging AI/ML technologies, practices, and industry trends. * Document AI/ML standards, frameworks, and decisions to support consistent adoption across the organization as the practice matures. * Act as a senior technical resource for the team, providing guidance on architecture, design patterns, and best practices AI/ML readiness and ML Ops frameworks * Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture on establishing architectural blueprints for AI readiness * Other Duties as Assigned. **Technical Knowledge and Understanding:** **Data Engineering** * Strong data engineering fundamentals: deep expertise in data pipeline design, optimization, and distributed data processing (e.g., Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, or equivalent). * Platforms: hands\-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks, and/or Azure Synapse Analytics, with the ability to architect and optimize workloads on one or more of these platforms. * Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern data warehouse/lakehouse architectures. **AI/ML Engineering** Programming \& software engineering fundamentals * Strong Python (the de facto language for AI/ML tooling); solid software engineering practices (testing, version control, code review) since AI engineers ship production systems, not just notebooks * API design and integration — most AI engineering work today is building systems around models (orchestration, tool\-calling, retrieval), not training them from scratch LLM \& foundation model fluency * Practical experience with LLM APIs (ie. OpenAI) and open\-weight models * Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation as a discipline, not just trial\-and\-error * Understanding of context windows, tokenization, embeddings, and model limitations (hallucination, latency, cost tradeoffs) RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) \& data retrieval * Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.) and embedding models * Chunking strategies, hybrid search, reranking Agentic systems \& orchestration * Frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration * Tool\-use / function\-calling design, multi\-step reasoning chains, agent memory and state management Fine\-tuning \& model adaptation * When to fine\-tune vs. prompt vs. RAG * Familiarity with parameter\-efficient methods (LoRA, etc.) MLOps / LLMOps * Model evaluation frameworks, A/B testing for model outputs, observability (tracing, logging model calls) * Deployment patterns: latency/cost optimization, caching, streaming responses, fallback handling * Versioning prompts and models, not just code * Safety, evaluation \& governance awareness * Bias/safety evaluation, guardrails, handling PII appropriately **Experience:** * Minimum 7\+years of experience in data engineering, with experience working on large\-scale, mature data platforms. * 3\+ years of experience developing ML or AI deliverables – includes deployment to production * Bachelor's degree in related field or demonstrated equivalent experience in a related field required. * Working knowledge of Agentic Workflows for engineering and architecture * Demonstrated experience taking autonomous technical ownership of complex projects from design through delivery, with minimal oversight. * Experience contributing to or shaping AI/ML enablement efforts, such as defining frameworks, evaluating MLOps tooling, or building infrastructure that supports model training and deployment. * Experience partnering with Data Governance, Data Science, or Compliance teams to align technical practices with governance and regulatory requirements. * A track record of proposing and driving innovative technical solutions rather than simply executing predefined plans. * Experience designing or implementing Agentic workflows for data engineering preferred. * Experience working with Property \& Casualty insurance carriers preferred. * Experience with Data Vault 2\.0 or Ensemble data modeling techniques preferred. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over work authorization sponsorship now or in the future for this position. \#LI\-Hybrid * At Core Specialty, you will receive a competitive salary and opportunities for professional development and advancement. We offer medical, dental, vision, and life insurances; short and long\-term disability; a Company\-match of 100% of a 6% contribution 401(k) plan; an Employee Assistance Plan; Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, Health Reimbursement Account, and a wellness program

Must also support facilities operations and maintenance by developing long\-range infrastructure priorities and conducting facility condition and capability assessments. * Serves as a primary technical consultant and project coordinator, liaising with engineers, architects, planners, contracting officers, tenant organizations, and external construction agents (for example, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command). Must apply knowledge across multiple engineering and planning disciplines to integrate technical, functional, and spatial requirements, lead design charrettes, and provide commanders and senior leaders with clear, timely advice on project status, risks, and technical issues. * Will collect, evaluate, and analyze technical data affecting facilities and infrastructure using advanced computer tools such as CADD, GIS, BIM, and other Government\-approved modeling programs. the safety and environmental compliance of the installation work environment. **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in civil engineering from an ABET\-accredited program and at least 5 and structural disciplines to ensure proper design and construction integration. * Comprehensive knowledge of applicable engineering and construction standards, contracting regulations, health and safety requirements, and environmental laws to ensure full compliance on all projects. * Proficiency in automated data processing, program planning, and budgeting cycles, including use of financial control systems to effectively manage project resources and timelines. * A high degree of skill in aesthetic and functional design techniques, drafting, and preparing complete project documentation, including preliminary sketches and final construction drawings. * The ability to plan, conduct, and record detailed site and facility surveys and inspections, and to analyze and apply the results to recommend timely and economical engineering solutions. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Structural engineering experience is desired DEFTEC offers a comprehensive whole\-life benefits package that jobs.title: ML Search Engineer
jobs.description: ***DEPLOY has been retained by a leading industrial parts distributor for an on site role in Birmingham, Alabama. We are looking for an ML S******earch Engineer (Software Engineer III)*** You must be eligible to work in the US without Visa Sponsorship. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We're building intelligent product search that understands intent, learns from behavior, and gets smarter over time. As a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** on the **ML/AI Search team**, you'll design and build both the frontend and backend systems that power product discovery for millions of industrial buyers—from scalable retrieval pipelines, APIs, and Frontend interfaces that make AI accessible. This isn't a research role. You'll own the full lifecycle: prototyping ideas, shipping production\-grade services on GCP, and iterating based on real user data. Strong Python and React engineering is the foundation—if you also bring experience in search systems, vector databases, or Elasticsearch, you'll hit the ground running from day one. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Build \& Ship Search and AI\-Powered Systems** * Design, develop, and deploy production Python services end\-to\-end—from retrieval and ranking pipelines through client\-facing APIs. * Build and integrate ML inference pipelines: embedding models, transformer\-based classifiers, LLM\-powered query understanding, and reranking services. * Develop event\-driven, real\-time architectures using GCP services—Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GKE, Cloud Functions. * Write clean, well\-tested, observable Python backends; own your services through deployment, monitoring, and on\-call * Drive frontend architecture decisions, establishing development standards, and creating reusable component libraries. **Contribute to Search Infrastructure** * Work alongside the Search Architect and ML Architect to implement hybrid retrieval systems combining keyword search, dense vector similarity, and reranking. * Build and maintain Elasticsearch indexing pipelines, query services, and relevance tuning tooling. * Integrate vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or similar) into retrieval workflows—even if this is new territory, you'll learn fast. * Instrument search pipelines with meaningful metrics: CTR, zero\-result rate, latency—feeding the team's A/B experimentation loop. * Build clean, responsive, and production\-ready interfaces from wireframes or Figma designs. **Own the Engineering Bar** * Champion CI/CD, observability, testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code as non\-negotiables, not afterthoughts. * Lead design sessions with Engineers and Architects; translate product requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions. * Participate in code reviews and knowledge\-sharing—actively raising the team's collective skill level. **WHAT YOU BRING** **Must\-Haves** * **Strong Python and React foundation:** 6\+ years of professional backend or full\-stack engineering experience with a deep Python/React (e.g., Next.js, Vite.js, Remix.js, Gatsby.js) focus—async patterns, type annotations, testing, and production\-grade service/component design. * **Cloud\-native experience:** Proven experience designing and deploying cloud\-native applications ( GCP strongly preferred; AWS or Azure considered). * Hands\-on experience building resilient high throughput microservices and RESTful/gRPC APIs. * Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and serverless paradigms. * Strong grounding in SOLID design principles and software craftsmanship. * Good communicator who thrives in cross\-functional, agile teams alongside ML engineers, architects, and product owners. * Comfort using AI tools to accelerate development throughput. * Strong experience of using and managing Monorepos * Strong understanding of relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and non\-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB). * **Mentorship:** Provide guidance and technical knowledge sharing to mid\-level and junior developers. **Strongly Preferred — Search \& ML** *You don't need all of these on day one—but the more you bring, the faster you'll contribute:* * **Search systems:** Experience with search platforms: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or Algolia—index management, query DSL, relevance tuning. * **Vector search:** Familiarity with vector search concepts and tooling: embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor (ANN), FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar. * Exposure to ML/AI patterns: RAG pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, or fine\-tuning workflows. * Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Google ADK. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, OpenTofu) and mature CI/CD pipeline ownership. **WHO YOU ARE** **Fearless Builder** A working proof\-of\-concept beats a thousand slide decks. Speed and quality are both non\-negotiable. **Relentless Learner** You pick up new technologies fast and have a genuine eagerness to master whatever comes next. **Architecture\-Minded** You design scalable, fault\-tolerant services as second nature and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. **Ownership\-Driven** Code isn't done until it's tested, documented, and monitored. Your name on a release means something. **Search\-Curious** You may not have built a search system yet—but you're excited by the challenge and ready to go deep. **Team Multiplier** You give and welcome candid feedback and actively make the people around you better.

We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non\-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it's not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. **DRW** is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus. We are looking for talented programmers eager to develop new technologies that directly impact our business. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, test, and maintain data\-intensive desktop applications and reusable libraries using C\# and modern .NET * Develop and maintain systems to ensure application performance, integrity and reliability for maintaining maximal up\-time, and logging and traceability to aid in the support of mission\-critical production systems * Profile and improve rendering, memory usage, concurrency, reactive data pipelines, and application startup performance * Collaborate with quantitative researchers, traders, and other developers * Own software through its full lifecycle, including design, implementation, automated testing, instrumentation, deployment, staged rollout, and production support * Leverage AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and evolve the team's engineering practices. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's in Computer Science or related discipline or relevant work experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial experience building C\#/.NET desktop applications * A thorough understanding of C\# UI development and tooling * Should be comfortable in a fast\-paced environment that continually embraces the latest technologies and techniques. * Effective communication skills, ability to read and write high and mid\-level architecture documentation * Awareness of emerging technologies/standards The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000 depending on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. jobs.title: Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE - Digital Native Business
jobs.description: **CSQ427R137** **Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE \- Digital Native Business** ============================================================= **About the Team** ------------------ The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C\-suite\-sponsored, high\-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering *outcomes*, not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production\-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." **Role Description** -------------------- As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi\-million\-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C\-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands\-on delivery mindset. **The impact you will have** ---------------------------- * **C\-Suite Scoping \& Value Definition:** Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M\+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands\-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. * **Technical Solution Leadership** **\& Delivery:** Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C\-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure\-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. * **Solution Launch \& Landing:** Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. * **Strategic Handoff \& Growth:** Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high\-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. **What we look for** -------------------- * **Executive Presence \& Communication:** You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. * **Product Judgment \& Delivery:** You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. * **Technical Fluency \& Architecture Judgment:** You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and pressure\-test technical decisions. * **Hands\-on Technical Ability:** You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. * **Relevant Experience:** Typically 7\+ years of experience delivering complex, customer\-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high\-growth technology company, forward\-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25\-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery. **Pay Range Transparency** Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. Zone 1 Pay Range $219,765—$302,220 USD **About Databricks** Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. **Benefits** At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** **If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

jobs.title: Senior Design Manager - Design Systems
jobs.description: The way products get built is changing. Agents write a growing share of shipped interfaces, designers work in code, and a design system's output is bigger than a component library. At Datadog we're redefining ours for that world, and evolving how the product looks and feels at the same time. DRUIDS is the design system behind every Datadog surface, used daily by more than a hundred designers and thousands of engineers across thirty\-plus products. You'll lead the team that owns it: designers and design engineers who set the system's direction, hold the quality bar for what ships, and build the tools that make designing in code the default way to work. The team partners closely with product designers, frontend engineers and PMs across the company. This is a hands\-on leadership role in a technical, engineering\-forward company. You'll be expected to have a point of view and defend it, to be the person the design org asks about quality, and to make the call when work isn't good enough yet. Much of what a design system should be right now hasn't been settled — here or anywhere else. If you're a designer who never stopped making things, and you'd rather decide what a system should be than maintain one that already exists, this is the role. *At Datadog, we place value in our office culture \- the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work\-life harmony that best fits them.* ### **What You'll Do** **Lead the team and set its direction** * Decide what DRUIDS owns, what it ships, and what stays with product teams. * Own where the system goes next. Have a view on what a design system should be, and argue for it. * Turn direction into a roadmap, and work with partners on what gets built and when. * Coach the designers and design engineers on your team, be clear about what each person owns, and hire as the team grows. **Own craft and quality** * Own the craft and quality of components, patterns, and principles. * Decide what's good enough to go into DRUIDS. * Raise the quality of the product through the system, and through the way design gets made here. * Say when work isn't good enough. **Own the tooling the system runs on** * Own the tooling that makes the system usable, and the workflows people use to build with it. * Work out how design quality gets evaluated, by people and by agents, and where that belongs in how software gets shipped. * Decide what the system ships beyond components, and which formats and surfaces it needs to reach. **Stay close to product design** * Keep a pulse on what's getting built and where teams are struggling. * Define how the system shows up for product teams — the touchpoints, relationships and working models needed to support them. * Make the system something teams want to use. ### **Who You Are** * You have 8\+ years in product design, 3\+ of them managing. * You've managed a design system team and grown it. * You read and write front\-end code, and can have conversations about it. * You design, have opinions and a point of view. * You are a clear communicator. * Your feedback improves quality and direction. * You can build relationships with fellow leaders and influence them * You've developed reports, and you've handled people who weren't performing. * You want to work in an engineering\-forward company. ### **About Datadog** *Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.* ### **Benefits and Growth:** * New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) * Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing * Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in\-house networking * An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups) * Access to Inclusion Talks, our internal panel discussions * Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6\+ * Competitive global benefits *Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.* \#LI\-HYBRID **About Datadog:** Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high\-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about \#DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. **Equal Opportunity at Datadog:** Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. **Privacy and AI Guidelines:** Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. jobs.title: Staff Researcher, Video Coding Engineer
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Social Impact \& Sustainability Job ID 41670 Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits. For this high functioning team, the nature of the work benefits from frequent in\-office presence, and employees may be expected to work from a company office up to four days per week. While we remain committed to flexibility, this team’s rhythm includes regular in\-person connection to support collaboration, learning, and impact. The **Legal** Department provides core legal support to all Dolby functions, runs several IP\-centric businesses, and leads government relations. You will bring your experience in video coding and processing technology development to Dolby’s video codec R\&D team. You will research and develop cutting edge technologies that will power the next generations of state\-of\-the\-art video compression and processing. As a prerequisite for your work, you have expert knowledge of video coding standards (e.g., AVC, HEVC, and VVC) and strong understanding of deep learning in the context of image and video processing. Your solid understanding of trade\-offs between computational complexity and picture quality will guide you in decisions. You will research and develop new algorithms to improve video coding systems, develop proof\-of\-concept prototypes, and evaluate end\-to\-end system performance. You must have expert knowledge of the principles, algorithms, and techniques in video and image processing, or machine learning, or computer vision technology. You should have excellent software design, problem solving, and debugging skills. You will join a highly skilled and motivated team to research and develop advanced video processing technologies to improve the quality, efficiency, and capabilities of video coding. **Job Functions** * Works with a general understanding of competitive technologies in video compression. * Works to understand the system context in which new technologies will be used and the requirements that the technology must fulfill for success. * Creates early\-stage conceptual models that demonstrate feasibility. * Documents and presents new algorithms and implementations in various forms, including standards contributions, patent applications, conference and journal publications, presentations, and technical white papers at various venues (JVET/MPEG meetings, IEEE conferences, etc.). * Represent company technology interests in industry associations or international standards bodies based on guidance from senior technical staff or management. * Maintain the highest technical and moral integrity for Dolby in the workplace and marketplace. **Skills, Education, and Experience Required** * Master or Ph.D. degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science, or related engineering disciplines required. * Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in developing algorithms for video compression or learning\-based visual computing. * Solid research background in video or image coding and processing. * Extensive programming experience in python/C/C\+\+ applied to image/video coding/processing and experience with one or more deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow and PyTorch) is required. * Track record of successful research accomplishments, published papers, and/or patent applications in the field of video coding and processing. * Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Strong team player who also works effectively and independently. * Ability to travel internationally 3\-4 times per year for MPEG/JVET standards meetings. * Ability to travel to Sunnyvale, CA for business meetings 6\-8 weeks per year and to accommodate weekly meetings during Sunnyvale, CA business hours * Ability to work effectively across different time zones and cultures. **Skills and Experience Preferred*** In\-depth knowledge in development, training, testing, and computing platforms for deep learning (DL) and statistical machine learning (ML) preferred. * Experience in filing patents of newly developed technologies preferred. * Prior participation in standardization activities with experience in drafting and defending contributions preferred. The San Francisco/Bay Area base salary range for this full\-time position is $191,000\-$234,200 which can vary if outside this location,plus bonus, benefits,profit\-sharing and equity. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, competencies, experience, market demands, internal parity, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead (SF)
jobs.description: **Why Join Doppel** Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI\-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI\-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat\-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real\-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. **What We're Building** We're building the AI\-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. **What You'll Do** Doppel's Forward Deployed Engineering team owns the onboarding of our biggest enterprise customers as effective and low touch as possible You'll work directly with our largest enterprise customers alongside GTM and Product to understand their onboarding needs, scope and prioritize technical solutions, and build the end\-to\-end systems that get customers integrated with Doppel’s core offerings. You'll lead the technical direction of the whole FDE team while staying hands\-on with our hardest integrations and most strategic deployments. As Doppel's customer base and product portfolio expand, you'll help turn what we learn in the field into reusable capabilities that make every future deployment faster and easier. * **Lead FDE technically.** Set technical direction, mentor engineers, unblock complex projects, and raise the engineering bar while remaining hands\-on. * **Own our most strategic deployments.** Join customers from technical discovery through production rollout, identifying onboarding friction, scoping solutions, and driving the engineering work required to get them live. * **Build end\-to\-end solutions.** Architect, build, and debug across APIs, webhooks, SIEM/SOAR platforms, identity systems, email infrastructure, and the broader enterprise security stack. * **Turn field work into product.** Identify patterns across customer deployments and turn bespoke solutions into reusable product and platform capabilities. * **Make deployment increasingly scalable.** Build the systems, automation, and internal tooling that make every new customer faster and easier to launch than the last. * **Shape the product from the field.** Create a tight feedback loop between customers, GTM, Product, and Engineering so what we're learning from our largest customers influences what we build. * **Help shape FDE's technical boundaries.** Develop strong judgment around what FDE should build, what should graduate into core product or platform, and where FDE should partner with other engineering teams. **What we’re looking for** * **Strong software engineering foundation.** 6\+ years building and shipping production software, with the technical depth to make architecture decisions and contribute directly to the codebase. * **Technical leadership experience.** You've set technical direction, mentored engineers, and driven complex projects while remaining hands\-on. * **Customer\-facing technical depth.** You've worked directly with complex enterprise customers, can uncover technical needs, and can turn ambiguous problems into scoped production systems. * **Experience with enterprise systems.** You're comfortable working across APIs, webhooks, identity and authentication (OAuth, SAML, SCIM), and enterprise infrastructure. Experience with security platforms or SIEM/SOAR ecosystems is a plus. * **Product instincts.** You recognize patterns across customer needs and know when something should remain customer\-specific versus becoming a reusable product or platform capability. * **High agency in ambiguity.** You cut through organizational and technical blockers to get things done. You figure out who to pull in across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering, chase down missing context, and create the connections and processes needed to move customer problems from ambiguity to production. * **Strong technical judgment and communication.** You can move comfortably between a customer call, system design, debugging with an engineer, and working with Product on what should be built next. * **AI\-native mindset.** Experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI\-powered workflows is a plus, but we're most interested in engineers who are excited to use AI to change how technical customer work gets done. **Join Doppel** =============== Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real\-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you. Compensation Range: $120K \- $250K

and validation frameworks. * Understanding of metadata management, data lineage, and data governance principles. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent initiatives and business intelligence programs. **So What About the Perks? jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Project Manager or Associate Manager
jobs.description: **Company Description** **The Opportunity:** At Elemental Brands, our success starts with our people. Every day, our engineers, innovators, creators, and problem\-solvers work together to develop and deliver innovative LED lighting solutions through Diode LED®, Lucetta®, Lucetta CI®, Gammalux®, and Elemental LED®. Together, we're driving innovation and helping define the future of the low\-voltage linear lighting industry. That same spirit of innovation and collaboration shapes everything we do. We encourage curiosity, continuous learning, and fresh ideas across every department, empowering employees to grow their careers, make meaningful contributions, and help shape the future of lighting. Recognized by EDAWN as “Company of the Year – Large” and “Employees First – Large,” and by the University of Nevada, Reno as “Graduate Employer of the Year,” Elemental Brands is proud to be an award\-winning workplace where people come first, innovation thrives, and careers flourish. **Job Description** **What You Get To Do:** We are seeking a highly organized Global Manufacturing Project Manager or Associate Manager to oversee and coordinate complex projects involving offshore production, contract manufacturing partners in Asia, and imported sub\-assemblies. In this role, you will serve as the primary operational and project\-management bridge among overseas manufacturing partners, Asia\-based engineering and supply chain teams, and domestic departments, including Engineering, Quality, OMS, Production, and Distribution. You will drive organizational excellence and manage cross\-time\-zone communication while ensuring all overseas projects meet strict technical specifications, quality standards, regulatory compliance, and delivery schedules. **Challenge Yourself – The Specifics:** * Lead, own, and manage end\-to\-end projects and schedules with contract manufacturers and suppliers in Asia, ensuring clear communication across international time zones and cultural boundaries * Travel domestically and internationally (up to 15%, primarily to Asia) to inspect manufacturing facilities, witness First Article Inspections (FAI), evaluate vendor capabilities, and actively resolve critical production issues on\-site * Partner directly with the Technologies division to manage specialized offshore builds, while coordinating closely with the Sr. Director, Project Management for project hand\-offs, status reporting, and executive reviews * Facilitate activities across multiple departments to include Engineering, APAC, Product, Accounting, Supply Chain, Quality, OMS, and Distribution to ensure alignment between overseas production timelines and domestic delivery schedules * Analyze engineering drawings, BOMs, and customer requirements to troubleshoot manufacturing challenges with suppliers and verify compliance prior to mass production * Establish, standardize, and document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for overseas project hand\-offs, import coordination, and sample approvals to ensure business continuity * Monitor overseas capacity, lead times, and shipping schedules to proactively identify risks, eliminate logistics bottlenecks, and maintain project momentum * Create, track, and present project metrics and quote\-to\-market conversion rates to senior leadership * Exercise professional discretion to prioritize overseas production runs and air/sea freight shipments based on critical customer demand and inventory needs * Conduct structured post\-production reviews and coordinate with Asia\-based QC teams to ensure finished goods meet exact engineering and aesthetic specifications * Assists with special supply chain and global vendor management initiatives as assigned * Performs other project management duties as required **Qualifications** **You Have a Unique Combination of Skills, Talents and Mindset, Including Many of the Following:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Technology, Business Operations, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and direct hands\-on experience * Minimum of 3–5 years of project management or production coordination experience, managing overseas manufacturing, specifically working with suppliers in Asia * Must possess a valid passport and the ability/willingness to travel internationally to Asia and other sites as required, expect to travel 15% annually * Global Operations Knowledge: Familiarity with international manufacturing practices, quality control standards (e.g., FAI, CPT, AQL), shipping, and cross\-cultural business communication * Software Proficiency: Experience with ERP/MRP platforms (e.g., IFS, Trello, Smart Sheets), CAD/architectural software (e.g., Bluebeam), CPQ tools (e.g., Configure One), and Google Workspace (Docs/Sheets), Microsoft Suite * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; exceptional organizational and multi\-tasking abilities under tight production deadlines **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. **The Perks and Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Vision, Life/AD\&D, Short Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance (100% PAID by employer), available first of the month, following the date of hire * Company\-matched 401(k) Plan, at 5%, no vesting schedule * Discretionary Time Off (DTO) * Parental Leave (PL) * Sick Time Off (STO) * Seven Paid Holidays * Pre\-Tax Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) \- $200 annual employer contribution * Career Development Plan Program * Discounted Corporate Gym Membership at South Reno Athletic Club * Tuition Assistance * Monthly Birthday Lunch Celebrations * Employee Discount * On\-site Snacks and Beverages * Employee Referral Bonus Program **About Us:** Visit us at www.elementalbrands.com or call 877\-564\-5051\.

jobs.title: Database Software Developer
jobs.description: **Request For Proposal:** **Environmental Data Management Platform** Ensolum LLC is seeking an experienced senior full\-stack developer or small development team to help design and build an Environmental Data Management Platform for environmental consulting operations. Project Overview: The platform will provide consultants with an organized view of projects to which they have been granted access, along with associated field activities, laboratory results, regulatory criteria, deadlines and deliverables required by regulatory agencies. It will initially focus on oil spill response workflows while establishing a flexible foundation that can support additional environmental services over time. Data will be organized hierarchically around clients, with each client containing one or more sub clients, each sub client containing a collection of projects and each project requiring one or many environmental services that occur at one or more sites. Each project will store associated field activities, laboratory results, and project deliverables, including reports, tables, photologs and GIS figures. This structure will provide a consistent way to organize environmental data and project work while maintaining clear relationships between the client, project, service(s), sites, and relevant project documents. The platform must ingest Electronic Data Deliverable (EDD) data received from a variety of laboratory sources, transform the data into a standardized format and load it into a custom, project specific template. Templates will provide functionality to compare analytical results against applicable regulatory criteria and flag potential exceedances for review. Pending approval and lab QC validation, the table, or updates to the table will be added as a project deliverable. The platform must provide standard data tables and customizable data tables and completed deliverables must be exportable as CSV and XLSX. The platform must be able to integrate directly with ArcGIS to obtain coordinates and associated metadata for point, line, and polygon features collected through Field Maps. This integration will enable laboratory sample data to be spatially associated with corresponding field locations, providing a unified view of sample results, field activities, and spatial information within the project. The successful candidate or team will be responsible for both the underlying platform and the user experience. The application must be intuitive for environmental consultants who work with complex data but may not be technical users. **Key Responsibilities** **Product and UI/UX** * Design clear, efficient workflows for project setup, field data, EDD review, approvals, reporting, and GIS access * Develop responsive, accessible, and consistent user interfaces * Create dashboards, data tables, filters, search, maps, review queues, forms, and approval screens * Make data\-quality errors and regulatory exceedances easy to understand and resolve * Incorporate user feedback from the internal team and pilot clients **Full\-Stack Development** * Design and implement the frontend application and backend services * Build the EDD upload, parsing, transformation, validation, and approval workflow * Implement configurable QA/QC and regulatory rules * Design database relationships among clients, projects, sites, samples, documents, and deliverables * Integrate with ArcGIS for spatial data, coordinates, features, and sample relationships * Support CSV, XLSX, PDF, image, and other project\-related files * Implement role\-based access, tenant isolation, audit trails, versioning, and approvals * Develop report and deliverable\-generation features * Develop a custom data analytics system for sorting and viewing data to look for trends in projects, locations and over time * Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and future enhancements **Preferred Experience** * Strong full\-stack web application development experience * Excellent frontend skills and demonstrated UI/UX judgment * Experience building data\-heavy business applications * PostgreSQL database design and optimization * PostGIS or other spatial\-data experience * API design and third\-party integrations * Workflow, approval, and data\-validation systems * GIS or ArcGIS integration * Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and access control * Cloud deployment, testing, version control, and security practices · Experience with environmental, laboratory, regulatory, engineering, or GIS applications is highly desirable. **Engagement Details** * **Role:** Senior Full\-Stack Developer / Product Engineer * **Engagement:** Contract * **Start date:** November 2026 Applicants should provide: * A brief description of relevant experience * Frontend and UI/UX work samples * Relevant backend, database, or integration experience * Experience with GIS, laboratory, regulatory, or workflow systems * Recommended technology stack * Availability and expected engagement terms * Cost and time estimates Job Type: Contract Pay: From $1\.00 per year Work Location: Remote
