jobs.title: Product Engineer (Full stack), Shared Services Platform - Miami
jobs.description: **Location:** Miami (in\-office 4 days per week) **Team:** Engineering **Reports to:** Head of Engineering **About Extenteam** Extenteam is the AI\-driven operations platform for short\-term rental property management, headquartered in Miami and founded in 2021\. Our platform, Shared Services, handles guest communication and daily operational workflows for 80,000\+ properties by pairing an AI orchestration layer with a shared\-services team of hospitality\-trained specialists, so no guest inquiry goes unanswered, day or night, and no property manager has to staff for the 2am cancellation themselves. We're industry\-only: every workflow, integration, and agent we hire is built around property management specifically, not bolted on from a generalist platform. As we push more of that platform toward AI\-led automation and self\-serve tools, the software our own Shared Services team works in every day has to keep pace, that's this role. **Why This Role Exists** Shared Services' guest communication runs on two things: an AI layer that handles as much of a conversation as it safely can, and a shared\-services team of hospitality\-trained agents who catch what the AI shouldn't touch alone. Every day, that team hits walls in the platform they use to do the work; bugs, missing tooling, workflows that don't match how a busy overnight shift actually runs. Some of that is a quick fix. Some of it is a signal that the platform is failing at scale, and by the time it reaches Engineering it's already cost real client trust. We don't have a layer of PMs pre\-chewing every one of those signals into a spec. We're hiring an engineer who can sit close to Operations, tell the difference between a one\-off bug and a systemic gap, and ship the fix with no handoff required. **The Role** You'll report to the Head of Engineering. Priorities are set jointly with the Head of Operations, who owns the operational signal driving what gets built. You'll do two things: * **Close incoming platform tickets from Shared Services.** Agents, Team Leads, and Operations report issues daily; quick fixes, workflow bugs, configuration problems. You triage, diagnose, and ship. * **Find the pattern and fix it at the source.** When multiple agents report the same friction, that's not a ticket, it's a product problem. When a client complaint traces back to repeated agent failures, you ask why the platform is allowing it, and you close that gap for good. Every ship goes through the same process as any other engineer's here: product filters for coherence, design filters for UX consistency, standard code review. This role works inside those guardrails, not around them. **What You Will Do** * Own features end to end; problem framing, design, backend, frontend, instrumentation, rollout, and the follow\-up fixes nobody filed a ticket for. * Work with founders, product, and design at the whiteboard stage, before anything is written down, and help decide what's worth building. * Build the AI surfaces of the product; prompt and agent architecture, tool calling, retrieval, guardrails, and the human\-in\-the\-loop escape hatches that make automation safe to ship. * Build and maintain evals. Treat "does this actually work" as an engineering artifact with a regression suite, not a vibe check before launch. * Watch real usage. Session replays, logs, transcripts, support tickets, and customer calls. Bring back what you learn as shipped changes, not as a document. * Own the details that make software feel good; latency budgets, token cost, empty states, error copy, loading behavior, keyboard paths. These are part of the feature, not a separate polish phase. * Cut scope and kill things. Argue a feature is wrong before you build it well. * Compound the team's velocity; CI, preview environments, internal tools, seed data, debugging surfaces. Leverage counts as product work. **What This Role Is Not** * **Not a ticket queue firefighter.** That's other roles on the Operations side. * **Not a shadow engineering team.** You report to and work within Engineering. * **Not an independent operator building outside the platform.** Everything you ship goes through product. **Anti\-Signals** * You want a ticket fully spec'd before you'll touch it * You treat "why does this keep happening" as someone else's question to answer * You measure your work by whether you closed the ticket, not whether the pattern stopped * Your AI/LLM experience is prompting a demo — never held to a reliability bar with a real agent depending on it at 2am **Required Experience** * 4\+ years of **full stack** (stronger on the BE) software engineering experience shipping production enterprise software * Direct experience building internal tools, agent\-facing platforms, or operational systems * Product mindset: comfortable scoping problems, asking the right questions, and communicating/prioritizing tradeoffs * Track record of shipping fast while working inside a product and design process * Experience working asynchronously with distributed teams **Required Technical Skills** * Strong fluency in TypeScript. We currently use: + Next JS + NestJS + TypeORM with Postgres + BullMQ * Comfortable with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Replit Agent) * API integration experience (REST, webhooks, third\-party SaaS APIs) * Prompt engineering experience with production AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) **Strongly Preferred** * Experience building tools for contact center, customer support, or operations teams * Short\-term rental, hospitality, or property management domain knowledge * Track record of deploying AI agents in production **How You'll Work** * Reports to the Head of Engineering * Priorities set jointly with the Head of Operations, based on operational signal * Product decisions filter through the Head of Product * Design decisions go through our design team * Weekly syncs with Engineering, Operations, and Product * Miami\-based, in\-office 4 days per week

You should be a detail\-oriented problem\-solver who is comfortable working both independently on routine tasks and collaboratively with senior engineers on more complex challenges.### **Key Responsibilities** * Apply standard engineering techniques and practices to perform sequences of related technical tasks * Conduct routine analyses and testing, preparing summaries and reports for review by senior staff * Participate in field activities, including site visits and construction inspections * Maintain accurate documentation and data logs from job sites and client locations * Analyze laboratory data and compose detailed reports that summarize findings * Perform calculations, develop input for plans and specifications, and compile historical records * Present technical information clearly in one\-on\-one and small group settings * Refer complex or non\-routine technical issues to more experienced staff for guidance and resolution * Participate in studies, analyses, and data collection under senior supervision to build broader experience ### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or environmental engineering * Basic proficiency with Computer Aided Design (CAD) software or introductory\-level experience * Strong reasoning and analytical ability * Ability to write clear, professional reports and correspondence * Effective communication and presentation skills, especially in technical settings * EIT (Engineer\-In\-Training) certification or active pursuit of the credential * Hands\-on experience with Civil 3D (AutoCAD) or similar design software * Familiarity with water resources analysis and modeling * Experience in field\-based engineering work or site inspections This is a **hybrid role**, offering the best of both worlds—collaborate in\-office with a high\-performing team and enjoy the flexibility of working remotely part of the week. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (FES)
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Every time a fan places a bet, earns a reward, or checks out on Fanatics — Fanatics Core made that possible. We build the shared foundations — identity, payments, loyalty, wallet, data, and platform — that power sports betting, ecommerce, collectibles, and beyond. We supercharge the business by providing products and capabilities so that teams can focus on what matters most: building delightful experiences for the fans. Fanatics is uniquely positioned at the intersection of sports commerce, betting, and collectibles, and Fanatics ONE is the loyalty and identity program that ties it all together. **Overview** As a Senior Software Engineer at Fanatics, you will design, build, and operate the platforms and services that power the Fan Ecosystem — the systems that connect fans to every Fanatics product and experience. You will own significant technical surface area end to end, set the technical direction for projects that span multiple services and teams, and raise the engineering bar for those around you through mentorship, design leadership, and hands\-on delivery. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role with a backend center of gravity. The majority of your work will be building high\-throughput, high\-availability services in Go, with meaningful contributions to the TypeScript/React front ends those services support. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, document, and operate high\-quality, production\-grade software with a focus on Go services and APIs * Own the technical design of medium\-to\-large features and systems: define the approach, weigh trade\-offs, document decisions, and drive them to completion * Break down ambiguous problems into well\-scoped, deliverable work for yourself and other engineers on the team * Lead and participate in design and architecture reviews; provide clear, constructive feedback that improves both the design and the designer * Set the standard in code reviews — for correctness, readability, testability, and operational safety * Mentor and grow engineers on the team; onboard new hires and act as a technical point of contact for your systems * Participate in and improve the on\-call rotation: instrument your services, drive incident response, and lead blameless postmortems that result in real fixes * Improve reliability, performance, and cost of the systems you own; define and act on SLOs and operational excellence metrics * Identify and pay down technical debt, and make the case for the investments worth making * Partner closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape the roadmap and make technology decisions that grow the business * Influence and help define the principles, guidelines, and best practices of our engineering strategy — then hold the team to them * Develop deep understanding of our industry, product, feature set, and roadmap, and use it to make better technical decisions **Required Qualifications** * **5\+ years** of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems * **Strong, demonstrated proficiency in Go (Golang) — required.** You have built and shipped production services in Go and can speak to concurrency patterns, error handling, testing, profiling, and performance tuning in the language * Proven experience designing, building, and scaling backend services and APIs (REST and/or gRPC) in a distributed, microservices environment * Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, and experience with React or another modern front\-end framework * Solid grounding in data stores and messaging: relational and/or NoSQL databases, caching, and event streaming (e.g. Kafka, SQS/SNS) * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code * Strong operational instincts: observability, monitoring, alerting, debugging production issues under pressure * Track record of leading projects with multiple contributors and delivering them on time without sacrificing quality * Familiar with Agile software product delivery and SCRUM methodology * Able to effectively work cross\-functionally within an enterprise environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building or integrating with identity and access management systems — authentication, authorization, SSO, and account lifecycle * Hands\-on familiarity with identity standards and protocols: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, MFA, session and token lifecycle management * Experience with identity providers and CIAM platforms (e.g. Okta, Auth0, ForgeRock, AWS Cognito, Ping) or with building an in\-house identity platform * Experience with account security, fraud prevention, PII handling, or regulatory/compliance\-driven engineering (KYC, GDPR, CCPA) * Experience designing systems that serve high\-traffic, consumer\-facing products with spiky, event\-driven load * Experience with platform or shared\-services work where your consumers are other engineering teams * Experience working in a start\-up environment * Experience in sports, commerce, media, or another consumer\-scale domain *If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-KR1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. Sitting at the critical intersection of digital signal processing (DSP), hardware\-software co\-design, and real\-time systems, you will lead the development of adaptive algorithms, error correction (FEC), and link\-telemetry frameworks. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Robotics Software Lead - Construction
jobs.description: *Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.* Robotics Software Lead \- Construction**Job Description:** ==================== The Robotics Software Lead is responsible for setting the technical direction for HITT’s robotics software team and leading the development of systems designed for complex, dynamic, and unstructured construction jobsites. This role guides initiatives across the full development lifecycle, from proof\-of\-concept prototypes through scaled field deployment. As a hands\-on, product\-minded engineering leader, the Robotics Software Lead owns the software stack, manages and mentors engineers, coordinates strategic co\-development partnerships, supports the robotics R\&D development roadmap, and establishes the architecture, infrastructure, and engineering practices that empower the team to experiment quickly and scale successful solutions. This team member reports to the Robotics Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full\-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite. The ideal candidate has led software teams that have developed and deployed complex robotics systems in demanding real\-world environments. They are equally comfortable moving quickly to validate an early concept while applying the engineering discipline required to mature a prototype into a reliable, safe, and maintainable field system. They combine systems\-level field robotics expertise with a product mindset, clear project leadership, and a practical understanding of the tradeoffs and dependencies among software, sensors, compute, networking, controls, mechanical hardware, and field operations. This role offers the opportunity to define a foundational software platform, grow a high\-performing engineering team, and directly influence how HITT develops and deploys robotics in the field. We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed. RESPONSIBILITIES Technical Leadership * Own the architecture and technical direction of the robotics software stack, including system interfaces, design standards, and technical review practices. * Own the software infrastructure that supports development, simulation, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, deployment, observability, data collection, and fleet support. * Guide technical decisions across autonomy, perception, manipulation, operator interfaces, embedded compute, networking, simulation, and cloud\-connected services. * Lead efforts to integrate and extend third\-party technologies via APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces. * Ensure software designs account for safety, cybersecurity, maintainability, degraded operating modes, and the environmental constraints of active construction sites. * Establish standards for AI\-assisted and agentic software development, including human review, automated testing, evaluation, and appropriate technical guardrails. * Remain a hands\-on technical contributor including architecture reviews, code reviews, prototyping, system integration, and diagnosis of difficult cross\-stack issues. * Travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing, deployment, and operational support. Team Leadership and Delivery * Lead, manage, and mentor a team of software engineers, setting clear expectations and supporting their technical and professional development. * Coordinate day\-to\-day R\&D work by translating priorities into actionable plans, assigning ownership, tracking dependencies, and resolving blockers. * Establish engineering plans, milestones, release criteria, and quality expectations for multiple concurrent robotics initiatives. * Use product management practices to translate user needs, field observations, and business priorities into requirements, backlogs, experiments, and release plans. * Promote disciplined software engineering practices, including documentation, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and reproducible development environments. * Support team growth through thoughtful staffing, onboarding, feedback, and knowledge sharing. Partnerships and Cross\-Functional Coordination * Lead the technical delivery of co\-development initiatives with technology partners and vendors, including defining scope, interfaces, milestones, risks, acceptance criteria, and ownership. * Evaluate third\-party technologies and recommend when HITT should build, buy, adapt, or partner based on technical fit, lifecycle cost, schedule, risk, and supportability. * Coordinate software priorities and integ oting, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and improvements to monitoring and support processes. * Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor’s degree in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field, advanced degree preferred. * 5\+ years of experience in robotics software development, including demonstrated experience leading software engineering teams that developed and deployed complex field robotics applications in real\-world environments. * Experience applying product management practices to define requirements, prioritize roadmaps and backlogs, plan releases, and incorporate end\-user feedback. * Proficiency in C\+\+, Python, and Linux\-based robotics development and system\-level troubleshooting. * Experience applying modern software\-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker). * Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open\-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution. * Fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor). * Experience leading external partners or vendors through co\-development, integration, technical project management, and acceptance testing. * Ability to communicate complex technical topics, decisions, risks, and plans clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real\-world environments. * Experience with mobile robot autonomy, perception, SLAM, navigation, manipulation, motion planning, controls, or teleoperation. * Experience developing low\-latency teleoperation systems that integrate real\-time video, command, and telemetry streams, including graceful degradation amid intermittent connectivity. * Experience integrating cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, IMUs, actuators, embedded computers, GPU\-accelerated perception, and other robotic sensing and control hardware. * Experience using robotics simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unity) to train, test, and validate robotic systems using Real\-to\-Sim and Sim\-to\-Real pipelines. * Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2\) and comparable robotics middleware. * Experience developing cloud\-connected robotics software (e.g., Azure, Azure DevOps, AWS), web\-based operator interfaces (e.g., React, JavaScript/TypeScript), and real\-time video\-streaming pipelines (e.g., GStreamer). In accordance with Virginia Senate Bill 215 (SB 215\), the base salary range for this position is: $120,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 Compensation in other cities and states may vary. HITT Contracting offers a competitive total benefits and compensation package including performance\-based bonuses, premium health care coverage including vision and dental, employer\-matched 401(k), wellness reimbursement program, paid holidays and time\-off, and other voluntary benefits and leave types. The determination of salary is based on the candidate’s individual professional experience, qualifications, education, skills, and training. ***HITT Contracting is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to hiring and developing the most qualified individuals based on job\-related experience, skills, and merit. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We value a respectful, inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. HITT Contracting maintains a drug\-free workplace, consistent with applicable local, state, and federal laws.***

jobs.title: Project Manager - Traffic
jobs.description: **What We're Looking For** HNTB is seeking a dynamic and entrepreneurial traffic engineering leader who is eager to help build a growing team across Northern New England while leading impactful transportation projects throughout the region. In the near term, you'll lead a diverse portfolio of traffic engineering projects from our South Portland, ME, or Bedford, NH, offices. Working with clients such as MaineDOT, NHDOT, VTrans, and HNTB's oldest client, the Maine Turnpike Authority, you'll help deliver a wide range of services, from planning and traffic studies to traffic signal and ITS engineering, microsimulation, and real\-time operational strategies. In this role, you'll manage projects through their full lifecycle, from shaping proposals and negotiating contracts to delivering on HNTB's 4\-for\-4 performance promise: quality work, on time, on budget, and to the client's satisfaction. You'll collaborate with internal and external partners, solve complex transportation challenges, and ensure successful outcomes on projects that make a lasting impact. This role places you at the forefront of innovation, helping guide teams and clients toward smarter, safer, and more connected mobility solutions. Beyond project delivery, you'll also play a key role in strengthening client relationships, recruiting and developing talent, expanding our market presence, and helping define the future of traffic engineering services across Maine, New Hampshire, and Vermont. As part of a nationally recognized transportation practice, you'll collaborate with regional and national leaders to deliver innovative solutions while helping grow HNTB's presence throughout Northern New England. With more than a century of experience delivering some of the nation's most complex transportation infrastructure projects, HNTB offers the unique opportunity to combine the impact of building a growing regional practice with the resources, expertise, and stability of an established employee\-owned firm.**What You'll Do:** * Responsible for development of the project scope and fee quotation and assists in the preparation of technical proposals and contracts in accordance with HNTB's Sophisticated Contracting Approach (SCA). * Serves as the primary client liaison and manages the project team to deliver the scope, schedule, and budgets to completion and to the client’s satisfaction. Assists with client project scoping and contract negotiations. * Performs technical discipline tasks including analysis, reports, design, specification, and production for assigned projects. * Implements the firm’s project delivery plan using HNTB's Sophisticated Delivery Approach (SDA) on each project. Leads the development and the execution of the project management plan. Supervises and mentors team to overall project objectives. * Performs coordination with managers on project staffing, including, but not limited to; recruitment, development, retention, and succession of project staff; development of plan for project staff reporting; and support for performance and compensation reviews. * Partners with Client Service Leaders and pursuit champions to assist with business development, building client relationships, and pursuit efforts for strategic and mini\-mega projects in accordance with HNTB's Sophisticated Sales Approach (SSA). Works with the project team and marketing resources to prepare appropriate proposal and presentation materials. Leads proposal development and interview presentations for strategic and mini\-mega projects to the client as well as general presentations within the industry and community. * May be responsible for the recruitment, hiring, development, and retention of staff, including development of plan for staff reporting, performance and compensation reviews, and succession. * Performs other duties as assigned. **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and 8 years of relevant experience * 2 years task management or Deputy PM experience ### **What You’ll Bring** * A passion for leading teams and shaping project success: you’re excited to help build something extraordinary. * Strong organizational skills to keep projects on track and deliver on HNTB’s 4\-for\-4 promise: quality work, on time, on budget, and with client satisfaction. * Ability to identify risks and adapt quickly, ensuring smooth project execution. * Confidence in client communication: you enjoy building relationships and delivering solutions that exceed expectations. * A collaborative mindset: you are ready to guide and mentor team members while contributing your own technical expertise. * Enthusiasm for innovation and continuous improvement, bringing fresh ideas to every challenge. ### **What We Prefer** * Experience managing transportation projects from planning through delivery. * Knowledge of traffic engineering and planning principles, including signal design, ITS, and traffic modeling. * Familiarity with project management tools and processes to monitor budgets, schedules, and deliverables. * A proven ability to lead and inspire collaboration across disciplines. * Professional Engineer (PE) license and PTOE is a plus—but what matters most is your drive to lead and deliver.**What You'll Bring:** * Winning, contracting, and successfully delivering 4for4 (on\-time, on\-budget, quality, client satisfaction) on smaller projects. Identifying and escalating risk and change management issues, with oversight from more experienced staff. * Leading a team for a smaller project or task order with no or few subconsultants. * Using system tools to manage, monitor, and deliver smaller projects or task orders. * Leveraging the Office Management Team to assist in implementing HNTB Sophisticated processes as applicable to the project. * Interfacing with your client\-level peer on a smaller project or task order. * Providing technical guidance to team and task leads as well as performing portions of the technical work. **Additional Information** Click here for benefits information: HNTB Total Rewards Click here to learn more about Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veteran Visa sponsorship is available for this position. \#RV \#Traffic . Locations: Bedford, NH, Burlington, VT, South Portland, ME (Portland) . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . The approximate pay range for Vermont is $126,950\.84 \- $198,564\.14\. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position based on all selected locations within the state at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on factors, including but not limited to, the individual’s qualifications, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as physical work location within the state. . The approximate pay range for Maine is $126,950\.84 \- $198,564\.14\. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position based on all selected locations within the state at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on factors, including but not limited to, the individual’s qualifications, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as physical work location within the state. . . *NOTICE TO THIRD\-PARTY AGENCIES:* *HNTB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or agencies. Any staffing/employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume to this site does so with the understanding that the applicant's resume will become the property of HNTB. HNTB will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion and without any fee owed to the submitting staffing/employment agency, person or entity. Staffing/employment agencies who have fee agreements with HNTB must submit applicants to the designated HNTB recruiter to be eligible for placement fees.*

We're looking for a Manager to lead the team responsible for the infrastructure, platform, frameworks, and tools that power data and analytics across the company. This team builds and operates the shared platform that data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers depend on every day, providing the critical foundation for enterprise AI. This is a hands\-on leadership role at an inflection point. The platform has grown organically alongside the business, and we're now ready to be far more intentional about it: fewer, better\-supported capabilities; clearer standards; a simpler operating footprint. You'll lead a team of platform engineers through that evolution, setting technical direction, growing the people on the team, and building the organizational alignment that makes real change stick. If you're energized by taking capable platforms and turning them into a coherent product that other teams love using, this role is for you. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- ### **LEAD AND GROW THE TEAM** * Manage, coach, and develop a team of data platform engineers spanning early\-career through senior levels. * Run a healthy engineering practice: clear priorities and process, diligent code review, sustainable support, and blameless retrospectives that produce continuous improvement. * Own hiring and team design as the platform's scope grows, assessing where you need depth or breadth and making great hires. * Create development paths for your engineers, and establish real ownership of the platform and its components within the team. ### **SET PLATFORM STRATEGY AND DRIVE STANDARDIZATION** * Treat the platform as a product: define what we offer, who it serves, what's supported, and what isn't. * Establish a set of standard, well\-documented platform offerings \- the default path most teams should take \- and drive adoption across data engineering, analytics, and AI. * Assess the current tooling landscape, identify where capabilities overlap or duplicate one another, and build a prioritized plan to consolidate onto a smaller, better\-supported set. * Own the full lifecycle of platform capabilities, including the harder work: deprecating what we no longer want to support and shepherding consumers through migration. * Balance central standards against genuine team\-specific needs, and know when to hold the line versus grant a well\-reasoned exception. ### **OWN THE TARGET\-STATE ARCHITECTURE** * Develop a clear, defensible point of view on where our data platform architecture should land, and build alignment behind it with engineering leadership and partner teams. * Lead the team through significant platform evolution \- consolidating overlapping capabilities, simplifying our cloud footprint, and migrating workloads between environments \- with minimal disruption to the teams that depend on us. * Make and document architectural decisions with explicit reasoning on cost, capability, operational burden, and long\-term maintainability. * Guide the team's infrastructure\-as\-code practice (Terraform) so that platform changes are reviewable, repeatable, and reversible. ### **DRIVE RELIABILITY, PERFORMANCE, AND COST DISCIPLINE** * Own the reliability of the data platform: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the improvements that reduce recurrence. * Establish the operational metrics that matter — availability, pipeline freshness, query performance, cost per workload — and manage the team against them. * Own platform spend. FinOps is important here \- you should understand where the money goes, forecast it credibly, and make deliberate tradeoffs between cost and capability. * Hold a high bar for documentation, runbooks, and operational readiness as a condition of shipping. ### **PARTNER ACROSS THE ORGANIZATION** * Build strong working relationships with data engineering, analytics, BI, AI, and ML teams; understand their workflows well enough to anticipate what they'll need. * Communicate direction, tradeoffs, and timelines clearly to engineers, partner teams, and senior leadership, especially when the answer involves changing how people work today. * Represent the platform's roadmap and constraints in planning conversations, and negotiate scope and sequencing honestly. * Partner with security, IT, and governance functions on access management, data governance, and compliance requirements. **What You'll Bring:** ---------------------- ### **REQUIRED** * 2\+ years managing engineers, plus a strong prior track record as a hands\-on data or infrastructure engineer. You should ing MCP servers or comparable tool\-access layers. * Experience with FinOps practices for data platforms. * Data governance or access management experience at scale in a multi\-region or compliance\-constrained environment. **What Success Looks Like:** ---------------------------- Success in this role looks like an estate you can fully account for; every significant workload, its consumers, its criticality, its cost. Decisions about overlapping capability made on locked criteria and tested evidence rather than preference, with fitness for AI and agentic workloads weighted as seriously as cost and capability parity, in a way that holds up with the people who wanted a different answer. It looks like a documented default path that new work lands on without being told to, exceptions coming through a single front door, and consolidation moving in deliberate waves that leave no dependent team stranded. It looks like an operational floor raised to match: access provisioning, entitlement review, data classification, credential rotation, and audit logging owned and automated rather than held as tribal knowledge, and a documented reference architecture governing how agents and internal services reach platform data: MCP servers and comparable tool\-access layers with named owners, least\-privilege credentials, and structured logging, rather than prototypes without owners. And it looks like a team stronger than the one you inherited: engineers owning more surface area, sustainable on\-call, and platform spend that's understood and forecastable against workload growth. jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description: HawkEye 360 (HE360\) is seeking a Senior Spacecraft Flight Software Engineer to join the Space team in Herndon, Virginia. You will develop flight software that powers our spacecraft and payloads, working directly with flight hardware from driver\-level code through integrated system functionality. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence mission success by architecting, implementing, testing, and optimizing software that flies on\-orbit. Reporting to the Spacecraft Bus Lead, you'll contribute to critical spacecraft systems including on\-board computer flight software (OBC FSW), radio communications, command \& telemetry, and payload operations. This role is ideal for an engineer with proven spacecraft flight software experience who thrives in fast\-paced environments and enjoys solving complex technical problems. **Your main responsibilities will be:** * Design and implement flight software in C/C\+\+ for critical spacecraft functions including radio communications, onboard computer (OBC) systems, telemetry, command handling, payload tasking, and autonomous fault protection. * Develop and integrate low\-level embedded drivers for spacecraft subsystems across RTOS and embedded Linux platforms * Support hardware bring\-up and system integration, debugging interactions between software, processors, FPGAs, sensors, radios, and payload electronics. * Conduct unit testing, integrated software testing, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop verification to ensure reliability before launch. * Build and maintain Python and C/C\+\+ tools for ground support equipment, automated testing workflows, and data processing. * Analyze on\-orbit and ground test data to diagnose issues, validate performance, and drive continuous system improvements. * Optimize software for Low\-SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power) embedded environments, focusing on performance, efficiency, and resource utilization. * Collaborate closely with Systems Engineering, RF, Electrical, AI\&T, and Operations teams to ensure seamless multi\-disciplinary integration. * Participate in rapid development cycles, supporting design reviews, code reviews, and iterative hardware/software testing. **Your skills and qualifications:** **Essential education and experience:** * **3\+** **years** **of** **spacecraft** **flight** **software** **development** **experience** on RTOS or embedded Linux platforms * Strong Proficiency in C, Python, and version control (Git). * Proven ability to solve complex technical problems with high attention to detail and minimal oversight. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional engineering teams. * B.S. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field; or equivalent experience. **Desirable:** * Experience with spacecraft command and telemetry systems, mission operations, or satellite bus architectures * Radio communications systems development, including software\-defined radios or RF payload interfaces * Hands\-on experience with board bring\-up and hardware debugging using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators) * Knowledge of embedded communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, I²C, RS\-422, , or similar * FPGA development experience, particularly with Xilinx Zynq platforms * Linux kernel internals and driver development * Experience with Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+, Zynq\-7000, or similar SoC platforms * Familiarity with bare\-metal microcontrollers or Zephyr RTOS * Understanding of Yocto/OpenEmbedded for ARM\-based embedded Linux systems * Experience with GitLab CI or similar Continuous Integration tools **Company Overview:** HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission\-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space\-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI\-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. jobs.title: Clinical Product Lead
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersGeneral \& AdministrationClinicalClinical **Compensation** ---------------- * Estimated Base Salary $127,840 – $188,000 • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About the Role** ------------------ At Headway, we're building the future of behavioral health — and increasingly, that means shipping products that providers and patients rely on every day. We're hiring a **Clinical Product Lead** to own the clinical judgment behind how risk gets detected, escalated, and closed out across our platform, and to make sure every product surface we build is connected to the safety systems behind it. Headway already has real safety capability through risk detection, human triage, a 24/7 crisis partner, and more. However as our platform expands, particularly into AI tooling, so does our need for a single coherent system and point of ownership for patient safety across product surfaces. This role sits on our Clinical Product team, partnering daily with engineering, product, and clinical operations. You'll also carry the clinical safety bar for our AI surfaces. This is a first\-of\-its\-kind role. You'll help define what "safe" means for a behavioral health platform operating at the scale of our network — and then build the products and systems that make it true rather than aspirational. **You will:** ------------- * Own the clinical requirements for how patient risk is detected and mitigated through our platform surfaces including the patient portal, support chat and phone, clinical assessments, conversational intake, and more. Drive us toward one shared severity taxonomy and routing model. * Serve as the Clinical Product Patient Safety partner for product features that carry the potential for risk disclosure. Define safety requirements and safeguards, integrate the product into existing escalations structures, and red\-team the failure points. Stay with the feature after launch to review how the safeguards performed. * Audit our product surfaces to identify patient safety gaps. Collaborate within the clinical team and with cross functional partners to close those gaps. * Support us in holding the clinical safety and quality bar for our AI surfaces such as AI\-generated clinical notes, treatment planning, and conversational tools. Write rubrics, label the gold\-standard cases our models learn from, and audit model output against your own clinical assessment. * Resolve risk\-ownership questions and ensure that our policies and the platform clearly and accurately reflect that position. * Communicate tradeoffs clearly to non\-clinical stakeholders — including when speed, scale, or automation must be balanced against clinical rigor — and push back constructively when product or technical decisions conflict with sound clinical judgment. **You will love this role if:** ------------------------------- * You are an Independently Licensed Therapist (LPC, LCSW, PhD, or PsyD) with 3\+ years of post\-graduate clinical experience. * You have worked inside a safety or quality system and feel extremely confident in risk assessment and safety planning, and crisis response. * You are a systems thinker. You can look at a set of disconnected escalation paths and see the single model underneath. * You thrive working quickly and cross\-functionally with engineers, product partners, and operations teams. You're comfortable saying "what you’re proposing carries some risk, and here's the clinical reason why," and you know how to make that feedback actionable for people who don't share your clinical training. * You are a first\-principles thinker who can break down fuzzy clinical concepts (therapeutic alliance, medical necessity, risk assessment, patient safety) into something concrete enough to label, evaluate, and ship against. * You have a working understanding of how AI models are evaluated — concepts like precision, recall, and false positive rates don't intimidate you, and you can connect them to real clinical consequences (e.g., what it means for a model to miss a safety concern vs. over\-flag one). * You are flexible and energized by ambiguity. Headway's clinical AI roadmap will shift across the next year, and you're excited to flex across quality, safety, and product AI projects as our needs evolve. * You are motivated by the opportunity to improve access to high\-quality behavioral healthcare at scale. **Compensation and Benefits:** ============================== The expected base pay range for this position is $127,840 \- $188,000, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. *We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.* **Benefits offered include:** * Equity Compensation * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage * HSA / FSA * 401K * Work\-from\-Home Stipend * Therapy Reimbursement * 16\-week parental leave for eligible employees * Carrot Fertility annual reimbursement and membership * 13 paid holidays each year as well as a Holiday Break during the week between December 25th and December 31st * Flexible PTO * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Training and professional development We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. Headway participates in E\-Verify. A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

jobs.title: Director, UX & Product Design
jobs.description: About HireRight: HireRight is the premier global background screening and workforce solutions provider. We bring clarity and confidence to vetting and hiring decisions through integrated, tailored solutions, driving a higher standard of accuracy in everything we do. Combining in\-house talent, personalized services, and proprietary technology, we ensure the best candidate experience possible. PBSA accredited and based in Nashville, TN, we offer expertise from our regional centers across 200 countries and territories in The Americas, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Our commitment to get it right every time, everywhere, makes us the trusted partner of businesses and organizations worldwide. Overview: HireRight is redefining its design function, and we’re looking for a Director, UX \& Product Design to join us on this journey. We are looking for a player\-coach that’s senior enough to raise the bar and hands\-on enough to demonstrate the value firsthand. The core of this job is evangelizing design thinking globally, starting with the Product and Engineering org and expanding to other departments as influence grows. This includes building the reusable systems that let anyone at HireRight produce good experiences: component libraries, research practices, content and copy standards, AI\-assisted design workflows, and the decision frameworks that turn process into impact. This means orchestrating the creation of artifacts for designers, product managers, engineers, and even cross\-functional partners that contribute to the customer or candidate experience. *If you have ever been the person who fixed the system instead of the ticket, this is that job.* Responsibilities: **What Makes This Role Different** ================================== * **Greenfield with air cover.** You are not inheriting a mature system to maintain. You are defining what design means here and evangelizing the value it brings beyond visuals with Product and Engineering leaders who have already made the case for the investment. * **Systems over throughput.** Roughly two\-thirds of your time is building repeatable capability; roughly one\-third is high\-leverage delivery work you take on yourself. * **AI as a force multiplier.** We expect you to use AI responsibly to scale design thinking across the company: reusable prompts and skills for copywriting, research synthesis, accessibility review, and pattern generation. * **Scope beyond the customer\-facing surface.** Candidate experience, employer and recruiter workflows, internal operations tooling, and partner\-facing integrations are all in scope. **What You'll Own** =================== Everything below is an opportunity, not a day\-one checklist. We do not expect all of it at once. A meaningful part of this role is deciding what matters most, in what order, and bringing others along. **Design Systems \& Scalable Capability** ----------------------------------------- * Build and govern HireRight’s design system with Branding (components, patterns, tokens, content standards, etc.) including the intake, review, rollout, and deprecation processes that keep it useful, not burdensome. * Align with Engineering’s front\-end platform. * Create AI\-assisted workflows and templates (copy, accessibility checks, research synthesis, pattern generation) that non\-designers can use safely, and drive adoption by making them genuinely useful rather than mandatory. **Design Tooling \& Vendor Management** --------------------------------------- * Own the toolchain: audit what we license today and go\-forward across design, prototyping, research, analytics, and accessibility, and assess what is actually used, duplicated, or wasted. * Run selection and renewal with Procurement, InfoSec, and Finance, and propose a forward\-looking roadmap where AI\-native tools earn a place, what we pilot before we buy, and what we retire. **Craft, Quality, \& Coaching** ------------------------------- * Set and hold a high bar across interaction, visual, content, and accessibility. * Coach designers, PMs, and engineers on craft and responsible design; give specific, actionable critique and teach others to give it. * Install lightweight quality controls that hold without policing: critique rhythms, definition of done, accessibility checklists, and release validation. **Research, Continuous Discovery, \& Measurement** -------------------------------------------------- * Establish research standards, templates, and learning loops with Product and Data so discovery is repeatable rather than heroic. Ensure learnings get shared and applied rather than forgotten. * Raise the floor on problem framing: journey maps, principles, and artifacts that keep teams solving the right problem at the right scope. * Define UX health in a few measures the team, stakeholders, and customers understand and instrument for them during design rather than after launch. * Make user testing and evaluation routine: a standing participant pipeline, lightweight  lated\-experience guardrails with Legal, Compliance, and Risk: disclosure patterns, consent and authorization flows, adverse action communication, and easy\-to\-understand copy. * Communicate design decisions in ways that move Executives, Sales, and Engineering, and create the repeatable formats that let others do the same. Qualifications: **What We're Looking For** ========================== * **Senior leadership experience.** Substantial experience as a senior design leader, including work that scaled beyond the products you personally designed. * **Systems thinking.** You can point to patterns, components, or practices you created that other people adopted and are still using today. You naturally orient towards themes and systems over bespoke solutions. * Given a wide field of opportunity, you comfortably sift through ambiguity and noise to decide what matters most now, what waits and why, and you can make that case to the people it affects. * **Player\-coach range.** You are comfortable with your directs and peers and comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you know which one the moment calls for. * **Strong current Figma skills.** We use Figma today; we want your influence on what we use tomorrow, so we are looking for someone fluent in the tool but not married to it. * **AI fluency.** Practical experience with AI tools in a design workflow plus judgment about where they help and where they quietly degrade quality. * **Accessibility depth.** Real WCAG 2\.1 AA fluency and beyond, applied to shipped products rather than audited after the fact. * **Influence without authority.** Across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Sales, and Operations, translating design decisions into the language each of those functions use. * **Bias towards action.** You know when to plan and when to just do. You get things done. **Nice to Have** ================ * You have built and implemented a design system or component library from zero inside an organization or team that did not have one. * You have created AI design templates, prompt libraries, and Claude skills that others use in production work and can speak to the business and customer impact. * Experience adapting systems across varied platforms and stacks: you have opinions, but they travel. * Background in regulated, high\-trust, or compliance\-heavy domains (HR tech, background screening, financial services, healthcare) where clarity and comprehension carry legal weight. * Experience designing for multiple audiences with different incentives (in our case, candidates, the employers screening them, and internal team members driving the work). * Enterprise B2B experience, including complex workflows and configuration\-heavy products. **Who This Role Is Not For** ============================ * You want a large reporting line. * You don’t enjoy doing some IC work. * Your best work happens only when requirements are settled. * You wait to be told what to work on and have others chase you for progress. * You’re strong on theory but have not actually put lasting systems into practice. What do we offer: In exchange for your expertise, HireRight offers an excellent employee benefit package which includes:* Medical * Dental * Vision * Paid Life/AD\&D Insurance * Voluntary Life Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Flexible Spending Accounts * 401K * Generous Vacation and Sick Program * 10 Paid Holidays * Education Assistance Program * Business Casual Attire * Generous Referral Program * Employee Discounts and Rewards * And much more! * *All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.* *HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.* HireRight, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities / Females / Veterans / Disabilities

jobs.title: Economics Specialist (Entry Level, Hybrid, Summer 2027)
jobs.description: Description ICF is looking for an **Economics Specialist** to join our Regulatory, Policy and Economics business portfolio where we primarily support public\-sector clients with research, analysis, technical assistance, and implementation to help them address complex policy, management, and regulatory challenges. We provide innovative, accurate, timely, and high\-quality analyses and support services. We estimate the safety, environmental, and social impacts of regulations, policies, and programs and assess their costs, benefits, and economic impacts. We also evaluate program effectiveness. We work with virtually all federal agencies and with state and local agencies and select non\-profit and private\-sector clients. Our key clients include the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, Department of Transportation, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Labor, Department of Interior, and Environmental Protection Agency. **This entry\-level full\-time position will be hybrid from our Reston, VA headquarters (preferred) or Waltham, MA office and is available starting Summer 2027\. The anticipated pay for this position will be in the low $60K range.** **Job Responsibilities**: As an **Economics Specialist**, you will work within an interdisciplinary team conducting applied research and providing consulting services in support of national\-level programs focused primarily on addressing a range of safety, environmental, and other policy issues. You will contribute to research and regulatory and economic analyses to improve the effectiveness of regulatory and non\-regulatory programs. Specific duties include: * Analyzing and synthesizing information from rulemaking documents, literature, or other technical reports to support program design or implementation. * Performing cost\-benefit, statistical/econometrics, or other quantitative analyses to assess industry response to changing regulatory requirements. * Developing analytical methods, databases, and models (e.g., in R, Excel) to quantify the costs, benefits, or other regulatory impacts. * Drafting and editing rulemaking support documents. * Providing other general program support. The bulk of your work will be on domestic regulatory issues. You will work in collaboration with senior and junior staff within a multidisciplinary team that includes economists, scientists, and engineers. jobs.title: Principal, AI Operations & Infrastructure Automation
jobs.description: Overview: **About the Role \& Team** IDC is the premier global provider of market intelligence, advisory services, and events for the technology markets. For more than 60 years, we've helped technology suppliers, buyers, and investors make the right decisions with evidence, not guesswork. Our analysts turn data into the clarity our clients need to navigate their next move with confidence. That standard applies internally too. The infrastructure our analysts, sales teams, and clients depend on has to be fast, reliable, and quietly excellent — at a scale manual operations can no longer reach. **What You’ll Do** IDC is modernizing how infrastructure is run — shifting from manual, ticket\-driven operations to an automated, AI\-informed model that keeps pace with the speed of the business. We're looking for a Principal of AI Operations \& Infrastructure Automation to lead this transformation: designing and standing up the automation, tooling, and operating model that will define how IDC's infrastructure team works going forward. This is a hands\-on, high\-velocity leadership role for someone who has actually built AIOps and infrastructure\-as\-code capability before — not just overseen it. You'll personally write and review automation, get into the tooling directly, and lead by example for the team you manage. You'll partner closely with the CIO, Cyber \& Infrastructure leadership, and AWS as a strategic cloud and co\-development partner to re\-architect how infrastructure operations get done. This role builds and leads the team responsible for automation — setting technical direction, reviewing their work, and growing their skills as the operating model evolves. Additional responsibilities include:* Own the end\-to\-end redesign of the infrastructure operating model, moving core workflows (provisioning, monitoring, incident response, patching, capacity management) from manual execution to automated, self\-healing pipelines. * Define a phased transformation roadmap with clear milestones, automation\-coverage targets, and go\-live gates — and drive execution against it at pace. * Lead change management for the infrastructure team through the transition — defining new roles, skills, and ways of working as automation is adopted. * Build the AIOps layer; evaluate, select, and deploy AIOps platforms and agentic tooling — anomaly detection, predictive alerting, automated remediation — suited to IDC's AWS\-centric environment. Implement event correlation and noise reduction so a hundred alerts resolve into one actionable incident with a probable root cause attached. * Stand up LLM (large language model)\-assisted triage that classifies, enriches, and routes incidents, pulling relevant runbooks, past resolutions, and change history into the ticket automatically. * Develop predictive capacity and failure models for critical services, and act on them before thresholds are breached. * Automate end to end, build and champion an infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) standard across the organization, converting legacy manual processes into version\-controlled, repeatable automation. * Deliver self\-healing automation and closed\-loop remediation for the highest\-volume recurring incidents — restart, rollback, scale, reroute, and verify without a human in the loop. Automate service request fulfillment: access provisioning, environment setup, onboarding and offboarding, and routine change execution. * Own CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery\-deployment) pipelines for operational tooling, including testing and safe rollback for automations that touch production. * Lead the team and prove the results Directly manage and develop a team of infrastructure and automation engineers — hiring, coaching, and setting technical direction — while staying hands\-on in the tooling and code yourself. * Partner with AWS and other strategic vendors to pilot and scale automation and AI\-driven operations capabilities, including Bedrock/AgentCore\-based tooling where relevant. * Establish new operational KPIs — automation coverage, mean time to detect and resolve, deployment frequency, toil eliminated — and report progress in concise, executive\-ready formats. * Set guardrails for AI in operations: human\-in\-the\-loop thresholds, blast\-radius limits, audit logging, evaluation of model output quality, and clear rollback paths. * Ensure automated operations meet IDC's security, compliance, and resiliency standards, working closely with Cyber \& Compliance. **What You Bring** Required * 8\+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, or IT operations, including 3\+ years leading automation or AIOps initiatives. * Demonstrated track record of redesigning an operations function around automation — not just introducing point tools but changing how a team works. * Deep hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure automation (AWS strongly preferred), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar), and CI/CD pipelines. * Wor ty with FinOps practices and cloud cost automation. * Relevant certifications (cloud architect or engineer, Kubernetes, ITIL v4, Terraform). **What success looks like** *First 90 days* You know our estate — tooling, telemetry, ticket volume, and the top recurring incident categories. The transformation roadmap is published with milestones and automation\-coverage targets, and at least one automation is live and measurably reducing manual work. *First two quarters* A documented automation\-first operating model is adopted across the infrastructure team. Intelligent alert correlation is live on our highest\-noise services, and baseline AIOps KPIs are instrumented and reported to the CIO. *One year* Measurable improvement in mean time to detect and resolve incidents. A growing share of routine operational workflows runs without manual intervention, and infrastructure changes are consistently deployed through version\-controlled, automated pipelines. **Why This Role Stands Out** At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high\-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions. Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long\-term career development with a globally respected brand. **What We Offer** 15 vacation days (prorated based on start date) 12 company\-paid holidays 6 paid sick days (prorated based on start date; may vary by state) Medical, dental, and vision coverage 2 floating holidays (prorated based on start date) 1 volunteer day 401(k) company match (IDC matches 3% on the first 6% of employee contributions) Company\-paid short\-term disability Company\-paid life insurance Company\-paid parental leave Compensation Transparency At IDC, we are committed to fair and equitable pay practices. jobs.title: Assoc Director - Responsible AI
jobs.description: Posted Date 9/21/2026 Description #### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing…** As the Associate Director of Responsible AI, you will lead Verizon’s enterprise\-wide efforts to ensure our artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies are developed, deployed, and scaled safely, ethically, and equitably. Sitting at the intersection of technology, law, and business, you will serve as the central authority on AI risk and governance as Verizon continues to integrate advanced AI across our global 5G network and customer experiences. * Defining, scaling, and managing Verizon’s enterprise\-wide Responsible AI (RAI) framework to align with global standards like the NIST AI RMF. * Co\-chairing the AI Governance Council, facilitating strategic reviews of high\-impact AI use cases, and establishing clear "go/no\-go" criteria for model deployment. * Designing and implementing AI auditing processes focused on bias mitigation, algorithmic fairness, transparency, and explainability. * Partnering with Legal, Privacy, and Public Policy teams to navigate the rapidly evolving AI regulatory landscape (e.g., EU AI Act, FTC guidelines) and ensure strict compliance. * Leading cross\-functional AI "red\-teaming" and stress\-testing initiatives to identify vulnerabilities and edge\-case failures in production models. * Collaborating with ML engineers and product managers to embed RAI checkpoints directly into the CI/CD pipeline and ML lifecycle (MLOps). * Developing comprehensive training programs to upskill Verizon’s workforce on AI ethics, data privacy, and responsible development practices. **What we're looking for…** You are a strategic leader who seamlessly bridges the gap between complex technical algorithms and enterprise risk. You have a deep passion for technology ethics and possess the unique ability to translate abstract principles—like fairness and privacy—into measurable engineering metrics and operational workflows. With exceptional stakeholder management skills, you are just as comfortable discussing prompt injection risks with data scientists as you are presenting governance strategies to C\-suite executives. **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Eight or more years of relevant work experience in technology policy, data governance, legal, risk management, or data science. * Three or more years of direct leadership experience in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Tech Ethics, or AI/ML Risk Management at an enterprise scale. * Deep understanding of machine learning lifecycles, generative AI technologies, and the specific ethical risks associated with Large Language Models (LLMs). * Demonstrated experience translating global AI and data regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA) into enterprise compliance strategies. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * A Master’s degree, JD, or PhD in Law, Public Policy, Computer Science, Data Ethics, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Experience operating within highly regulated industries such as Telecommunications, Financial Services, or Healthcare. * Active certifications in privacy or risk (e.g., CIPP/US, CIPT) or relevant AI ethics credentials. * A proven track record of representing your organization in industry consortiums, academic partnerships, or standard\-setting bodies focused on AI ethics and safety. #### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies. #### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. #### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $126,000\.00 \- $242,000\.00\. Salary126,000\.00 \- 242,000\.00 Annual Type Full\-time
