This role requires a strong operator mindset—someone who thrives in complex, production\-critical environments and takes pride in resolving issues at their root. You will serve as a primary technical escalation point, working closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to maintain system stability and performance. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, making clear and professional communication in English (written and verbal) essential for success in this role. This role offers continuity across both deployment and operational phases and provides exposure to large\-scale, modern infrastructure environments, with a clear path for progression into advanced technical or engineering roles. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Advanced Hardware Troubleshooting \& Repair** * Diagnose and resolve complex hardware failures across server platforms (motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage) * Perform component\-level repairs and replacements on servers and data center hardware * Execute break/fix processes with a focus on minimizing downtime and meeting SLAs * Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) of hardware failures and implement preventative improvements * Identify recurring failure trends and contribute to tooling, automation, and process enhancements ### **Linux Systems \& Platform Support** * Utilize Linux command\-line tools for system monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting * Support provisioning and deployment of servers across Linux distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, etc.) * Troubleshoot boot\-level and OS\-level issues in production environments * Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve complex hardware/software interaction issues ### **Data Center Operations** * Support hardware installation, structured cabling, and infrastructure validation * Maintain accurate inventory of spare parts, assets, and retired equipment * Document repairs, changes, and configurations in ITSM/DCIM systems * Ensure adherence to safety, security, and operational protocols * Serve as a primary escalation point for complex infrastructure issues * Participate in on\-call rotation supporting 24x7 operations ### **Collaboration \& Mentorship** * Provide guidance and mentorship to technicians on hardware troubleshooting and best practices * Collaborate with network, storage, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross\-functional issues * Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and operational excellence initiatives * Support continuous improvement efforts across processes, tooling, and operational workflows **Required Skills** ------------------- * Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) are required for coordination with cross\-functional teams * Expert\-level knowledge of server hardware architecture and component\-level troubleshooting * Strong proficiency with Linux systems and command\-line diagnostics * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and infrastructure components * Experience working within structured operational environments (SOPs, SLAs, ticketing systems) * Familiarity with ITSM/DCIM tools (ServiceNow, Jira, or similar) * Experience with structured cabling and fiber optic connectivity * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail * Ability to operate effectively in high\-pressure, high\-availability environments * Strong organizational and documentation skills **Required Experience** ----------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in data center operations or similar infrastructure environments * Significant hands\-on experience with server hardware troubleshooting and repair * Minimum of 2 years of experience working with Linux operating systems in production environments * Experience supporting enterprise server platforms and infrastructure environments * Demonstrated experience performing root cause analysis and resolving complex hardware issues * Experience working within ticketing systems and operational workflows * Exposure to data center build\-outs, deployments, or infrastructure upgrades (preferred) **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- * CompTIA A\+, Server\+, or Linux\+ * LPI certification or equivalent * Vendor\-specific hardware certifications **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Ability to lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs * Ability to work in a temperature\-controlled environment with moderate noise levels * Ability to perform physical tasks such as standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods **Compensation** ---------------- Estimated Pay Range: $46\.17 \- $68\.00 USD Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. **Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** -------------------------------------------- *At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.* *Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.* *We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack TypeScript Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** Seeking a senior full\-stack TypeScript engineer to construct the web platform through which enterprise users manage our multi\-tenant control plane powering AI infrastructure. This interface allows organizations to establish tenancy, orchestrate GPU resources, configure access policies, and observe cluster metrics in real time. Responsibilities encompass the full web stack: React components integrated with our design system, Next.js server logic for authentication and API proxying to backend Go services, and automated client SDK generation. Collaborating with distributed teams across North America, Europe, and Asia, you will drive frontend features from design phase to production deployment, delivering resilient, information\-dense web tools for system administrators. **Main Responsibilities:** * Build product features end to end in a modern Next.js and React application — server components, route handlers, client interactivity, and the data layer that connects them. * Develop and extend the shared component library and design tokens, implementing Figma specs faithfully across light and dark themes. * Own the server tier that sits between the browser and the platform: request proxying, session handling, and keeping backend service URLs and credentials securely off the client. * Implement authentication and authorization in the web tier — OIDC login against the platform auth service, JWT claim verification, session expiry, and role\-based UI gating that mirrors platform permissions. * Maintain the generated TypeScript SDK produced from the platform's OpenAPI specification, including the codegen pipeline, compatibility gates, and drift detection against the live API. * Partner with backend teams on API contracts — push back when a response shape does not efficiently serve the UI, and negotiate the change rather than building front\-end workarounds. * Build a resilient data layer: caching, invalidation, optimistic updates, pagination, and honest loading/error states for highly dynamic infrastructure data. * Write tests at every level — component tests with mocked network behavior, and Playwright end\-to\-end suites that run against live environments. * Ensure accessibility, responsive behavior, and optimal web performance (bundle size, render cost, and what ships to the browser on each route). * Instrument the application for production: error tracking, product analytics, feature flags, and structured logging. * Review peers' code, debug production issues to root cause with regression coverage, and mentor junior engineers through design reviews. **Qualifications** **Required Skills/Abilities:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including deep production experience with TypeScript and modern React paradigms. * Next.js architecture mastery: deep understanding of the server/client component boundary, caching strategies, and server\-side rendering. * Genuine full\-stack range: comfortable and secure owning server\-side code and API proxies, not just browser\-based logic. * Practical web\-tier security experience: implementing OAuth2/OIDC flows, JWT verification, and secure cookie/session management. * Architectural fluency in managing complex application state, specifically bridging server\-state synchronization with client UI updates. * Strong CSS architecture and design\-system practice — utility\-first CSS, scalable theming, and accessible component APIs built on headless primitives. * Testing discipline across unit, component, and end\-to\-end layers, including network mocking and CI integration. * Experience working in a monorepo with shared packages and a task\-graph build system. * Clear written English for design docs, review comments, and asynchronous collaboration across global time zones. **Must Have** (We expect deep production experience in several of these, and the engineering fundamentals to learn the rest rapidly) * Core: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js (App Router), Node.js 22\+. * Styling \& Components: Tailwind CSS v4, headless primitives (Base UI, Radix), CVA, design tokens, and theming. * Data: TanStack Query, Zod validation, and OpenAPI\-generated TypeScript clients. * Auth: OIDC/JWT session handling in a server tier (jose or equivalent), cookie security, and role\-based access control. * Testing: Vitest, Testing Library, MSW, and Playwright. * Tooling: pnpm workspaces, Turborepo, ESLint, Prettier, and GitHub Actions. * Production: Error tracking and product analytics (Sentry, PostHog, or equivalent), and Docker\-packaged deployment. **Nice to Have** * Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure product experience (familiarity with the domain this application exposes). * GPU infrastructure or AI/ML platform UI work. * Rich editor integration ( YAML editing and validation), map/geospatial visualization, animations (motion.dev and/or CSS) * Web performance optimization: Core Web Vitals, bundle analysis, streaming, and partial rendering. * Feature\-flag driven delivery and experimentation. * Design\-system ownership (Ladle, Storybook, visual regression testing). * OpenTelemetry or structured client\-side logging. * Go familiarity, for reading the backend services behind the API contract. * CNCF or React/TypeScript ecosystem open\-source contributions. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science \& Engineering or related field or 10 years related experience. **Additional Information** **What does Mirantis offer you?** * Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry; * Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next\-generation cloud technologies; * Be a part of cutting\-edge, open\-source innovation; * Thrive in the high\-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk\-taking, and continuous growth are valued; * Professional development and training; * Attend conferences and working groups; * Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks; * Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan. We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Job Description** At Mission Pet Health, our passion for pets and their families fuels our ambition to build the world's greatest veterinary organization. We are scaling toward 1,000 hospitals and 20,000\+ teammates, and the data behind that growth runs across hundreds of clinical, financial, HR, and marketing systems. We're hiring a Solutions Architect to own the end\-to\-end design of the platform that ties it all together — and to stay hands\-on while doing it. **This is a hybrid opening in Birmingham, AL.** **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the target\-state architecture for the data platform end\-to\-end — ingestion, storage, modeling, serving, and governance. * Set the direction for our analytical layer on SQL Server, SSAS, and ClickHouse, and for our integration fabric across Azure Data Factory, REST APIs, NATS, and CDC. * Design and operate event\-driven, service\-oriented workloads on Kubernetes in Go and Python. * Make AI\-driven development a core focus of the team: build and adopt agentic tooling (code\-aware agents, retrieval over our own schemas and lineage) so engineers ship faster, with better tests and documentation, and so routine work gets automated rather than repeated. * Define the data contracts, schema standards, and quality SLAs that engineering and analytics teams build against. * Embed PII/PHI handling, access control, and auditability into the platform * Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and translate executive intent into delivery roadmaps. **Responsibilities and Benefits** **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE** * 8\+ years across data engineering, software engineering, or platform architecture * Deep hands\-on experience with T\-SQL, SQL Server at scale, SSAS, and Azure Data Factory. * Production experience with ClickHouse (or a comparable columnar engine such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks). * Strong production\-grade skills in Python, Go, or a comparable backend language — and the discipline to write the code, not just the diagrams. * Comfort designing event\-driven systems (REST, NATS or Kafka, CDC) and operating workloads on Kubernetes. * Genuine fluency with AI\-assisted engineering — coding agents, LLM tooling, retrieval, evals — and a point of view on how to do it responsibly inside a regulated, multi\-site business. * A track record of partnering with executives and turning ambiguous business problems into durable technical designs. * Reside in or be willing to relocate to Birmingham, Alabama and work onsite. **NICE TO HAVE** * Veterinary, healthcare, or multi\-site retail/services experience, particularly with Practice Information Management Systems (PIMS). \#INDHQ

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **The Equipment Reliability and Maintenance Coordinator is responsible for optimizing equipment performance and coordinating all maintenance activities within the facility. This role combines responsibilities for ensuring equipment reliability through data\-driven analysis and implementing effective maintenance strategies to minimize downtime and extend asset life. The position will provide a liaison between multiple Maintenance Supervisors, Production Supervisors, and Manufacturing Engineers.** **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Reliability Analysis:** Monitor and analyze equipment performance data to identify trends, potential issues, and areas for improvement. Utilize reliability\-centered maintenance (RCM) and predictive maintenance techniques to enhance equipment reliability. * **Maintenance Scheduling:** Develop and manage maintenance schedules to ensure timely execution of preventive and corrective maintenance tasks. Coordinate with maintenance staff and other departments to minimize operational disruptions. * **Work Order Management:** Oversee the creation, assignment, and tracking of work orders. Ensure that work orders are completed efficiently and accurately, with all relevant documentation maintained. * **Failure Analysis:** Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment failures and downtime incidents. Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions to address identified issues and prevent recurrence. * **Resource Allocation:** Allocate resources, including personnel, tools, and materials, for maintenance activities. Monitor inventory levels and order maintenance supplies as necessary. * **Compliance and Safety:** Ensure all maintenance and reliability activities comply with safety regulations, environmental standards, and company policies. Conduct safety audits and inspections to identify and address potential hazards. * **Data Management and Reporting:** Maintain accurate records of equipment performance, maintenance activities, and reliability metrics. Generate and present reports on maintenance performance, equipment reliability, and cost\-effectiveness for management review. * **Continuous Improvement:** Identify and implement process improvements to enhance maintenance efficiency and equipment reliability. Stay current with industry trends and advancements in maintenance and reliability engineering. **QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactory. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field. Relevant certifications such as Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) or Certified Maintenance \& Reliability Professional (CMRP) are a plus. * **Experience:** Minimum of 3 years of experience in equipment reliability and maintenance coordination, preferably in a \[specific industry, e.g., manufacturing, facilities management, etc.]. * **Skills:** Strong knowledge of reliability engineering principles, predictive maintenance techniques, and maintenance management software (e.g., CMMS, SAP PM). Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook). * **Technical Abilities:** Basic understanding of mechanical, electrical, and HVAC systems. Ability to interpret technical manuals and schematics. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to effectively interact with staff, vendors, and other stakeholders. * **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to addressing maintenance and reliability issues. * **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a team, manage multiple priorities, and work collaboratively with various departments. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Ability to work in various environments, including plant floors, maintenance workshops, and office settings. May require occasional lifting, climbing, and other physical activities. The employee must be available during all hours if needed, and have the flexibility to work various shift hours if needed. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The environmental characteristics described here are representative of those an associate encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the associate frequently works near moving parts. The associate is frequently exposed to electromagnetic fields, risk of electric shock and vibration. The associate may occasionally work in high precarious places and is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. Associate may be subject to temperature extremes for extended periods of time. *To learn more about Multimatic, check out our youtube channel \-* *https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=psOjJIh3t90* *If you are interested in this position, apply by sending us your cover letter and resume.* *We thank all interested candidates in advance; however, only individuals selected for interviews will be contacted.* *As part of our commitment to ensuring our employment practices are fair, accessible, and inclusive of persons with disabilities, recruitment\-related accommodations for disabilities, are available upon request throughout the recruitment and assessment process for applicants with disabilities.*

You will partner with engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, the Enterprise Application and Infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders while providing technical leadership and mentorship across internal and offshore team members. Your work will have a direct impact on NBME's future growth and innovation in a highly collaborative, digitally driven environment. This role has been designated as a primarily remote position, though it may require occasional onsite work for team collaboration or meetings. We are currently prioritizing applicants within a 50\-mile radius of our Philadelphia office. ***Please note that onsite interviews and onboarding at our Philadelphia office may be required for this role. If applicable, advance notice will be provided to support planning.*** At NBME, we continue to innovate and improve how we fulfill the evolving needs of the health care community. This commitment starts and ends with the people at NBME. By recruiting and empowering talented individuals from various disciplines and backgrounds, which includes professionals with diverse life experiences, abilities, and perspectives, NBME can take a well\-informed, robust approach to advancing medical education and assessment for years to come. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Participate in business and technical requirements meetings, translate business needs into technical designs and solutions, provide estimates, and communicate proposed solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Lead the design and implementation of scalable serverless and event\-driven solutions using AWS technologies such as Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, and AppSync. * Develop and deploy serverless APIs and AWS service integrations using Python, AWS SDKs, and the boto3 library. * Design and support data solutions using AWS databases and storage services, including DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Aurora, RDS, and S3, with appropriate file management, retention, and archiving strategies. * Build and deploy serverless applications using Infrastructure as Code tools such as AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or AWS SAM, and support DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines and serverless testing frameworks. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex serverless application issues using appropriate AWS monitoring and debugging tools while supporting security and compliance requirements. * Work across modern cloud\-native solutions and legacy applications, including PL/SQL, Java, and Oracle, and support serverless data\-processing needs using tools such as AWS Glue or Athena as appropriate. * Collaborate with Scrum teams, Product Owners, Solution Architects, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and Security teams to conduct technical reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture and security standards. * Lead and manage an offshore team of technical professionals, providing technical guidance, mentorship, code review, and support to promote timely, high\-quality execution. **QUALIFICATIONS** Skills and Abilities * In\-depth understanding of serverless computing concepts, event\-driven architectures, and design patterns for serverless applications. * Strong hands\-on experience with AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, and AppSync. * Deep knowledge of Python, AWS SDKs, and the boto3 library for AWS services integration. * Strong experience with AWS database and storage technologies, including DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Aurora, RDS, and S3\. * Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps practices, including CloudFormation, CDK or SAM, CI/CD pipelines, and serverless testing frameworks. * Knowledge of serverless monitoring, debugging, security, and compliance considerations, including tools such as AWS X\-Ray or CloudTrail. * Ability to work effectively across cloud\-native and legacy application environments, including PL/SQL, Java, and Oracle. * Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills, with experience working in Agile or Scrum\-based environments. * AWS certification related to serverless computing, such as AWS Certified Developer \- Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, is a plus but not required. Experience * 10\+ years of experience in Information Technology, with expertise in designing and building large\-scale applications, security, or infrastructure solutions. Education * Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent work experience. **About NBME** NBME is a not\-for\-profit organization that specializes in the creation of assessments and learning tools for physicians and health professionals. Our mission is to advance assessment of these professionals to achieve optimal care for all, supporting the development of a highly effective, diverse and compassionate health care workforce. Founded in 1915, NBME develops and manages the United States Medical Licensing Examination® with the Federation of State Medical Boards. We offer a comprehensive portfolio of assessment products for every stage of the medical school journey and provide assessment services to various health profession organizations. We are dedicated to advancing innovative assessment approaches through research, collaboration and contributions to the medical education and assessment communities. In 2024, we expanded our assessment capabilities to include simulation through the acquisition of MedVR Education. Learn more on NBME's website. **NBME's Community Collaborations and Contributions** NBME believes that a key path to meeting our mission is collaborating with and supporting our communities. Our Community Collaborations and Contributions programs provide resources and recognition to medical educators and researchers advancing the field of assessment throughout their careers. In addition, we invest in fee assistance, scholarships and pathway programs to aid learners and help support increased representation in health care. Headquartered in Philadelphia, NBME also gives to local organizations that advance health equity and access and positively impact social determinants of health. Compensation we are offering for this position is at $135,600 – 170,000/year. Please note that the offered rate for this position typically aligns with the minimum to midrange of this grade, but it can vary based on the successful candidate's qualifications and experience, department budget, and an internal equity review. **The NBME offers competitive salaries, excellent benefits, and a rewarding work environment.** Excellent Benefits include: Healthcare, Dental, Prescription, and Vision plans; 401(k) w/match, Tuition Reimbursement Plan, Commuter Benefit: Public Transit or Parking options. Remote Friendly Workplace. **NBME is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.**

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Security Architecture - DGX Cloud
jobs.description: NVIDIA DGX Cloud is an AI Factory designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial\-scale breakthroughs. As a Principal Engineer for Security Architecture, within our Security Engineering organization, you will own a core security domain of the AI factory: the architecture, the paved road that delivers it, and much of the code underneath. You will hold the security design bar across DGX Cloud from inside the teams doing the building, and this is a founding seat on a new team. Security Engineering is a new organization at DGX Cloud, accountable for the security outcome of the platform, and Security Architecture is the function inside it that holds the design bar. Security here is fleet horizontal and stack vertical, so your work will cross every DGX Cloud engineering organization: you will embed with the teams building GPU clusters, control planes, and services, join their designs as a participant rather than an approver, and leave behind systems in which an entire class of risk is no longer possible. There is no architecture review board here and no approval queue. You are a senior IC with deep security domain knowledge, and the security bar holds because you helped set it and then helped ship it. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Own a Security Domain End to End: Take architectural ownership of a core domain of DGX Cloud security, from the design through the system running in production. That could be tenant and GPU workload isolation, workload identity, infrastructure and network, supply\-chain provenance, hardened baselines and patching, or deploy\-time policy and admission control. * Embed with the Teams Building It: Join the design early, write the code, and help land it. The posture is not "you did this wrong." It is "here are the considerations we need to meet, I will help, let's go to work." * Build Paved Roads, Not Gates: Engineer the secure path into the platform so that it is also the easy path. You are measured by whether teams take that path by default, not by the number of requirements you have written down. * Engineer Classes of Risk Out of Existence: Finding a vulnerability is 4% of the work; building the system where it cannot happen again is the other 96%. When teams keep missing the same requirement, the paved road is wrong, and fixing the road is our job rather than theirs. * Threat Model and Attack the Design: Run deep\-dive threat models across the substrate, the orchestration layer, and the tenancy boundary, then go after your own designs offensively and feed what you find back into the baselines, the guardrails, and the detections. * Carry the Bar into Execution: Turn the DGX Cloud security bar into reference architectures, requirements, and golden paths teams can build against. Raise gaps early, in the design, with the work to close them attached. * Multi\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with DGX Cloud platform, production engineering, and network security teams, and with NVIDIA's central security organization, to make the secure path real in CI/CD and in the hardware lifecycle. We operate horizontally across vertically organized teams, with influence rather than authority. **What We Need to See:** * Security and Infrastructure Engineering: Experience (typically 15\+ years) across software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, and security engineering. You build systemic solutions rather than performing manual operations or "tool administration." * Production\-Grade Coding: A strong software engineering background with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code. You should be comfortable building and operating production services at scale. * Emerging Technology: You work with what is new rather than waiting for it to settle. Today that means writing and reviewing AI\-generated code at the volume it now arrives, putting AI\-assisted analysis to work in your own security engineering, and building for agents that act inside the systems you own. Tomorrow it will mean something else. * Security Architecture in Practice: Designs you own that actually got built and run, in areas like multi\-tenant isolation, identity and access, policy enforcement, vulnerability management, or detection engineering. You stayed on to operate them. * Threat Modeling and System Design: Proven ability to build threat models for complex distributed systems, identify the architectural gaps rather than only the bugs, and engineer the solutions that close them. * Distributed Systems and Linux Depth: Cloud\-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and hands\-on Linux systems security including kernel\-level primitives (eBPF, AppArmor, or SELinux). * Influence Without Authority: Experience landing designs through teams you do not own, in environments where credibility and relationships, not org charts, determine whether the work ships. * Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience) with 15\+ yrs of relevant experience. **Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:** * HPC/AI Security: Experience securing high\-performance computing environments, RDMA\-based networks, large GPU fleets, or GPU\-specific security challenges. * Cloud\-Native Identity and Attestation: Expertise in workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE), hardware root of trust (TPM/HSM) integration, or confidential computing. * Offensive Depth Turned Defensive: Real exploitation, red team, or security research experience that you have converted into engineering: the controls, guardrails, and detections that closed what you found for good. * Open Source Impact: Notable contributions to security\-focused open\-source projects or a track record of engineering\-focused security research. jobs.title: Research Intern, Robotics - Summer 2027
jobs.description: NVIDIA is at the forefront of the AI and robotics revolution, and NVIDIA’s robotics teams are on a mission to build the essential technology that can enable any company to become a robotics company. The Seattle Robotics Lab is uniquely positioned at the intersection of open academic research and real\-world industry impact, pursuing fundamental and applied robotics research across the full robotics stack, including perception, planning, control, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, simulation, and robotics foundation models. This research aims to transform research paradigms, transfer into NVIDIA’s robotics and simulation products, and create new robotics markets for the world. The Seattle Robotics Lab has published over 500 research papers, including many influential works that have been presented at top robotics, AI, and computer vision conferences. Interns can either be working on their own projects typically aligned with one of our internal efforts, or in some cases directly contribute to one of our efforts. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. **About the Role** * Works throughout the software development life cycle and performs in a utility capacity to create, design, code, debug, maintain, test, implement and validate applications with a broad understanding of a variety of languages and architectures. * Analyzing existing applications or formulating logic and low\-level designs for new applications, procedures, coding and debugging programs. * Creates appropriate deliverables and develops application implementation plans throughout the life cycle in a flexible development environment. * Providing technical direction and engineering leadership for a team of engineers * Recommends changes in development, maintenance and system standards * Mentoring jobs.title: Design Engineer, Design Systems
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **The Team** XD Design Engineering is a small team of engineers with a big mandate: to develop, maintain, and innovate the Design Platform central to Netflix’s product development lifecycle. Our goal is to improve product development velocity *without compromising on fidelity* and to increase efficiency of the design/engineering handoff. Our portfolio includes API services, web apps, and Figma Plugins, serving a diverse range of cross\-functional partners, from product designers and project managers to software engineers. **The Role** In this high\-impact role, you’ll work on a portfolio of productivity tools and automations designed to accelerate the product design lifecycle at Netflix. You’ll collaborate closely with system designers and engineers, to contribute to the distribution and adoption of the Design System. You'll drive medium\-to\-large features end\-to\-end and communicate progress and impact to your team and partners. You will also gather input from stakeholders, identifying opportunities to help inform prioritization of features that continuously evolves the design capabilities portfolio to ensure it remains best\-in\-class. **Responsibilities** * Contributing, maintaining, and expanding critical design component libraries and capabilities supporting hundreds of internal users (React) * Implementing AI solutions , when appropriate, that measurably accelerate product design workflows * Execute on projects, working from ideation to implementation to rollout * Participating internal user\-research to gather insights to inform prioritization and feature development * Completing medium to large features independently with limited guidance * Help triage and resolve support requests related to the Design System portfolio * Work with designers and engineers across other teams to maintain the integrity and reliability of the Design System portfolio. * Participate in on\-call rotation to continue to meet our critical SLAs * Participate in design and code reviews **Who You Are** * 3\+ years of professional experience designing, building, and shipping software * Experience with single page applications architecture, patterns, and design * Experience fetching data from GraphQL and REST APIs * Experience with client\-side instrumentation and observability * Ability to drive features and communicate effectively with your team and partners * Able to contribute to design, architect, debug, test, and create well\-documented code * Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript , React , and Node.js **What Sets You Apart** * You’re known for your excellent communication skills (written and verbal) * You have an ownership mentality in all the things you build and are comfortable with identifying improvements and proposing them to your team * You take a thoughtful , practical approach to problem\-solving that considers tradeoffs and avoids over\-engineering * You’re motivated by the scope and impact to contribute to discussions that shape the future of design workflows * You’re data driven and lean on both qualitative and quantitative data to drive your decision making * You have a strong intuition for user experience flows * Experience managing web applications with complex state management * Current/former professional experience working with Figma Plugins * Bonus if you’ve contributed to open\-source projects Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $320,000\.00 \- $500,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future\-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast\-paced, mission\-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. **What** **we're** **looking for:** We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to help us build and optimize tech solutions to accelerate our sustainable energy future. At Nexamp, you'll be part of an engineering squad focused on multiplying the efficiency of how we raise and deploy billions of dollars of capital into low\-downtime solar power plants. You'll focus on internal financial modeling tools and will drive impact by writing quality code, steering projects from conception to completion, helping refine our processes, and guiding more junior team members. This role will be hybrid, based out of our Boston office, and you will report to your squad's Tech Lead. **What you'll do:** * Deliver value: Internalize our objectives and deliver measurable change for Nexamp and our customers. * Write code: Design, implement, and deploy reliable and efficient production software in our React/Django/Azure stack. * Elevate your squad: Actively collaborate in sprint planning, execution, code reviews, demos, and retrospectives. * Architect for maintainability: Own design decisions across the stack. Establish and execute scalable patterns, standards, and best practices for the squad. * Grow others: Guide and inspire more junior developers across the organization through mentorship and collaboration. * Grow yourself: Continually seek ways to level\-up your own skills and make a bigger impact throughout the company. **What you'll bring:** * 7\+ years of full stack software development experience at companies with 10 or more developers. * Experience building financial forecasting software is a plus. * Experience building and optimizing consumer\-facing frontend applications in React and TypeScript. * Experience developing and optimizing web\-based solutions in modern Python, ideally using Django, FastAPI, or similar frameworks. * Robust understanding of web standards, infrastructure (databases, storage, caching, content delivery, etc.), and cloud platform offerings. * Effectively communicate and collaborate with users and business stakeholders, facilitating software and process requirements. * Experience leveraging debugging expertise and a proven track record of independently solving problems. * Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases. * Familiarity with version control systems like Git, CI/CD pipelines for automated testing \& deployment, and infrastructure tools like Terraform. * Understanding of cutting edge AI tools and a commitment to leveraging them to rapidly deliver high quality software. * Ownership mentality and initiative to make improvements to code, processes, and user experiences across the organization. * Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today. * Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization. * Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. * Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. * Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. * Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions. ***If you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.*** ***At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.*** **You'll** **love working here because:** Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer\-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more! **Compensation:** *The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $170,000 \- $190,000\. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non\-annual sales incentive plans, or other non\-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company's stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location.* *Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third\-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Staff DevOps Engineer, IaC
jobs.description: **About the Role** As a **Staff DevOps Engineer**, you'll own how code gets from commit to production at NinjaOne — designing and continuously improving the release and deployment pipelines that let engineering teams ship quickly, safely, and often. This role sits at the intersection of CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code, and it's built for someone who thinks in modules, state files, and plan/apply workflows, not manual console changes. Terraform is our IaC standard, and you'll be the architect behind it — building a cloud\-agnostic foundation that scales across teams today and extends to a multi\-cloud future (AWS now, Azure/GCP as we grow). You'll operate at both a strategic and hands\-on level: setting deployment and IaC standards org\-wide, mentoring engineers, and partnering closely with Development, QA, Security, and IT to keep our release process fast, secure, and resilient. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to own the "last mile" of software delivery — turning builds into safe, repeatable production deployments backed by clean, modular infrastructure code — and who's excited to shape that strategy as we expand into new regions and cloud providers. **Location** \- We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states \- **CA**, **CO**, **CT**, **FL**, **GA**, **\*IL**, **KS**, **MA**,**MD, ME**,**NJ**, **NC**, **NY**,**OH,** **OR**, **TN**, **TX**, **VA**, and **WA**. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.* *Onsite interviews* *may be required* *for this role.* We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on **Java**, **Kotlin**, **C\+\+**, **Golang** and **Postgres**; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in **AWS**. Knowing large\-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client\-server architecture will help you. **What You’ll be Doing*** **Own the CD/Release Pipeline****:** Design, build, and continuously improve delivery pipelines — from artifact promotion through progressive rollout (blue/green, canary, rolling) to production, with automated health checks, gating, and rollback. Build the CI/CD framework with particular depth on the CD half: release orchestration, environment promotion, deployment gating, automated rollback. Automate release management across services and regions — deployment scheduling, change tracking, feature\-flag\-driven rollout, coordinated multi\-service releases. * **Lead Terraform/****IaC** **Strategy \& Architecture****:** Serve as technical authority on the Terraform codebase: module design, remote state management (backends, locking), workspace/organization strategy, versioning, provider pinning, RBAC for infra changes, and secrets management — built to scale across dozens of teams without conflict. Define the cloud\-agnostic architecture (abstraction layers, reusable module libraries, naming/tagging conventions) that lets this extend from AWS to Azure/GCP as the company grows multi\-cloud. * **Establish Governance \& Guardrails****:** Implement policy\-as\-code and automated compliance/security/cost scanning (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov, Infracost, or similar) directly into the Terraform pipeline so infra changes are safe, auditable, and cost\-aware by default. * **Drive Org\-Wide Adoption****:** Partner with every engineering team to migrate existing infrastructure onto the new Terraform architecture; build documentation, golden\-path templates, and training so teams outside DevOps/Deployment Engineering can safely author their own IaC. * **Drive Cross\-Cloud Infrastructure Delivery****:** Design, develop, and deploy secure, compliant infrastructure in AWS (current primary cloud) via Terraform, shaping module/architecture strategy so the standard extends cleanly to Azure/GCP as those environments come online. * **Monitor, Support, and Respond****:** Proactively monitor deployment pipelines, release health, Terraform plan/apply activity, and infra alerts/metrics. Serve as technical escalation point for production support, including after\-hours. Own incident response, rollback, and remediation decisions for both deployment and infrastructure issues. * **Mentor the Team****:** Coach engineers on release engineering, deployment safety, Terraform best practices, and IaC code quality. * Other duties as needed. **About You*** 10\+ years cloud DevOps (AWS\-primary), with strong emphasis on release engineering, deployment automation, and IaC. * Multi\-cloud production experience required — AWS plus hands\-on, production\-grade work in Azure and/or GCP (not theoretical portability). * 4\+ years hands\-on, production\-grade Terraform — module authoring, remote state (S3/DynamoDB), workspaces, provider version management, safe plan/apply in CI/CD. * **Deep CD experience** (not just CI) — progressive rollout strategies, automated rollback, supporting infra as code. * Proven enterprise\-scale **Terraform** architecture experience — remote state design, module registries, versioning/governance policy, multi\-team access control. * Real multi\-cloud IaC architecture experience — built/operated a cloud\-agnostic architecture in production, not just designed portable\-in\-theory modules. * Terraform ecosystem tooling (Terragrunt, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, Atlantis, Sentinel/OPA, Checkov) — plus. * **Track record driving org\-wide IaC adoption** — migrations, golden\-path templates, enabling other teams. * Agile/version\-control tooling: Jira, Confluence, Git, BitBucket. * Deep CI/CD tooling expertise, with hands\-on **CircleCI**experience strongly preferred; we're especially interested in candidates who've owned the CD/release side of the pipeline — including the provisioning layer — not just build/test automation. * Expert in cloud ops — scalability, reliability, maintainability through full deployment lifecycle. * Track record reducing lead time, change failure rate, time to recover. * Ability to coach/mentor. * 7\+ years \*nix (Linux, MacOS, BSD, AIX). * 5\+ years scripting (Shell, Go, Python, PERL, Tcl/Tk) for deployment tooling/Terraform providers. * 5\+ years monitoring/alerting/observability, including drift detection against Terraform state. * Kubernetes/ECS experience (Helm, Kustomize) including cluster/node provisioning via Terraform — highly desirable. **About Us** NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140\+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. **What You’ll Love** We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. We honor your flexibility needs with full\-time work that is hybrid remote. We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance. We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan. We prioritize your work\-life balance with our unlimited PTO. We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement. **Additional Information** This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.* Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self\-relocate. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job\-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey, or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $180,000 \- $240,000 per year. For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $180,000 \- $240,000 per year. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment. \#LI\-KS2 \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-Hybrid \#BI\-Remote \#BI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nutrient** ================== At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission\-critical. **Your Role at Nutrient...** ============================ As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Sales team, your work starts with a customer: * You will find the document problem that is actually costing them money, and build the working solution yourself, on their documents, that works with or within their environment, against a scorecard we agree on before we start. * Then you will turn what you built into something the next customer can buy ready made. We commit to the specific outcome for the customer, and we then measure how much of each engagement converts into actual product. Here’s how this role is different: * If you are a **solutions engineer** today, the difference is that you ship. * If you are a **professional services engineer** today, the difference is that the work is not billed by the hour against a spec someone else wrote, and success is not a signed\-off SOW but a customer outcome and a reusable capability in the product. * If you are a **product engineer** today, the difference is that your users are in the room, on the call, and occasionally disagreeing with you. This is a role for someone who is genuinely comfortable in all three chairs: the discovery conversation where you work out what job the customer is actually trying to get done, the terminal where you build it by Friday, and the seat at the table when the product is being meaningfully developed. **What You'll Work On...** ========================== * **Discover the problem before anyone scopes it**. Get into the customer's process deeply enough to state the job to be done in their words. Most engagements start because someone asked for a feature; the work is finding the outcome behind the request. * **Build the first implementation yourself**. Working software on the customer's own documents and in their own environment if necessary, fast enough that the demo lands while the problem is still urgent. A prototype that shows beats a deck that tells, and a working solution closes the deal. * **Agree a scorecard upfront and hit it.** Every engagement starts with a written definition of what success looks like and how it will be measured. We commit to that result. * **Stitch across the whole platform**. Real solutions cut across Nutrient Workflow, Document Engine, our Document Web Services APIs, the Web and native SDKs, AI data extraction, and whatever the customer already runs. Recent engagements have meant SharePoint and Salesforce integrations, AWS Bedrock models, .NET services behind consistent\-hash routing, bulk export pipelines, and database archiving. * **Productize what you build**. Choose the implementation that makes the next customer easier, not the one that closes fastest. In a recent engagement we deliberately built a cover\-sheet generator on AI Data Extraction rather than a SQL script, and that task is now stronger for every customer. Several deliverables from that engagement are now licensable product components and self\-service features. * **Close the loop back into the company**. Write up what you learned, file the defects you hit, articulate the pattern so the next engagement starts from it, and hand the template to the next team. Forward deployed work that stays inside one account is just consulting. * **Support the deal**. You will work alongside account executives and solutions engineers before the contract as well as after it. What you build during the sales cycle is often what decides whether we win. **What You'll Bring...** ======================== The shortest description of the profile: a strong software engineer who has moved toward product thinking — you care about the problem, not the ticket — and who is unusually good with customers. You live in a world that exists beyond technical requirements and can quickly go into solution mode to deliver a working solution. You are likely a good fit if most of the following are true:* You can run a discovery conversation. You ask about the business process before the API, and you can tell the difference between a use case and a job to be done. * You get real leverage out of coding agents. Our customers expect the first working version in days, not sprints, and that only happens if you direct agents well. * You have shipped production software for years, and you still build. You are comfortable being the only engineer on a problem and being a part of a team that delivers the solution. * You are fluent in at least one of JavaScript or TypeScript, .NET/C\#, Java, Python or Go, and you p  experience** with the systems enterprises actually run, such as SharePoint, Salesforce, Power Automate, or an internal system nobody has documented since 2011\. * Comfort working with **regulated environments** and the conversations that come with them, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, FIPS, and government cloud. Be honest with yourself — this is probably not for you if:* You want a clean backlog and a quiet quarter. Early engagements will be ambiguous and the team's boundaries with Engineering and Professional Services are still being drawn. * You prefer to hand off after the design. Here you build it. * You would rather build the perfect bespoke thing than the slightly less perfect thing three more customers can use. **Also…** ========= * **Your first 90 days**: By day 30 you will have shadowed two live engagements and shipped one small thing a customer uses. By day 60 you will own an engagement end to end, from discovery through the agreed scorecard. By day 90 at least one thing you built will be on its way into the product as a template or a component, and you will have written up why. * **How we will measure your impact**: Customer outcomes against the scorecards you agreed, revenue influenced through the engagements you run, and the share of your work that converts into reusable product rather than staying in one account. That last one is the number that keeps Nutrient a software company. * **Team and location**: You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering team, reporting into Sales, working daily with Engineering and the Account teams. We are hiring in Raleigh, NC and in London. Expect meaningful travel to customer sites, concentrated in bursts around engagement kickoffs. **Who Thrives Here...** ======================= At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: * **Collaborators**: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego. * **Hungry Learners**: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth. * **Curious Thinkers**: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. * **Self\-Starters**: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence. * **Owners**: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control. * **Doers**: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges. **Why You'll Love Working Here...** =================================== At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. * **Real technical ownership:** you're not just managing relationships; you're running technical discovery, building POCs, and being the engineer in the room for your customers. * **Cross\-functional influence:** your work sits at the intersection of CS, Solutions Architecture, and Support, with a direct line to shape product direction through customer advocacy. * **Distributed and async\-first:** minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work. * **Mission\-critical product:** Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%\+ of the Global 500 across 80\+ countries. * **Strong growth trajectory:** ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners. jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Proximie is on a mission to improve healthcare by transforming the world’s operating rooms into connected ecosystems of people, devices, and data. Our Intelligence Suite transforms operating room (OR) performance, keeping teams in sync and workflows on track to maximise throughput. Simultaneously our computer vision and AI capabilities capture real\-time data and detect surgical events – improving quality of data outputs. The result: ORs are optimised like never before – with predictive analytics and automated notifications ensuring patients and staff are in the right place at the right time. Once practitioners are in the OR, our Surgical Suite enables real\-time remote access and creates a secure video record of every procedure; improving training, education, and collaboration. It is an intuitive asset which helps instil a culture of continuous learning, accelerates the adoption of cutting\-edge medical devices, and enhances surgical performance across the entire global workforce – improving outcomes and saving lives. Proximie was commercialised in 2019 and is available in over 500 facilities globally. Check out our Founder and CEO Nadine’s Origins Story here: https://www.proximie.com/about\-us/ **Position Overview** Proximie is seeking a Sales Engineer to serve as the technical bridge between our commercial team and our engineering and product organizations. This is a high\-impact, customer\-facing role for someone who thrives on translating complex technical concepts into clear, confident conversations. This role will be critical to Proximie’s growth in the US market, supporting the commercial team as we respond to RFPs, navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, and onboard new health system partners. **Responsibilities** * Act as the primary technical resource during the sales cycle, joining commercial conversations to address deep product, software, networking, and integration questions. * Lead technical discovery conversations with hospital IT, innovation teams, and procurement stakeholders covering topics such as SSO configuration, network requirements, hardware setup, cloud architecture, and data flow. * Translate customer requirements into clearly scoped questions or change requests for engineering and product teams. * Build and maintain a strong partnership with Engineering, serving as the connective tissue between field insights and internal technical teams to ensure customer needs are understood, prioritized, and addressed effectively. * Troubleshoot integration and configuration issues in the field, identifying root causes and driving resolution. * Proactively identify recurring technical friction points across deals and escalate patterns to product and engineering to inform the roadmap. * Support the onboarding of new health system customers by bridging the handoff between sales and implementation. * Maintain clear documentation of technical configurations, customer environments, and common integration patterns. **Requirements** * 5\+ years in a Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Pre\-Sales role, ideally in a SaaS or health tech environment. * Strong foundational knowledge of networking and infrastructure, including hospital or clinical network environments (VLANs, firewalls, SSO/SAML, Active Directory). * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how cloud\-based software integrates with on\-premises hospital systems. * Ability to get into a system, understand what is happening, and fix what is configurable — you do not need to be a developer, but you need to be comfortable at the configuration and troubleshooting layer. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you will be speaking with innovation leaders, IT directors, and C\-suite stakeholders. * Strong judgment: you know when to say yes, when to say not yet, and how to position both in a way that builds trust. * Experience working in fast\-moving, commercial environments where deals are complex and timelines are tight. * Comfortable operating without a playbook; you can figure out what questions to ask and find a path forward in ambiguous situations **Nice to Have** * Experience supporting sales in a healthcare or medtech environment. * Familiarity with surgical workflows, clinical documentation, or OR technology. * Background working with enterprise IT procurement and RFP processes. * Existing relationships within hospital innovation, IT, or digital health teams.

jobs.title: Entra ID/ Active Directory Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own. We’re actively seeking a talented Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations Engineer to work in our Newport beach, CA office (preferred) or Omaha, NE office. Relocation assistance may be provided. You will be responsible for the delivery of the Entra ID and Active Directory services required to support the enterprise infrastructure and business line applications. In this role you will implement and support the associated strategy and corresponding roadmaps considering the corporate strategy, industry security trends and regulatory requirements. You will also collaborate and coordinate with other technologists and support staff to ensure the requirements are clearly defined and service level agreements are met. Finally, you will work to improve and track the maturity of the IAM services showing increased adoption, speed to market, and resiliency. **How you’ll help move us forward:** * Serve as an Active Directory and Entra ID Operations Engineer for the IAM department * Deliver and support the multi\-year plan incorporating on\-premise, cloud\-based, and hybrid directory services solutions * Deliver and support the multi\-year plan for workforce authentication leveraging SSO, MFA, and conditional access policies * Define best practice and development of troubleshooting processes, methodologies, standards, alerts and reporting from Entra ID services to be leveraged for operational monitoring * Provide monitoring and support of the integrated business applications and end\-users ensuring the required uptime and resiliency * Create solutions that drive full automation, self\-service, and resiliency * Identify, manage and escalate, as appropriate, project risks, issues, and roadblocks to timely delivery * Partner with internal technical teams ensuring the strategy and roadmaps are well understood while monitoring the successful implementation * Develop and implement program communications framework and metrics to ensure well\-informed stakeholders, customers, and IAM colleagues * Contribute to the development and maintenance of information security strategy and architecture **The experience you bring:** * 10\+ years Information Security experience, with strong focus in directory services platforms (e.g. MS Active Directory, MS Entra ID, MS Office365\) * Detailed knowledge and experience in enabling and supporting integrated Entra ID applications, Single Sign\-On, Multi\-Factor Authentication, and Conditional Access Policies * Detailed knowledge and experience in supporting cloud joined, hybrid joined, and multi\-domain enterprise directory services platforms based on best practices * Design, deploy, and manage Active Directory (AD) environments including forests, domains, OUs, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), and trusts * Troubleshoot complex AD issues related to authentication, replication, Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, and DNS * Manage AD replication, sites and services, DNS, and DHCP integration * Detailed knowledge and experience with automating processes by leveraging out of box capabilities, PowerShell/Python scripting, MS Graph, and PowerBI * Experience with Agile methodologies and corresponding Agile based tools * Proven ability to influence and gain trust at senior management levels in multi\-cultural environments * Ability to manage complex activities simultaneously to short timescales * Ability to demonstrate continuous improvement * Clear understanding of CoBIT and ITIL Frameworks **What makes you stand out:** * BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science or related field * CISSP, CISM, CISA or other relevant security certifications and knowledge of ISO and NIST security standards preferred You can be who you are. We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife \#LI\-DW1 **Base Pay Range:** The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay. $167,670\.00 \- $204,930\.00**Your Benefits Start Day 1** Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered. * Prioritization of your health and well\-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents * Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off * Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program * Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation **You Can Be Who You Are** We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential. What’s life like at Pacific Life? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife **EEO Statement:** *Pacific Life Insurance Company is an Equal Opportunity /Affirmative Action Employer, M/F/D/V. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request an accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career center as a result of your disability. To request an accommodation, contact a Human Resources Representative at Pacific Life Insurance Company.*

AI \& Automation* Find the High\-Value Use Cases: Evaluate where AI and automation can meaningfully improve productivity, decision\-making, and business processes across the organization. * Build and Prototype: Use modern AI tools to rapidly build agents, scripts, internal tools, and workflow automations that solve real business problems — and apply those same tools to your own analysis, research, modeling, and reporting. * Scale Adoption: Partner with Engineering, IT, and functional leaders to deploy what works, raise practical AI fluency across teams, and drive adoption. Strategic \& Operational Initiatives* Lead High\-Impact Projects: Own 1–2 high\-priority cross\-functional initiatives at any given time, from initial analysis and recommendation through implementation — coordinating across functions and driving accountability and follow\-through. * Redesign How Work Gets Done: Work with functional leaders to identify inefficient, redundant, or manual processes and determine the right fix: redesign, technology, automation, or elimination. * Solve Cross\-Brand Problems: Identify where shared processes, technology, data, and capabilities can be leveraged across Peaksware's brands, building the relationships needed to surface and scale them. * Measure Impact: Set clear success metrics for strategic initiatives and track results so investments translate into measurable business outcomes. Financial \& Business Analysis* Analyze Business Performance: Evaluate financial and operational performance across brands to identify trends, risks, and opportunities to improve growth, profitability, and efficiency. * Support FP\&A: Partner with Finance on forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, scenario modeling, and recurring reporting for leadership. * Build Business Cases: Develop financial models and ROI analyses to evaluate investments, headcount, technology, and other strategic decisions. **Requirements** Requirements * 2\+ years of experience in management consulting, financial advisory, corporate strategy, FP\&A, or a similarly rigorous analytical role.
