Physical Requirements: Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles. Working Conditions: Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable. Minimum Qualifications: Must be eighteen years of age or older. Must be legally permitted to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications: 3\-5 years of relevant work experience Docker, GKE \& Kubernetes fundamentals Cloud networking (i.e: Vantage, IP tables, Identity Providers). The mesh layer (Envoy \+ Wayfinder \+ Tailscale). CI/CD pipelines (Spinnaker \+ GitOps, Github, Flux CD, etc.). Cloud Admission Controllers \& tenant workload config Minimum Education: The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job. Preferred Education: No additional education Minimum Years of Work Experience: 3 Preferred Years of Work Experience: No additional years of experience Minimum Leadership Experience: None Preferred Leadership Experience: None Certifications: None Competencies: Global Perspective Manages Ambiguity Nimble Learning Self\-Development Collaborates Cultivates Innovation Situational Adaptability Communicates Effectively Drives Results Interpersonal Savvy

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description: **The** **mission** **of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It's why we have a world\-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It's why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world\-class digital and app destination. And it's why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it's worth paying for.** **About the Role, Mission or Department Overview** As a Senior Engineer, Marketing, you'll be embedded with the Marketing team, providing us with technical leadership, consulting, and systems thinking. You'll assemble the orchestration systems, integrations, and AI capabilities that help teams work faster, and in more data‑driven ways. You will lead end‑to‑end design, implementation, and management of the marketing campaign lifecycle system, integrations, internal tools, and learning/experimentation infrastructure. You will report to our Director, Advertising Systems. **Responsibilities:** * You will write high\-quality, secure, and well\-tested code, contributing to standards and documentation for Marketing infrastructure, data models, and tools * You will build the campaign lifecycle orchestration backbone * You will build integrations and internal tools that connect project management, collaboration, creative, media, and email/lifecycle platforms * You will work with Marketing partners as a technical advisor, translating needs into designs * You will integrate AI agents and automations (including LLM\-powered flows) into Marketing workflows according to company GenAI guidance * You will design and operate data pipelines and models that ingest marketing and performance data into a data layer, supporting experimentation and analytics workflows * You will deliver abstractions and APIs that ensure AI systems and our users to create campaign wrap\-ups, insights, next\-test recommendations, and more from that data * You will lead reliability, observability, and incident response for integrations, data pipelines, and automations, including monitoring, logging, alerting, auditing, feature flags for pilots, and change management. * You will demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world. **Basic Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on backend or full\-stack development for distributed systems and APIs. * Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js and experience building integrations, services, data pipelines, and internal tools (using modern frontend frameworks such as React or similar). * 5\+ years of experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth2, webhooks, and event\-driven patterns * Hands\-on experience building applications with large language models (LLMs), such as prompt flows, retrieval\-augmented generation, or AI agents, using approved GenAI tools. * 1\+ years of experience delivering production systems on cloud platforms (AWS preferred), including using serverless services (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, managed databases/queues) and CI/CD practices. * 3\+ years of experience working with marketing and performance data and supporting experimentation and analytics workflows, including designing metrics and dashboards. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 1\+ years of experience implementing or integrating campaign orchestration and workflow automation tools (such as Notion, Monday.com, Asana, or similar) into marketing or operations environments. * 1\+ years of experience working with or integrating Marketing technology stacks, such as customer data platforms (CDPs) or CRMs, ad platforms, email or lifecycle platforms, project management tools, and collaboration tools. * 1\+ years of experience partnering with data engineers and analysts to design schemas, interfaces, and experimentation frameworks that serve both BI and AI use cases. * AWS serverless expertise across services such as Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, SQS, SNS, CloudFront, and related tooling. * 1\+ years of experience with Terraform and Docker for infrastructure automation and deployments. * 1\+ years of experience configuring and using observability tooling such as DataDog, along with infrastructure\-level logging, alerting, networking, and application security. * 1\+ years of Experience with tools such as BigQuery, Hex, Mode, Statsig or similar for analytics and experimentation. REQ\-020576 **Additional Compensation and Benefits:** For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company\-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs. For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process. **Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:** We're excited to learn more about you and your experience. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Application Systems Analyst/Programmer - Staff Specialist
jobs.description: **Mission Statement** --------------------- Michigan Medicine improves the health of patients, populations and communities through excellence in education, patient care, community service, research and technology development, and through leadership activities in Michigan, nationally and internationally. Our mission is guided by our Strategic Principles and has three critical components; patient care, education and research that together enhance our contribution to society. **Job Summary** --------------- The Michigan Medicine Department of Radiation Oncology is seeking an experienced and motivated software engineering professional to build and maintain clinical applications that support safe and effective radiation therapy. This position supports team\-based workflows across a broad range of radiation therapy areas, including treatment planning, medical imaging, quality assurance, and clinical workflow automation. Alongside a dedicated team of software developers, you will collaborate with radiation oncologists, medical physicists, dosimetrists, radiation therapists, clinical informatics specialists, enterprise IT teams, and commercial system vendors. Prior healthcare or radiation oncology experience is welcome but not required. We are looking for a strong software engineer who is interested in learning the clinical domain and applying sound engineering practices to meaningful problems in patient care with a commitment to patient safety. We recognize that excellent candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If this role interests you and your experience aligns with most of the required qualifications, we encourage you to apply. **Responsibilities\*** ---------------------- **Application Development and Maintenance (60%)** * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, production support, and maintenance. * Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and related technologies. * Develop modern web\-based user interfaces using JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as Angular or React. * Build secure, scalable, maintainable, and well\-documented REST APIs and backend services. * Develop applications and interfaces that support radiation therapy planning, treatment delivery, clinical workflow, reporting, visualization, and data validation. * Translate complex clinical and operational requirements into reliable, testable, and maintainable software solutions. * Diagnose production issues, integration failures, performance problems, and data inconsistencies through structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis. * Modernize, migrate, or replace legacy and end\-of\-life applications while maintaining clinical functionality, data integrity, and continuity of operations. * Apply object\-oriented programming, design patterns, SOLID principles, clean\-code practices, secure coding, automated testing, and appropriate application architecture. **Clinical Informatics and Systems Integration (30%)** * Collaborate with clinical and technical stakeholders to design and maintain informatics tools supporting Radiation Oncology protocols and workflows. * Develop workflow applications that automate clinical data processing, validation, communication, task management, notifications, and reporting. * Develop dashboards and web applications that provide authorized users with timely access to clinical radiotherapy data and operational metrics. * Integrate applications with treatment planning systems, oncology information systems, imaging systems, databases, electronic health record platforms, vendor APIs, and institutional services. * Design and maintain relational database structures, SQL queries, stored procedures, data\-access components, interfaces, and data\-transformation processes. * Support secure clinical data exchange, mapping, reconciliation, audit logging, authentication, authorization, and role\-based access control. * Evaluate artificial intelligence, large language models, rule engines, cloud services, and other emerging technologies for appropriate use in clinical and operational workflows. **Software Quality and Documentation (10%)** * Create and maintain software requirements, architecture, design, testing, validation, deployment, support, and troubleshooting documentation. * Develop unit, integration, API, system, regression, security, and user\-acceptance testing appropriate to each application. * Participate in code reviews, architecture reviews, security reviews, testing reviews, and peer review of departmental applications. * Maintain traceability among requirements, implementation, testing, releases, and production changes. * Contribute to continuous improvement of coding standards, testing practices, CI/CD processes, monitoring, documentation, and software quality procedures. **Required Qualifications\*** ----------------  create clear software requirements, design documentation, test plans, release notes, installation guides, and support procedures. * Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary clinical and technical teams. * Ability and willingness to learn radiation oncology workflows, healthcare technologies, clinical terminology, and emerging software development practices. **Desired Qualifications\*** ---------------------------- Experience in any of the following is helpful but not required: * Healthcare, medical imaging, scientific computing, or other complex software environments. * DICOM, DICOM\-RT, DICOMweb, HL7, FHIR, or clinical system integration. * 3D visualization and medical image processing * Angular, React, REST APIs, OpenAPI, or asynchronous processing. * SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL. * CI/CD, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, deployment to Hyperscaler platforms * PowerShell scripting, Haskell * EPIC, including certification courses * System monitoring, vulnerability scanning and remediation. * Medical device development, HIPAA, accessibility, or human\-centered design. * AI, machine learning, large language models **Why Join Michigan Medicine?** ------------------------------- Michigan Medicine is one of the largest health care complexes in the world and has been the site of many groundbreaking medical and technological advancements since the opening of the U\-M Medical School in 1850\. Michigan Medicine is comprised of over 30,000 employees and our vision is to attract, inspire, and develop outstanding people in medicine, sciences, and healthcare to become one of the world's most distinguished academic health systems. In some way, great or small, every person here helps to advance this world\-class institution. Work at Michigan Medicine and become a victor for the greater good. **What Benefits can you Look Forward to?** * Excellent medical, dental and vision coverage effective on your very first day * 2:1 Match on retirement savings **Modes of Work** ----------------- Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes. **Background Screening** ------------------------ Michigan Medicine conducts background screening and pre\-employment drug testing on job candidates upon acceptance of a contingent job offer and may use a third party administrator to conduct background screenings. Background screenings are performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Report Act. Pre\-employment drug testing applies to all selected candidates, including new or additional faculty and staff appointments, as well as transfers from other U\-M campuses. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ Job openings are posted for a minimum of seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. **U\-M EEO Statement** ---------------------- The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Job Opening ID** 283275 ### **Working Title** Application Systems Analyst/Programmer \- Staff Specialist ### **Job Title** App Sys Anlst/Prgm Staff Spec ### **Work Location** Michigan Medicine \- Ann Arbor Ann Arbor, MI ### **Modes of Work** Hybrid ### **Full/Part Time** Full\-Time ### **Regular/Temporary** Regular ### **FLSA Status** Exempt ### **Organizational Group** Um Hospital ### **Department** MM Radiation Oncology ### **Posting Begin/End Date** 9/22/2026 \- 11/06/2026 ### **Career Interest** Information Technology

jobs.description: Kick start your civil engineering career where your work supports high\-impact mission critical and data center infrastructure across the Southeast. When you join Thomas \& Hutton, you'll discover a career with real purpose. We equip you with cutting\-edge tools, technology, and software to work efficiently and excel. Our career development programs, including PaTHways and T\&H University, combine with approachable leadership and a collaborative environment to support your professional growth at every stage. Pair that with industry leading benefits, genuine work\-life balance, and meaningful opportunities to give back through T\&H Helping Hands, and it's clear why so many professionals choose to grow their careers here. Learn more at www.thomasandhutton.com **Please note:** Sponsorship is not available for this position. Thomas \& Hutton is a Drug\-Free Workplace and an E\-Verify participant. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified minorities, women, veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer / Architect – AI, CoCounsel FDE
jobs.description: **Job Description** Are you a Principal\-level software engineer who enjoys solving complex customer problems while remaining deeply hands\-on with technology? Thomson Reuters is looking for a **Principal Software Engineer / Architect – AI, CoCounsel Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)** to help design, build, and deliver production AI solutions for some of our most complex customer environments. This is a highly technical, hands\-on individual contributor role. You will work directly with customers, product teams, and engineers to understand difficult business and technical problems, architect solutions, and personally contribute production code. You will also help translate what we learn from customer engagements into scalable capabilities that strengthen the broader CoCounsel product. We are looking for someone who combines **Principal\-level architecture and technical leadership with strong hands\-on engineering skills** . This is not an architecture\-only or advisory role. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead highly complex technical and customer engagements from discovery through production delivery. * Architect, build, and deploy production AI solutions within customer and enterprise environments. * Write production code regularly and review the work of Senior, Staff, and Forward Deployed Engineers. * Provide technical direction across complex AI, software architecture, integration, security, and deployment decisions. * Work directly with customers to understand their technical environments, constraints, and business needs. * Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer learnings into scalable product capabilities. * Identify patterns across client engagements and recommend improvements to the core CoCounsel platform. * Guide engineers through complex technical challenges through hands\-on development, architecture reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership. * Influence technical strategy across Forward Deployed Engineering and related product and engineering teams. * Evaluate new technologies and approaches that improve AI delivery, reliability, scalability, and customer outcomes. * Communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineering teams, product leaders, executives, and customer stakeholders. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description: **About ThredUp** ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale\-as\-a\-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry. Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022\. **How You Will Make An Impact** A generation of shoppers is starting to find what they want by asking an AI agent instead of browsing a website. The marketplaces those agents can read, understand, and buy from will win that traffic; the ones they can't won't get surfaced at all. As our first Senior Software Engineer for Agentic Commerce, you'll build the layer that makes 4 million unique secondhand items discoverable and transactable by AI shopping agents, and own how ThredUp shows up when someone asks an agent to find them a dress for a wedding. This is early, open territory. The standards are young, customer behaviors are still forming, and there's no established playbook to follow. You'll partner closely with engineering and product leadership to give the space shape — working out what's worth building, making the architectural decisions together, and getting real functionality in front of customers to learn from. For the first stretch you'll be the primary engineer on this work, with broad ownership of how it comes together. You'll report to our Senior Director of Engineering. **In This Role You'll Get To:** * Design and build the agentic\-commerce layer end to end — from exposing our catalog, pricing, and inventory to AI shopping agents through cart, checkout, and order handoff — defining the integration surface rather than inheriting one. * Own how ThredUp gets discovered and surfaced by LLM\-driven shopping agents, including the structured data that makes 4M\+ unique, single\-SKU items legible to machines. * Prototype quickly against real agent platforms, then harden what proves out into production\-grade services — working across the stack, wherever the problem lives. * Use AI tools and agentic workflows as a core part of how you build, setting the bar for what AI\-native engineering looks like at ThredUp. * Partner with engineering, product, and executive leadership to turn an undefined space into a roadmap, carry it from idea to shipped, and let real customer usage drive what comes next. * Our stack: Ruby on Rails, Java/JVM, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, Sidekiq, OpenSearch, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform. Apollo GraphQL API gateway. React, PWA, native iOS and Android. No prior experience with any particular piece required. **What We're Looking For:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, owning systems end to end from ambiguous problem to production. * Fluent daily use of LLMs and agentic coding tools, with strong instincts for where AI output needs human judgment. * Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, and an understanding of how model behavior shapes product experience. * Strong API and integration design skills, for interfaces consumed by other systems rather than by people. * Depth in backend engineering with the range to work across the stack. Design judgment matters more here than which languages you've used. * Genuine curiosity about a space that changes monthly — new protocols, new tooling, new model capabilities — and the habit of keeping up with it. * Comfort working from a blank page without a surrounding team to make progress. * The judgment to scope a problem, put a plan behind it, and drive it to shipped rather than exploring indefinitely. * Clear communication with engineers and non\-technical executives alike. * Familiarity with the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), MCP, or other emerging agentic\-commerce standards is a plus. * E\-commerce or marketplace experience is a plus. * Experience having built something from zero, whether at a startup or inside a larger company is a plus. Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock, ThredUp employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, as well as a discount when purchasing ThredUp stock if voluntarily participating in ThredUp's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Subject to eligibility requirements, you'll also receive other benefits: Comprehensive medical \& dental coverage, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. **What We Offer:** * 4\-day work week, with most Fridays off * Competitive salary (we leverage market data) * Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards * Employee stock purchase plan * Flexible PTO (take the time you need) \+ 13 company holidays * Paid Sabbatical after 3 years of full time employment * Generous paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers * Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance offered * We live by our Core Values of Transparency, SpeakingUP, Thinking Big, Infinite Learning, Influencing Outcomes \& Seeking the Truth **We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team** At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one\-of\-a\-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you. If you are a candidate with a disability and have a reasonable accommodation request for the job application process, please email *disabilitysupport@ThredUp.com* the specific details of your disability related accommodation request. This email address is reserved for candidates with disabilities only. General application inquiries will not receive a response.

jobs.description: Tiger Analytics is a fast\-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. jobs.title: Network Engineer I
jobs.description: Transcor Data Services provides the ground transportation industry with the most advanced systems designed to maximize efficiency and revenue without maximizing costs. Our advanced applications and SaaS (Software as a Service) solutions integrate data and coordinate booking functionality across multiple platforms and sales channels globally. **Job Summary** As a Network Engineer I, you will be a core team member delivering digital business transformation solutions to our clients. You will assist in the day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of our cloud and on\-premises network infrastructure while learning from senior engineers. In this role, you will also leverage modern AI platforms including Claude AI to accelerate scripting, streamline technical documentation, and assist with network operations. **Duties/Responsibilities** * Assists in configuring, maintaining, and monitoring local, metropolitan, and wide area networks. * Supports department staff in maintaining routers, switches, firewalls, and cloud networks. * Assists senior engineers in implementing network architectures, topologies, hardware, software, transmission, signaling links, and protocols into complete configurations. * Leverages Claude AI and generative AI tools to assist in drafting network scripts, summarizing system logs, and producing technical runbooks. * Actively builds and maintains positive relationships with internal user communities and vendors to understand business needs. * Performs, documents, and communicates basic network health checks, routine installations, and performance evaluations. * Supports department staff in the analysis, solution, and documentation of network issues and tickets. * Escalates complex errors or high\-impact incidents to senior team members for advanced resolution. * Learns and adheres to department network design policies, standards, and security procedures. * Actively solicits feedback and guidance on best practices from management and senior engineers. * Continually enhances knowledge of network engineering concepts and company standards for professional growth. * Contributes to existing technical documentation, runbooks, and educational content based on system updates and user feedback. * Triages initial product or system issues by analyzing basic log sources and assessing the impact on hardware, network, or service quality. * Tracks all work time accurately across assigned tickets and projects. **Required Skills/Abilities** * Foundational understanding of physical architecture, interconnect firewalls, and basic setup procedures. * Basic knowledge of Google Cloud Networking concepts and cloud infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience or familiarity with using Claude AI (or similar AI assistants) for code/script generation, query building, and technical troubleshooting. * Ability to assist in creating, reviewing, and updating basic network diagrams and documentation in Google Cloud. * Familiarity with setting up and maintaining VPN connections between on\-premises and cloud (GCP) environments. * Basic understanding of external hub\-and\-spoke ingress/egress configurations. * General knowledge of Google DNS services, subnets, shared VPCs, and load balancers. * Basic exposure to or interest in working with Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Diligent time\-tracking habits across projects and ticketing tools. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience/certifications). * 0–2 years of hands\-on experience in cloud, server, or network administration. * Practical exposure to utilizing Claude AI or equivalent AI tools within standard engineering workflows preferred. * Basic exposure to shared VPCs, firewalls, subnets, VPN tunneling, and load balancing. * Entry\-level cloud or network certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network\+, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, or CCNA) are a plus.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description: About Trexquant Trexquant is a systematic investment firm focused on building the research and trading infrastructure required to discover and deploy quantitative strategies across global markets. Our mission is to build a platform that enables researchers to backtest and implement almost any type of cross\-region and cross\-asset alpha idea. We want researchers to be able to move efficiently from an investment hypothesis to simulation, evaluation, and ultimately production trading. Achieving this requires much more than building a backtester. It requires an integrated research and trading platform that supports multiple asset classes, regions, data sources, execution venues, brokers, and counterparties. The Role We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer who can turn this vision into an executable plan and ensure that the organization delivers on it. The COO will work closely with the CEO and leaders across research, engineering, trading, data, operations, and other functions to establish clear goals, assign ownership, identify dependencies, and drive projects through completion. This is a highly execution\-oriented role. We are looking for someone who can take ambitious, sometimes loosely defined objectives and translate them into concrete projects with measurable milestones and accountable owners. Key Responsibilities * Translate Trexquant's strategic vision into clear, measurable company\-wide goals and execution plans. * Drive the development of a unified research and trading platform capable of supporting cross\-region and cross\-asset quantitative strategies. * Coordinate research, engineering, data, trading, execution, and operational teams to ensure that the necessary infrastructure is delivered. * Establish priorities, milestones, ownership, and timelines for major initiatives and continuously track progress against them. * Identify bottlenecks and dependencies that prevent researchers from moving efficiently from an idea to backtest to production. * Help expand the firm's capabilities across equities, futures, corporate bonds, options, ETFs, FX, and other asset classes. * Coordinate the operational infrastructure required to trade across multiple markets, brokers, counterparties, and execution venues. * Develop scalable processes that allow the organization to continue executing effectively as the firm grows. * Hold teams accountable for results while helping remove organizational and technical obstacles. * Continuously look for opportunities to automate processes and use AI to make research, engineering, trading, and operations more efficient. **Requirements** What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is an exceptional operator who combines strategic thinking with a strong bias toward execution. You should be comfortable working across highly technical teams and understanding complex systems well enough to identify the important problems, ask the right questions, establish priorities, and ensure that they are solved. We value candidates who: * Have demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional organizations or initiatives. * Are exceptionally strong at setting goals and driving execution. * Can break large, ambiguous problems into concrete and manageable projects. * Understand technology and quantitative systems sufficiently to work effectively with researchers and engineers. * Can coordinate many simultaneous initiatives without losing sight of the firm's larger objectives. * Create accountability through clear ownership and measurable outcomes. * Are intellectually curious and willing to learn unfamiliar areas quickly. * Are comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment where priorities evolve as new opportunities emerge. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means steadily removing the barriers between a researcher's idea and its implementation. Over time, a Trexquant researcher should be able to formulate a cross\-asset or cross\-region investment hypothesis, access the necessary data, backtest it accurately, evaluate it, and deploy it to production through a common platform with increasingly little manual infrastructure work. The COO's responsibility is to help organize and drive the company toward making that vision a reality. **Benefits** * Competitive salary with performance\-based bonus. * Collaborative, casual, and friendly work environment. * PPO health, dental, and vision insurance fully covered for you and your dependents. * Pre\-tax commuter benefits. * Weekly company\-provided meals. The base salary range is $200,000 to $300,000, depending on candidates’ educational and professional background. Base salary is only one part of Trexquant’s total compensation, which may include a discretionary and performance based bonus. Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Details:** **Job Summary** Tyson Foods is seeking a motivated and curious Data Engineer I to join the Inventory Optimization organization. Inventory Optimization brings together Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Enterprise Inventory Management (EIM), and Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) into one department focused on improving inventory visibility, data quality, operational efficiency, working capital performance, and enterprise value creation. This is a foundational career\-development position designed for individuals who are eager to learn, solve problems, and build expertise across business, technology, finance, operations, and data management disciplines. Successful candidates are not expected to enter the role with expertise in every area of responsibility. Instead, they will be provided opportunities to learn through hands\-on execution, mentorship, project participation, and exposure to multiple business functions. The Data Engineer I will support data, systems, reporting, governance, and business process activities associated with assets, direct materials, work\-in\-process, finished goods, packaging, spare parts, operational supplies, and related financial information. This role works closely with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, and Information Technology teams to ensure enterprise data remains accurate, reliable, and actionable. **Why This Role Exists** Our department believes that great solutions begin by understanding the problem. We encourage team members to ask questions, challenge assumptions, improve processes, automate repetitive work, and connect data to measurable business value. We are building a culture where curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement are just as important as technical capability. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning, seeks diverse experiences, and wants to build a career at the intersection of operations, inventory management, engineering, finance, analytics, and technology. \- **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Support inventory, asset, and operational data management activities across EAM, EIM, and MRO business processes. * Assist with data validation, reconciliation, correction, and reporting activities. * Maintain master data records in SAP and connected systems according to established standards. * Support business users with reporting, system questions, issue resolution, and application support activities. * Participate in inventory optimization, data quality, governance, analytics, and process improvement initiatives. * Help document business processes, system configurations, standards, and procedures. * Assist with dashboard creation, report development, and analysis that support operational and financial decision\-making. Collaboration and Development * Collaborate with team members and business partners to complete assigned projects, support day\-to\-day operations, and communicate findings effectively. * Learn and apply data, systems, and business knowledge to support inventory optimization initiatives across Finance, Operations, Maintenance, Engineer, and IT * Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and improvement through curiosity, clear communication, and reliable execution. **Requirements:** Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree preferred in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience will also be considered. Experience: 0–2 years of relevant work experience. College projects will be considered. Computer Skills: Above\-standard computer skills needed. Prior SAP experience is not required, and candidates are not expected to arrive fluent in asset accounting, maintenance operations, or inventory management. A demonstrated willingness to learn SAP S/4HANA and the business processes behind it is essential. Foundational data handling skills such as advanced Excel, introductory SQL, or exposure to Python, with genuine interest in analytics platforms including Power BI, Palantir, or Tableau. AI platforms exposure preferred. Special Skills: Interest in manufacturing, supply chain, or asset\-intensive environments, and a desire to understand how fixed assets, direct materials, and spare parts drive cost, cash, and capital decisions. Strong attention to detail, disciplined follow\-through, and the judgment to escalate a question early rather than proceed on an assumption. Supervisory: none Open to travel to manufacturing sites and project locations as needed up to 50% of the year. **This position does not offer any sponsorship benefits. Resume must be included to be considered for the role.** **This position will not offer any relocation benefits. Priority consideration will be given to qualified candidates who currently reside in the local area. Candidates who are willing to self\-relocate may be considered after the initial review of local applicants.** **This is not a remote position and the selected candidate will be working on\-site.** **Relocation Assistance Eligible:** No **Work Shift:** 1ST SHIFT (United States of America) **Certain roles at Tyson require background checks. If you are offered a position that requires a background check you will be provided additional documentation to complete once an offer has been extended.** Hourly Applicants ONLY \-You must complete the task after submitting your application to provide additional information to be considered for employment. The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation. Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status. We provide our team members and their families with paid time off; 401(k) plans; affordable health, life, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; and more. **If you would like to learn more about your data privacy rights and how you may use that information, please read our Job Applicant Privacy Notice** **here** **.** Unsolicited Assistance: Tyson Foods and its subsidiaries do not accept unsolicited support from external recruitment vendors for open positions within the United States. Any resumes or candidate profiles submitted by recruitment vendors or headhunters to any employee or applicant tracking system at Tyson Foods or its subsidiaries, without a valid written request and search agreement approved by HR, will be considered the property of Tyson Foods. No fees will be paid if the candidate is hired due to an unsolicited referral.

Brings recognized expertise in specific technical areas to bear on in\-depth evaluation of variable factors affecting system design and performance. **Apply By Date** 10/5/2026 at 11:59pm THIS IS AVAILABLE TO EMPLOYEES IN THE DEPARTMENT OF RISK \& SAFETY SOLUTIONS ONLY. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications \- For full consideration, applicants are encouraged to upload license and/or certification if required of the position** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology or related ﬁeld. * Experience programming JavaScript web applications using responsive single page application frameworks (such as Angular, ReactJS, Ember). * Experience programming Java web applications using a combination of related technologies including HTML, XML, CSS, JavaScript, Spring Framework. * Experience with JavaScript and Java testing frameworks (such as Mocha, Jasmin, Karma, JUnit); Experience designing and implementing complex database application systems and user\-centered Web interfaces including the integration of advanced web applications. * Experience reviewing and producing technical policies, recommendations and analysis; Experience developing architectural solutions based on multi\-tier architecture and web development tools. * At least three years of professional software development experience, including maintaining and troubleshooting applications in a production environment using a combination of full\-stack and AI technologies. * Knowledge of programming techniques including analysis, flow charting, design, work measurement, data collection, and workflow processing. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience interpreting business functions and objectives to technical solutions. jobs.title: Consultant, Software Engineering
jobs.description: **Lead. Innovate. Grow. Make An Impact.** UDig is seeking an Engineering Consultant who is ready to own their work, grow their consulting craft, and deliver real value to clients across a range of industries. This is the core delivery role at UDig — you'll contribute meaningfully to complex engineering engagements, develop independent judgment on technical problems, and begin building the client relationships that define a consulting career. You bring 3–5 years of hands\-on engineering experience and are ready to do more than execute tickets. **Why Top Consultants Choose UDig:** * **Career Growth —** Own your path with UDig Elevate, offering a clear trajectory for career growth and leadership opportunities. * **Consulting with Purpose —** Contribute to real solutions that directly impact clients from your first day. * **Flexibility \& Balance —** Hybrid work environment with opportunities for high\-caliber in\-person collaboration. * **Investment in You —** $1,500 annual training budget, mentorship, and hands\-on learning. * **Competitive Compensation —** Strong salary, performance\-based bonuses, and career progression. * **Comprehensive Benefits —** PTO, parental leave, 401(k) match, health, dental, vision, and more. **What You'll Do:** * Deliver full\-stack engineering solutions as a contributing team member on client engagements — backend, frontend, and data\-integrated systems. * Design, build, and deploy cloud\-native applications following established architectural patterns and engineering standards. * Actively incorporate AI\-assisted development into your daily workflow — using AI tools to accelerate implementation, review, and testing — and share what's working with your team. * Participate in and contribute to code and design reviews, agile ceremonies, and delivery check\-ins with increasing confidence. * Begin engaging directly with client stakeholders: presenting work, asking clarifying questions, and translating technical concepts for non\-technical audiences. * Mentor Associate Consultants through code reviews, pairing, and sharing hard\-won lessons. * Identify and surface opportunities to improve delivery quality or team practices on your engagements. **What You'll Bring:** * 3–5 years of experience in software or data engineering, ideally with exposure to client\-facing or consulting environments. * Technical delivery ownership: you take end\-to\-end accountability for the features and systems you build. * Developing consulting instincts — you think about the client's problem, not just the engineering task. * Strong problem decomposition instincts — you consider edge cases, weigh tradeoffs between approaches, and can explain your technical decisions clearly. * Proficiency in backend API development and at least one frontend framework (e.g., React, Angular, Vue); comfortable working across multiple languages and frameworks. * Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), relational databases, and DevOps fundamentals (CI/CD, containerization). * Comfort navigating both software and data engineering contexts — reading from and writing to data systems, contributing to pipelines, and understanding how data shapes product decisions. * Active fluency with AI development tools — you use them regularly, can evaluate their output critically, and are building your own practices around AI\-assisted delivery. * Experience building software in enterprise team settings, following established standards and contributing to shared codebases. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical work to varied audiences. * Previous consulting or client management experience is preferred. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience. **Join UDig — Where Consulting Meets Innovation.** UDig is a technology consulting firm dedicated to delivering high\-impact solutions that have driven client success for over 20 years. Our team collaborates directly with clients, taking a consultative approach to turning complex challenges into successful projects that deliver business value. By harnessing expertise, innovation, and connections, we achieve extraordinary outcomes across multiple verticals. At UDig, we're more than consultants — we're problem solvers, mentors, and innovators. If you're ready to dig into your first career chapter and build alongside people who take the craft seriously, let's talk. \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-JS1

jobs.title: Communications Engineer I, II
jobs.description: We are looking for talented individuals who are passionate about making an impact in the company and the community. **Apply now** and become part of the dynamic energy industry! Help power the future of critical infrastructure. Join our team and play a key role in designing, building, and securing the communications networks that support electric transmission, distribution, substations, and smart grid technologies across our service territory. **What You Will Do** * Design, engineer, and support telecommunications and operational network solutions that enable reliable electric system operations. * Develop and maintain fiber optic, microwave, RF, wireless, and IP/MPLS communications networks for substations, control centers, and field operations. * Support SCADA, AMI, grid automation, and tele\-protection systems by ensuring secure and dependable data communications. * Lead or assist with telecom and operational network projects, including planning, budgeting, design, implementation, and vendor coordination. * Monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, implement upgrades, and maintain cybersecurity and regulatory compliance standards. Create engineering designs, technical documentation, network standards, and project specifications while collaborating with cross\-functional utility and IT teams. * **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET\-accredited institution; Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. * Knowledge of networking fundamentals including switching, routing, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, STP, WAN technologies, and IP/MPLS networks. * Experience or interest in critical infrastructure communications systems, including fiber optics, RF, microwave, wireless, and operational technology networks. * Understanding of network security principles, firewalls, cybersecurity frameworks, and industrial protocols such as DNP3 and IEC 61850\. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and project coordination skills with the ability to work effectively across teams. For Engineer II consideration, relevant utility, industrial networking, or telecommunications experience and industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or Nokia NRS are preferred. * This is an exciting opportunity to help design and maintain the communications infrastructure that keeps the electric grid safe, secure, and reliable while supporting the modernization of critical utility operations. **Position Description:** Responsible for the planning, engineering, design, implementation, management and administration of mission critical communications infrastructure that encompasses the Unisource Transmission and Distribution Telecommunications system and operational network infrastructure for Unisource’s substation LAN/WAN. This includes networks for SCADA, Data Center interconnection, AMI, services for substation corporate and security networks, and smart grid systems, with a focus on reliability, security, and performance. The ideal candidate will have experience in network and security architecture, RF system design, communications facility planning and design, and hands\-on expertise in configuring and managing switches, routers, and firewalls and advance protocols such as IP/MPLS—particularly Nokia service routers and Siemens/Ruggedcom industrial networking devices. Create engineered designs and documentation for new and existing communications facilities and infrastructure for substation projects and other company wide communication application needs. The creation and administration of Ethernet and other networks for multiple Wide Area Networks. Perform engineering studies and evaluate alternative designs or processes related to communication equipment and networks. Develop project scopes of work that specify material and estimate time and material costs required for assigned projects and assist in the evaluation of suppliers and products. Act as a project engineer for communications projects as well as train less experienced personnel. **Position\-Related Responsibilities:** * Design network and telecommunications solutions for Unisource and its subsidiaries with an emphasis on integration between companies and flexible solutions that are cost\-effective and scalable for effective control, monitoring, protection and maintenance of electrical generation, high voltage transmission, and distribution systems. As well as provide Corporate Voice and Data Transport Communications Systems. * Wide range of communications and computer networking experience required to manage networks and intelligent electronic devices utilizing different telecommunications equipment. Specific knowledge about Ethernet networks and Wide Area Network (WAN) skills to compliment a telecommunications knowledgebase. * Lead or support telecom and operational network related capital projects, including planning, budgeting, and execution. * Engineer, design, deploy, and maintain fiber  proper operation and/or maintenance of equipment. Provide technical assistance to the Electronics Construction \& Maintenance Section. * Assist in divisional O \& M and Capital Budget preparation and adherence. * Internal and external representation of section responsibilities, requirements, methods and procedures. * Initiate job tasks (work orders) and track expenditures as may be required to complete Capital Budget project assignments. Lead formal and informal meetings concerning assigned projects and can communicate effectively with all levels of personnel both in the office and field crews. * Collaborate with substations engineering, protection, metering \& control, IT, and operations teams to ensure alignment of telecom and operational network infrastructure with utility needs * Develop and provide detailed design specifications for bidding and purchase requirements. * Evaluate and recommend equipment and/or components available to meet project requirements or improve existing installations in a way which optimizes cost and reliability. * Ensure compliance with NERC CIP, IEEE, FCC, and other regulatory standards. This position may provide services to affiliates of the Company subject to the UNS Energy Code of Conduct and the related Policies and Procedures. * **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** (Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.) * Strong knowledge of switching and routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP, STP, VLANs) and IP/MPLS technologies. * Experience with network monitoring tools and cybersecurity frameworks for critical infrastructure. * Knowledge of grid modernization initiatives and utility automation systems. * Experience with communications facility design including structural, electrical, and environmental considerations. Fiber optic systems, microwave radio, and wireless technologies. * Proficiency in RF system design and deployment, including propagation modeling and site planning. * Strong understanding of SCADA protocols (e.g., DNP3, IEC 61850\), IP networking, and cybersecurity principles. * Experience in developing and implementing security architecture for telecom and operational networks, including firewall design, configuration, and ongoing management. * FCC license management. Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and project management skills. * **Level I Description:** * Will have primary responsibility for small modification or revision projects. * Will assist more experienced personnel in large projects. * Will assist in the review and revision of material and design standards. Requires close supervision and detailed instruction for tasks and expected results. * Minimum Qualifications: * BS degree in Engineering, from an ABET accredited institution, with less than two (2\) years professional experience in an engineering role. * Effective written and oral communication skills required and a willingness to learn in a rapidly changing environment. Enterprise networking aptitude is required. * Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications Engineering, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or related discipline is preferred. * **Level II Description:** * Will have primary responsibility for medium sized projects and act as the project engineer/manager. * May be assigned to perform technical studies as needed. * May have several projects assigned at the same time. * Requires close supervision on new aspects of assignments. Assists more experienced personnel on projects and deals with day\-to\-day support. * Minimum Qualifications: * Requires two or more years of experience as an Engineer I or a Master’s degree or qualifications for Engineer I plus a industrial/operational network background. Industry certifications, CCNA, CCNP, NRS I/II or equivalent. * Shall have strong analytical capabilities. * Requires self\-direction and the ability to work with vendors on creating statements of work and completing that work.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview:** As a Data Engineer at US Tiger Securities, you will support the company’s data platform and work with cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable data pipelines, reports, data services, and interface applications for business users. The ideal candidate has strong SQL and Python skills, hands\-on experience with data pipelines and orchestration, and the ability to debug data issues across database, streaming, batch processing, and BI systems. **Key Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain reliable batch and near\-real\-time data pipelines using Python, SQL, Airflow, Kafka, Flink, Spark, Hive, Doris, DataSight, or similar technologies. * Identify recurring reporting or data service needs and implement reusable internal solutions. Experience with Python, Java, Django, and JavaScript debugging is helpful. * Develop and maintain data interfaces for internal and external systems using RESTful APIs and message queue technologies such as Apache Kafka or IBM MQ. * Help troubleshoot, monitor, and improve data platform components across TiDB, Kafka, Flink, Hive, Spark, Doris, DataSight, and AWS services such as EC2, Docker, RDS, Redshift, and S3\. **Qualifications:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. * Minimum of 3 years of experience in a data engineering or data platform role. * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with relational databases or analytical databases. * Proficiency in Python; Java experience is a plus. * Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines. * Experience with Apache Airflow or another workflow orchestration tool. * Ability to debug production data issues across logs, SQL queries, pipeline jobs, and application interfaces. * Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is required, as the role will involve collaboration with Mandarin\-speaking engineering and business stakeholders. **Preferred:** * Experience with TiDB, Kafka, Flink, Hive, Spark, Doris, and DataSight, or a comparable real\-time/batch data warehouse architecture. * Experience with Kafka, CDC, streaming data processing, and IBM MQ is a big plus. * Experience with Spark/PySpark, Flink/PyFlink, Hive, or Doris performance tuning and data modeling. * Experience with Django, RESTful APIs, JavaScript, and web debugging tools. * Experience with AWS and related cloud technologies, including EC2, Docker, RDS, Redshift, and S3\. **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Job Types: Full\-time, Internship Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Python: 1 year (Required) * SQL: 1 year (Required) Language: * Mandarin (Required) Location: * New York, NY 10022 (Required) Ability to Commute: * New York, NY 10022 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10022

jobs.title: CIRES / NOAA Chemical Sciences Laboratory, Research Scientist in Atmospheric Chemistry Measurements and Modeling
jobs.description: Requisition Number: 74870 Location: Boulder, Colorado City Boulder State Colorado Employment Type: Research Faculty Schedule: Full\-Time Posting Close Date: 24\-Sep\-2026 Date Posted: 22\-Sep\-2026 ### **Job Summary** The Cooperative Institute for Research in Environmental Sciences (CIRES) at the University of Colorado Boulder encourages applications for a Research Scientist in atmospheric chemistry within NOAA's Chemical Sciences Laboratory (CSL) in Boulder, Colorado. This role works within CSL's Atmospheric Composition and Chemical Processes (ACCP) program alongside federal and university scientists investigating atmospheric composition and the chemical and physical processes that influence air quality, the ozone layer, and climate. This role will lead and contribute to research combining innovative in situ measurements with atmospheric chemical modeling to investigate reactive trace gases and aerosols from the lower troposphere through the upper troposphere and lower stratosphere (UTLS). A major component of the position will involve leadership in the development, characterization, deployment, and scientific application of chemical ionization mass spectrometry (CIMS) and complementary instrumentation for aircraft and ground\-based atmospheric measurements. The scientist will also integrate field observations with chemical transport and process models to improve understanding and representation of atmospheric chemistry. This position is intended for a scientist capable of independently developing research directions, leading instrument and field measurement activities, initiating collaborations, mentoring junior researchers, and contributing to the development and funding of future research projects. The successful candidate will join CSL's highly collaborative research groups and work alongside scientists within NOAA, CIRES, and the broader national and international atmospheric chemistry community. CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. ### **Who We Are** CIRES is an internationally recognized leader in innovative environmental science and research and is located at the University of Colorado Boulder. At CIRES, more than 900 environmental science professionals work to understand the dynamic Earth system, including people’s relationship with the planet. CIRES has partnered with NOAA since 1967, and our areas of expertise include weather and climate, changes at Earth’s poles, air quality and atmospheric chemistry, water resources, solid Earth sciences, and more. Our vision is to be instrumental in ensuring a sustainable future environment by advancing scientific and societal understanding of the Earth system. The NOAA Chemical Sciences Laboratory (CSL) conducts research to advance scientific understanding of the chemical and physical processes that affect Earth's atmospheric composition and climate. Within CSL, the Atmospheric Composition and Chemical Processes program investigates atmospheric constituents and chemical processes affecting air quality, the ozone layer, and climate. ACCP scientists conceive, construct, develop, and deploy advanced instrumentation to measure atmospheric trace gases and aerosols from ground\-based and airborne platforms and interpret these observations using laboratory studies and atmospheric models. These efforts support major national and international field campaigns and provide fundamental understanding of the processes controlling atmospheric composition. ### **What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be** * **Lead development, characterization, and deployment of advanced atmospheric instrumentation (25%).** Lead the development, optimization, operation, and scientific application of chemical ionization mass spectrometry and complementary instrumentation for measurements of reactive trace gases and aerosols, with particular emphasis on airborne measurements in the upper troposphere and lower stratosphere. * **Lead and participate in atmospheric field research (20%).** Develop measurement strategies and lead or participate in domestic and international airborne and ground\-based field campaigns. Coordinate instrument integration, field operations, mission science planning, and collaboration with other instrument investigators and project scientists. * **Conduct independent scientific analysis and research (20%).** Analyze and interpret complex, multi\-instrument atmospheric datasets to investigate chemical and physical processes controlling atmospheric composition. Develop new research questions and integrate observations from multiple measurement platforms and complementary datasets. * **Integrate atmospheric observations and chemical modeling (15%).**  stdoctoral research experience or equivalent professional research experience in atmospheric chemistry or a closely related field. * Proven experience conducting independent atmospheric research using advanced instrumentation, atmospheric observations, and atmospheric chemical models. * Demonstrated experience leading research activities, instrumentation projects, or field measurement activities. * Proven record of communicating scientific results through peer\-reviewed publications and presentations at national or international scientific meetings. ### **What You Will Need** * Expertise in atmospheric chemistry and the chemical and physical processes controlling atmospheric composition. * Expertise in the development, operation, and scientific application of advanced instrumentation for measurements of atmospheric trace gases or aerosols. * Strong skills in scientific data processing, analysis, visualization, and interpretation. * Ability to independently develop research questions and lead collaborative scientific activities. * Ability to work effectively with scientists, engineers, technical staff, students, and collaborators in a multidisciplinary research environment. * Excellent written and verbal scientific communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple research priorities and provide scientific and technical leadership. ### **What We Would Like You to Have** Please note that while the position details both required and preferred skills and experience, we invite applicants to apply even if they do not have the preferred skills outlined in this section. If you meet the requirements and have passion for the work, you are encouraged to apply. We encourage on the job training for any additional skills or knowledge that become relevant to the position. * Experience with chemical ionization time\-of\-flight mass spectrometry (CIMS) or related mass spectrometric techniques for atmospheric measurements. * Experience developing/deploying instrumentation aboard high\-altitude research aircraft. * Experience conducting measurements and research in the upper troposphere/ lower stratosphere. * Experience with global atmospheric chemical transport models such as GEOS\-Chem. * Experience integrating aircraft, ground\-based, satellite, and/or monitoring\-network observations with atmospheric models. * Experience developing or modifying atmospheric chemical mechanisms, heterogeneous chemistry schemes, or aerosol process representations in numerical models. * Experience with Python, MATLAB, Fortran, high\-performance computing, and/or cloud computing environments. * Experience preparing competitive research proposals and developing domestic or international scientific collaborations. * Experience supervising or mentoring students, postdoctoral researchers, or technical staff. ### **Special Instructions** To apply, please submit the following materials: * A current resume. * A cover letter that specifically tells us how your background and experience align with the requirements, qualifications, and responsibilities of the position. We will request professional references at a later time. If you are selected as the finalist, your degree will be verified by the CU Boulder Campus Human Resources department using an approved online vendor. If your degree was obtained outside of the United States, please submit a translated version as an optional attachment. Please apply by **September 24, 2026** for consideration. Note: Application materials will not be accepted via email. For consideration, please apply through CU Boulder Jobs. In compliance with the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. #### **Posting Contact Information** **Posting Contact Name:** Alexandre Baron **Posting Contact Email:** alex.baron@colorado.edu

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Site Reliability
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we're united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that's both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We're proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn't mean distant. We're intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026\), you'll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you're energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we'd love to hear from you. **The Team** ------------ Upstart's Site Reliability Engineering team enables engineers to operate reliable, resilient, and observable production systems at scale. We build the platforms, tooling, automation, and operational practices that help teams understand system health, respond effectively when things go wrong, and continuously improve the reliability of the services they own. Our goal is to make reliability an integrated part of how software operates at Upstart. We provide shared observability and reliability capabilities, improve incident response and operational readiness, automate recurring operational work, and use system and customer data to identify where reliability investments will have the greatest impact. SRE partners closely with product engineering, Cloud Platform, Delivery, Developer Platform, Security, and other infrastructure teams. SRE provides shared reliability capabilities and operational practices, while engineering teams remain accountable for the reliability and operation of the services they build. **The Role** ------------ As a Software Engineer on the Site Reliability Engineering team, you will build and operate systems that improve the reliability, resiliency, and observability of Upstart's production environment. You will work across observability platforms, reliability tooling, incident response systems, operational automation, and resiliency capabilities. You will independently deliver well scoped engineering projects, contribute to technical design, and use production data and operational experience to improve systems used across engineering. We are looking for engineers who are thoughtful and intentional about how AI changes software development and operations. You should be comfortable using AI throughout the engineering lifecycle, including understanding unfamiliar systems, investigating production behavior, planning implementation, accelerating development, validating changes, and automating repetitive work. We expect engineers to continually develop more effective ways of working with increasingly capable AI tools and to apply sound engineering judgment to where they provide the most leverage. **How you'll make an impact** ----------------------------- * Build and improve the tooling, services, and automation that help engineers understand and improve the reliability of production systems * Develop shared observability capabilities that make metrics, logs, traces, service health, and customer impact easier to understand and act on * Improve incident response and operational readiness through better tooling, automation, standards, and actionable production signals * Build resiliency capabilities that help teams identify failure modes, reduce operational risk, and recover effectively from infrastructure or application failures * Identify recurring operational toil and reliability problems and replace manual processes with durable software and automation * Use AI as an integrated part of software development and operational problem solving, while identifying opportunities for AI enabled capabilities that improve incident investigation, observability, reliability, and engineering efficiency **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, or a related engineering discipline * Strong software development skills in o the software engineering lifecycle, with an interest in continually evolving how you use these tools as their capabilities advance **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Kubernetes, AWS, infrastructure as code, and cloud native production environments * Experience building internal reliability, observability, incident management, or operational automation tools * Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch, or similar technologies * Experience with reliability practices such as service level objectives, capacity planning, resiliency testing, disaster recovery, or operational readiness * Experience operating distributed applications with complex dependencies and high availability requirements * Experience building AI enabled operational workflows, tools, or automation that extend beyond individual code generation **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions' cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-Associate **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy
