jobs.title: Principle Integration and Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview The Principal Integration \& Data Platform Engineer leads the design and evolution of the company’s enterprise integration and data platform. This role operates at the intersection of enterprise applications, manufacturing systems, and analytics infrastructure. The position combines architecture, hands\-on engineering, and technical leadership to ensure reliable data movement and system interoperability across the organization. The Principal Engineer helps shape how information flows across the company — connecting ERP systems, SaaS platforms, manufacturing technologies, and analytics environments into a cohesive and reliable data ecosystem. This role provides senior technical leadership and works closely with enterprise applications, manufacturing engineering, and analytics stakeholders to translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions. While this role influences technical direction and mentors engineers, people management and formal performance oversight remain with the Director of Enterprise Applications. Mission Design and operate the integration and data platform that connects enterprise applications, manufacturing systems, SaaS platforms, and analytics infrastructure across the company. This platform enables operational automation, reliable data movement, and analytics capabilities that support business operations and decision\-making. Key Responsibilities Architecture \& Technical Leadership Provide technical leadership for the company’s enterprise integration and data architecture. * Provide technical leadership across integration and data platform initiatives * Define integration patterns and architectural approaches for cross\-system data flows * Translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical designs * Establish development standards and integration best practices * Participate in platform and architecture decisions alongside IT leadership * Mentor and guide engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and complex troubleshooting Enterprise System Integration Design and maintain integrations connecting core enterprise systems, including: * Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations * Tulip Manufacturing Software * eMaint CMMS * EDI trading partners * Various SaaS platforms and operational systems Integration solutions may involve APIs, event\-driven messaging, data pipelines, and orchestration workflows. Data Platform \& Analytics Infrastructure Lead development and evolution of the company’s analytics data platform. Responsibilities include: * Development of data pipelines supporting enterprise reporting * Architecture and implementation of Microsoft Fabric\-based analytics pipelines * Integration with an existing SQL Server data warehouse and SSAS OLAP models * Supporting Power BI semantic models and reporting infrastructure * Improving reliability and maintainability of enterprise data pipelines * Manufacturing Data Integration Collaborate with manufacturing engineering teams to integrate operational data from production equipment and manufacturing systems. Examples include telemetry and operational data flowing from PLC environments through systems such as Kepware, Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Stream Analytics, and Fabric. Engineering teams manage the PLC layer; this role focuses on ingestion, orchestration, and integration with enterprise systems and analytics platforms. Hands\-On Engineering This role is expected to remain highly hands\-on and engaged in day\-to\-day engineering work, serving as a senior individual contributor. **Typical work may include:** * Building integration services and orchestration workflows * Developing event\-driven integrations and messaging pipelines * Implementing data ingestion and transformation pipelines * Troubleshooting complex cross\-system issues * Supporting enterprise automation and operational data infrastructure **Primary technologies currently include:** * C\# / .NET * SQL Server * Azure Function Apps * Logic Apps * Azure Service Bus and messaging services * Microsoft Fabric and Power BI While familiarity with these technologies is helpful, success in this role depends more on strong systems thinking and the ability to learn new technologies than prior experience with any specific tool in our stack. Operational Reliability Ensure enterprise integrations and data pipelines operate reliably. * Diagnose and resolve cross\-system issues and pipeline failures * Improve monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting capabilities * Maintain documentation and operational knowledge of integration systems * May require rare after\-hours support for critical issues (no formal on\-call rotation) Required Qualifications * 8\+ years of software engineering experience * Experience designing or implementing enterprise integrations or distributed systems * Experience working with data pipelines, analytics platforms, or integration architectures * Strong programming and debugging skills in modern development environments * Experience working with cloud\-based systems and APIs * Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving platforms * Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to other engineers Preferred Experience * Microsoft Azure services * Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations integration * Microsoft Fabric or modern analytics platforms * Power BI data models and reporting infrastructure * Event\-driven architectures or messaging systems * Industrial or manufacturing systems integration * IoT or streaming data pipelines * Modernizing legacy applications Work Environment * Collaboration with teams across IT, manufacturing engineering, and business operations * Most work occurs during standard business hours with occasional after\-hours support for critical production issues Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied Research, YouTube Languages Capabilities
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * Experience prototyping and shipping ML products. * Experience designing and developing services catering user\-facing traffic. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 3 years of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging). * 3 years of experience with applied ML and scaling the product. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience developing accessible technologies. * Knowledge/interest in video accessibility (dubbing, captions, translations). **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a member of the Languages Capabilities team, your mission is to make YouTube the best platform for multilingual content. Our team leverages AI to democratize knowledge, making video dubbing and captioning easy and accessible for creators. You will be developing a next generation dubbing, captioning and video asset localization product on YouTube which leverages the many advances in AI/ML to hide away the complexities around time and language expertise from the creator and give them a simple and easy to use mechanism to dub and localize their content. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Write and test product or system development code. * Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). * Develop an innovative and successful Dubbing experience for YouTube creators that makes it possible to dub at scale with state of the art technology (e.g., Gemini, Omni). * Collaborate with partner teams, such as Google Deepmind and YouTube Infrastructure teams, on rapid prototyping and bring the research to reality with solutions that can scale across YouTube. * Establish evaluation frameworks, including AutoRaters to measure and iterate quickly. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Quality Sr Engineer I
jobs.description: At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised. **What You Can Expect** ----------------------- The Senior Quality Engineer supports the design, development, and lifecycle support of medical device software, including software incorporating artificial intelligence, for new and existing products. This role works closely with design and cross\-functional teams to support new product introductions, maintain software design documentation, and ensure compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, and industry standards. The position plays a key role in risk management, verification and validation activities, design reviews, cybersecurity considerations, and implementation of software changes throughout the product lifecycle. **How You'll Create Impact** ---------------------------- * Partner with design and cross\-functional development teams to support quality activities for new product introductions as well as maintenance on existing product lines. * Lead or contribute to design, implementation, integration, and maintenance for product development projects. * Maintain product design documentation and ensure it remains current throughout the product lifecycle. Support product changes, enhancements, defect corrections, and sustaining engineering activities for released products. * Lead risk management activities, including hazard analysis, risk assessments, and implementation of risk controls. * Support verification and validation planning, protocol development, execution, and documentation. Participate in design reviews and provide technical guidance to ensure robust, compliant, and maintainable solutions. * Collaborate with quality, regulatory, systems, and test engineering teams to support compliance with internal procedures and external standards. * Review and approve technical documentation, including, design documents, test protocols, traceability matrices, and change records. * Provide technical leadership for complex troubleshooting, root cause investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Mentor engineers and serve as a technical leader across multiple projects and product platforms. Support audit, inspection, and regulatory submission readiness activities as needed **What Makes You Stand Out** ---------------------------- * Must be familiar with all aspects and elements of a quality system including but not limited to management responsibility, resource management, product realization and measurement, analysis and improvement processes. * Knowledge on aspects of quality assurance techniques such as: inspection methods, statistical sampling plans, gauging and test methods concepts, validation, and statistical process control * Demonstrated technical expertise * Demonstrates ownership for the integrity of work * Able to work independently or as part of a team and consider options for completing work * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Your Background** ------------------- * Bachelor’s Degree in Quality or Engineering field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Must be familiar with Microsoft Office Suite * Must have minimum of 5 years of experience in Quality Engineering field * Experience of working in a regulated industry, preferably medical devices. * Experience working within a quality management system compliant with ISO 13485\. * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Proven ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams and influence technical decisions. **Travel Expectations** ----------------------- Salary Expectations: $80,000 \- $101,000 On site in Salt Lake City, Utah EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **At Zotec Partners, our People make it happen.** Transforming the healthcare industry isn’t easy. But when you build a team like the one we have, that goal can become a reality. Our accomplishments can’t happen without our extraordinary people – the men and women across the country who make up our diverse Zotec family and help make this company a best place to work. Over 25 years ago, we started Zotec with a clear vision, to partner with physicians to simplify the business of healthcare. Today we are more than 900 employees strong and we continue to use our incredible talent and energy to bring that vision to life. We are a team of **Innovators, Collaborators and Doers.** We’re seeking a **Senior ML Engineer** to join us. As a **Senior ML Engineer** at Zotec, you will build and extend the machine learning and AI systems that give our teams direct, governed access to data and AI tooling. You will design and ship models, build the infrastructure and integrations that connect large language models to real Zotec data, and help define how AI systems reason over that data safely and accurately. This role is perfect if you’re passionate about applied ML, AI tooling, and turning complex data into systems the business can actually use. **We’re seeking ML engineering professionals with:*** Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a STEM field; Master's degree preferred * 3\-5 years delivering ML solutions at scale * Proficiency in: + Python + Machine learning model development, training, and evaluation + Working with structured and unstructured data at scale + System design for data and ML pipelines * Familiarity with: + AWS, including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Redshift + Claude and other large language models + Ontology, knowledge graphs, or structured data modeling + DevOps practices, such as CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (IaC) * Experience in: + Building and maintaining tools and integrations that connect large language models to real data sources + Deploying and monitoring ML models in production on AWS + Applying knowledge representation (ontologies, taxonomies, or graphs) to improve retrieval or reasoning + Instrumenting models and pipelines for observability and performance monitoring **Who You Are:*** Can communicate clearly and effectively with cross\-functional teams, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and other engineers * Enjoy balancing technical depth with practical problem\-solving, knowing when to prioritize performance, scalability, or accuracy * Are committed to writing clean, maintainable code and mentoring others through code reviews, documentation, and collaboration * Enjoy collaborating closely with a supportive team to tackle complex technical challenges from start to finish * Understand the importance of quality standards, processes, compliance and security as it relates to the healthcare industry and have general knowledge of standards such as HIPAA or PCI **What You’ll Do:*** Design, develop, and maintain the ML models and data integrations that power our AI\-driven products and internal tools * Connect large language models to real data by building and maintaining the tools and integrations that let AI systems query and reason over Zotec’s data accurately and safely * Own the ML lifecycle from problem framing and data preparation through model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring * Architect for AWS, Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across SMS and adjacent enterprise technology teams. * Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, performance tuning, and troubleshooting production issues. * Lead technical estimation, solution planning, and Agile delivery activities for short\- and mid\-term outcomes that require independent judgment, creativity, and cross\-functional alignment. * Ensure system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security compliance. * Support production deployments, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Establish and lead SMS architecture governance, design review forums, and reusable engineering standards that improve consistency, reliability, performance, and maintainability across the platform. * Evaluate future concepts, products, and technologies for subscriber management, billing, rating, payments, provisioning, cloud modernization, and enterprise integration, and translate recommendations into actionable architecture strategies. * Serve as a recognized technical authority for SMS architecture in executive\-level discussions, roadmap planning, and high\-impact issue resolution. **What you’ll need:** * Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of enterprise software development and architecture experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 6 years experience; or equivalent experience. * Extensive experience with Oracle BRM including real\-time rating, pricing configuration, billing and invoicing, policy opcode modification, and custom opcode development. * Demonstrated expertise in opcode development following best practices for memory management and performance optimization. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, enterprise integrations, and microservices architecture. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, containerization, Kubernetes, or modernization initiatives is a plus. * Strong software development skills in C, SQL, Python, and Java within Unix/Linux environments. * Experience integrating with payment processors/gateways such as Paymentech or Worldpay. * Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise applications in production environments. * Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and leadership skills. * Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and coding assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex CLI. * Expert ability to resolve critical technical issues and broad design matters across complex enterprise platforms, with deep SMS and Oracle BRM expertise and broad knowledge of adjacent enterprise disciplines. * Proven ability to exercise independent judgment and creativity in ambiguous, high\-impact assignments where architecture decisions affect customer experience, billing accuracy, revenue operations, compliance, and platform resilience. * Demonstrated ability to build formal networks with key technical and business decision makers and influence architecture strategy across multiple teams or functions. * Must have legal right to work in the U.S. Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. jobs.title: Manager, Product Management - AI Concierge, Service Experience
jobs.description: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. **Position Summary** You will own the product direction for the AI Concierge, the front door to the AI agents and experiences that support our Customer Success organization. You will be responsible for the experience a practice has when they come to us for help getting onboarded, going live, and getting the most out of athenaOne, deciding what the Concierge handles on its own, what it routes to another agent, and when a person should step in. You will work closely with engineering and architecture to understand how these systems behave, where they connect, how they must evolve, and you will turn that understanding into requirements teams can build against. Staying close to customers is essential. You will engage with them often, put working solutions in their hands early, and iterate quickly on what you learn. This role reports to the Director of Product Management, Service Experience, and is a hybrid role based in Boston, MA. **About the Team** athenahealth operates one of the largest connected networks in healthcare, working with more than 160,000 providers and 117 million patients. Our mission is to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. The Service Experience zone is a new product development team, and its job is the AI enablement of the Customer Success journey: the part of the mission customers feel most directly when they are getting onboarded, getting trained, going live, and getting help optimizing their use of athenaOne. The AI Concierge is where that comes together. From the moment a customer joins the athena network, the Concierge understands what they need and either handles it, routes it to the right AI agent, or brings in a person. Getting that right is a hard product problem and a new one, and this role owns it. You will shape what a delightful, AI\-enabled customer experience looks like for everyone who joins us. You will not be starting from a blank page. Our first version is already built, and part of the job early on is understanding what's been built, shaping the vision for where it goes, and putting improvements in customers' hands. You will work alongside Experience Design and engineering partners, and you will be uniquely chartered with owning product direction and making quick decisions. **Essential Job Responsibilities** * Own the product direction for the AI Concierge and the agentic onboarding experiences behind it, in partnership with the Director of Product Management. * Define what the Concierge handles on its own, what it routes to another agent, and when it brings in a person, and design the handoff so the customer is not repeating themselves. * Decide what the Concierge needs to know and remember about a customer to be useful, and what context travels with a request when it moves to another agent or to a person. * Define how the Concierge behaves when it is unsure or wrong, covering when it should decline to answer, how it stays grounded in verified information, and how a customer recovers from a bad answer without losing trust. * Stay close to customers, getting in front of them regularly to understand their experience firsthand, putting working solutions in their hands early, and iterating quickly on what you learn. * Partner with the Experience Design team on customer research, using it to find unmet needs and to test whether what we built actually works before we scale it. * Develop a deep understanding of onboarding and go\-live workflows, system interactions, integration points, and operational dependencies across athenaOne and our enterprise platforms. * Partner with engineering and architecture to define problems, weigh solution options, identify constraints, and guide scope and sequencing. * Turn customer, operational, regulatory, and business needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. * Establish how we measure whether the Concierge is working, covering task success, answer quality, handoff rates, and cost, and use that evidence to decide what to fix and what to expand. * Prioritize work based on customer impact, technical feasibility, effort, risk, and business value. * Coordinate dependencies across teams and keep delivery risks, technical decisions, and release readiness visible. * Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and planning, applying your own judgment to validate what they produce. **Additional Job Responsibilities** * Support iterative delivery through discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and ongoing clarification. * Communicate product recommendations, tradeoffs, sequencing rationale, and release status to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Partner with go\-to\-market, implementation, support, and customer\-facing teams on feature readiness and adoption. * Lead customer discussions, user g ack record of turning ambiguous problems into plans a team can execute, including the discipline to write acceptance criteria and say what is out of scope. * Experience with AI or LLM\-enabled products, conversational or agentic experiences, or customer onboarding and implementation workflows, with enough hands\-on fluency with AI tools to judge what is feasible and to design around what these models cannot reliably do. * Strong communication skills, and the analytical judgment to investigate a problem across several systems and teams and come back with a recommendation. * Preferred: experience taking inherited or vendor\-built work to a first customer release; experience defining where an AI agent acts on its own and where a person approves; familiarity with EHR data migration or practice configuration. * Ability to travel up to 10\-15% annually for client site visits, conferences, and trainings. ***Expected Compensation*** $121,000 \- $207,000*The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job\-related experience,* *relevant knowledge* *and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package \- depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long\-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.* ***About athenahealth*** ***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.* ***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.* ***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.* ***What we can do for you:*** *Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.* *We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.* *In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.* *Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers* *https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal\-opportunity*

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Physical Deployment
jobs.description: Nscale is a GPU cloud platform purpose\-built for AI. We deliver high\-performance, cost\-effective infrastructure for AI startups and global enterprises alike. By streamlining complex AI deployments, Nscale empowers organizations to accelerate innovation, optimize costs, and achieve strategic business objectives cleanly and sustainably. We foster a high\-ownership, high\-impact culture driven by operational excellence, transparency, and urgency. As an Nscaler, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build and scale the foundation powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. **About the Role** ------------------ The Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Data Center Infrastructure is an individual contributor role responsible for architecting programs and driving execution across our global physical deployment portfolio. In this hands\-on position, you will personally own high\-complexity programs across the physical deployment lifecycle—defining success metrics, establishing stakeholder alignment, managing delivery schedules, and executing rack integration and delivery initiatives. This role serves as a key strategic bridge across internal teams, ensuring seamless alignment on priorities, cross\-functional dependencies, risks, and operational execution. As Nscale invests in bringing physical deployment capabilities in\-house, you will build and scale global programs focused on rack integration and onsite deployment logistics. You will collaborate closely with Data Center Development, Design \& Construction, Engineering, Power \& Utilities, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Security, Network, Operations, and Executive Leadership to establish a unified operational cadence. The ideal candidate possesses deep, hands\-on experience leading strategic infrastructure programs in data center, high\-density compute, networking, or mission\-critical environments, with a strong focus on technical depth and program delivery. **What You'll be Doing** ------------------------ ### **Internal Stakeholder Engagement \& Alignment** * Serve as the primary liaison and alignment point for internal and external teams involved in data center infrastructure delivery. * Transform high\-level strategies into structured, actionable programs that drive measurable financial, timeline, and risk\-mitigation value. * Establish robust communication frameworks, governance structures, escalation paths, and operational rhythms to ensure end\-to\-end delivery performance. * Drive cross\-functional consensus on program milestones, ownership, critical path dependencies, risk mitigation strategies, and executive decisions. * Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, ambiguous scopes, or competing priorities, facilitating rapid conflict resolution. * Synthesize complex technical, commercial, and financial data into clear executive briefings and actionable strategic proposals. ### **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship** * Partner with physical deployment engineers to champion high standards for program discipline, communication, and operational consistency. * Mentor field technicians and site teams on executive reporting, risk management, and structured problem\-solving techniques. * Enhance organizational delivery capabilities by establishing playbooks, standardized templates, and continuous improvement reviews. * Advise executive leadership on portfolio health, delivery risks, and strategic process improvements required to scale efficiently. * Foster a results\-oriented delivery culture grounded in accountability, technical rigor, and operational excellence. * **Experience:** 3\+ years of technical program management experience leading complex, large\-scale infrastructure or physical deployment programs. * **Technical Domain Knowledge:** Strong core understanding of data center physical infrastructure, networking, hardware architecture, and distributed systems. * **Program Rigor:** Proven mastery of program management methodologies (PMP, Agile, or Scrum preferred) with exceptional stakeholder management and written/verbal communication skills. * **Execution in Ambiguity:** Demonstrated ability to drive clarity and progress in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments while managing dynamic priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Direct experience managing programs related to data center infrastructure deployment, rack integration, and hardware commissioning. * Background in hyperscale or public cloud environments supporting 24/7 mission\-critical operations. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Willingness to travel periodically to data center project sites and deployment locations. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with AI\-focused infrastructure, high\-density compute environments, GPU clusters, or cloud region deployments. * Familiarity with full\-lifecycle data center deployment, including site development, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handoff. * Understanding of power infrastructure, utility interconnections, substations, cooling systems, switchgear, and MEP dependencies. * Proficiency with enterprise program tooling such as Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, MS Project, Primavera P6, or Power BI. * Proven track record scaling a program management delivery framework within a rapidly growing technical organization. * PMP, PgMP, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification preferred but not required. **What We Can Offer You** ------------------------- At Nscale, you will thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment where high\-impact work is recognized and rewarded. We are building the infrastructure foundation for the future of AI, and we offer: * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive base salary and equity package, with performance reviews every 12 months. * **High\-Growth Environment:** An opportunity to shape leading\-edge AI infrastructure alongside industry experts in a hyper\-growth startup setting. * **Career Progression:** Tailored professional development plans designed to expand your leadership capabilities and operational impact. * **Workplace Flexibility:** A human\-centric, remote\-first workplace culture that emphasizes trust, autonomy, and work\-life harmony. *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*
